Subject: The Weekly Wrap 4th July 2025
Body:
04th July 2025


 





#Fit.MS AMA June Edition – Highlights from Coimbatore

The June edition of the #Fit.MS AMA was held on June 23, 2025, at the Coimbatore campus and drew an enthusiastic crowd of over 300 associates, both in-person and virtual. The session brought sharp focus to transformation, innovation, and the evolving landscape of Mobility at BGSW.

The panel featured Rajkumar B (Vice President, HR), Panakkal Julius (Sr. Program Director, BEG), and Rajat Goel (Sr. Director, Vehicle Motion), with Akshayita Saxena (Head of Marketing & Communications) moderating the discussion.

Core themes included:

*  Why transformation now? Because the industry, technology, and customer needs are evolving rapidly.

*  AI isn’t just a buzzword, it’s a powerful enabler we can harness to improve engineering precision, leadership decision-making, and delivery outcomes.

*  Every associate has a role to play through learning, leadership, and a future-ready mindset.

From strategy to individual upskilling, the panel shared how #Fit.MS is shaping the path ahead. The open Q&A reflected strong associate curiosity, especially around AI adoption, cultural change, and career growth.

Let’s keep the momentum going. Share your feedback and join the #Fit.MS conversations on Bosch Connect!


 


 






Keep the Shakti Spirit Alive - Support, Strengthen, Stand Together!

Since 2016, the Shakti Welfare Trust created by our very own BGSW team has stood as a symbol of care and solidarity, offering vital financial support to Boschlers and their families during challenging times. It's more than a fund; it's a community-driven movement that thrives on compassion. Contributions start from as little as ₹200 and can go up to ₹500 every rupee makes a difference. To avail Shakti benefits, you must be a contributing member for a minimum of six months. 

You can start or increase your contribution by visiting HR Core ESS/MSS > My Benefits > Shakti Contributions. Let’s come together to keep the Shakti spirit alive and thriving! 

For any support, reach out to mailto:SHAKTIWelfareTrust@bcn.bosch.comor contact Roopa Panduranga (BGSW/HRL-CBP3). To know more, follow the link to Shakti_Welfare_Trust.


 


 









#TribePune | Pune Center Showcases Capabilities During Birje Jayashri's Visit         

Birje Jayashri’s (MS/ETT MS/ETT5) visit provided a valuable platform for the team to showcase the Pune center’s evolving identity and growing capabilities. The alignment with the ETH-PG strategy and integration into FIT.Pune initiatives were evident through the team's proactive engagement, showcasing a commitment to exceeding expectations and pushing beyond limitations.

A high-level technical overview—complemented by focused discussions at the MS/ETT-Pune section—offered a mapping of competencies, aspirations, and specialized expertise across the team. 

This open communication, embracing transparency and collaboration, further solidified our approach to innovation. Looking ahead, there is a shared ambition to establish a unified, competency-based structure at the Pune location in close collaboration with the management team. 

It was a delight to have Jayashri join us for our UTSAV celebration! Sharing in the joy and camaraderie of the event made her visit even more special for everyone involved.

#TribePune | BGSW Pune Steps onto the Corporate Football Field — and Makes a Bold Statement 

We’ve officially kicked off our journey in the inter-company football scene, and what a debut it’s been! Representing BGSW Pune for the very first time, our team showed up with heart, hustle, and a whole lot of team spirit.

From the very first whistle, our team brought energy and coordination that stood out, even among some of Pune’s most competitive corporate squads. What makes this even more special is the story behind it. What started with a few passionate players quickly turned into something bigger. The team came together—finding players, booking practice slots, juggling work schedules, and putting in the effort week after week. Every step showed not just love for football, but real dedication to something greater.

And it’s catching on. We've seen a big rise in interest, with more people joining in-not just to play, but to be part of something fun, healthy, and community-driven.  

Rajput Bhushan (MS/EFW2), Ambure Kartik Dattatraya (MS/EAI-PJ1-PS), Komarapuri Venkata Subhash (MS/EAI3-PS),Ubhate Yash Sharad (BD/DPA-DIS1), Zade Ratik (MS/EOD31-VM), Garud Harsh Kuldeep (BGSW/PJ-SPL1), Satpute Sandeep (MS/ENB34-EM-PE), Bendale Dotesh (MS/EDV5-ETAS), Yadav Satyajeetsinh Sanjaysinh (MS/ETT4), Arun Mathew (MS/ETD2-PS MS/EAI2-PS), Aggarwal Tarun (BD/DPA-DAP4), Ansel Sebastian (MS/ETD2-PS MS/EAV4-PS), Adannavar Mallikarjun Shekhar (BD/ERA-SCE4)


 


 






#TribePune | SAP Conclave | Fueling Innovation and Collaboration

The successful SAP Conclave held at BGSW Pune underscored our dedication to driving innovation and digital excellence in the SAP landscape. This event embodies our Bold, Boundaryless, Proud spirit, showcasing our commitment to pushing limits and collaborating effectively. A bold move to have external customers join us for discussions. A boundaryless approach where diverse teams came together to showcase innovative solutions. And a proud moment for us all where the customers appreciated the solutions we have to offer and the event. 

Key Takeaways:

Visionary Leadership: The event kicked off with a welcome from Aditya Adavi (Centre Head BGSW Pune & VP SDS APAC) and a keynote from Gopalakrishna S (Global Head for SAP Delivery, Bosch SDS) outlining the evolving SAP practice landscape.

Intelligent Enterprise Insights: A highlight was the insightful panel discussion, "Building the Intelligent Enterprise: A Journey of Innovation," moderated by Rai Divya (SDS/BSV-ES3). Esteemed panelists including Muthaiah P (Global Head, Digital Enterprise, Bosch SDS), Deepak Menon (VP and Head of Engineering, SAP Labs ), Amit Vadalkar (Head of Spare Parts Operations, John Deere), and Aditya Adavi explored key strategies and challenges.

SAP's Business Evolution: Deepak Menon and Sharath S from SAP Labs India delivered an inspiring address on how SAP is driving business evolution from strategy to validation, offering valuable perspectives on future trends.

Showcasing Innovation: BGSW colleagues demonstrated cutting-edge solutions and presented a live Marketplace demo, highlighting our capabilities and collaborative spirit.

Why it Matters:

This Conclave demonstrates our commitment to staying at the forefront of SAP innovation. The discussions and demonstrations showcased the power of collaboration and the potential of building an intelligent enterprise.


 


 






#TribePune | Stellantis Chief Engineer Visits BGSW Pune, Reinforcing Strategic Partnership

BGSW Pune recently hosted a visit from Stellantis Customer Chief Engineer, Mr. Longelin Damien, as part of the ongoing OSS & RBIC business sales strategy. Pandey Mukesh Kumar (VM/CIN2) also joined us. The visit highlighted the importance of the Pune location as a core business anchor for IOEM & GOEM, leveraging Indian R&D capabilities in the region.

Ramesh Palaniappan (BGSW/PJ-ESO1-PUN) and Kanta Sagar (BGSW/OFE-ECH-PUN), delivered a comprehensive presentation outlining Pune's strategic insights, business enablement initiatives, and Field of Actions (FoA). They emphasized the location's critical role in supporting IOEM & GOEM, showcasing the strong Indian R&D presence within the region.

The agenda of the visit included project presentations from both the OSS/IOEM team (TML, FML PSA) and the Stellantis Global team. These presentations provided a clear overview of ongoing projects and allowed for a detailed discussion of strategic direction. The discussions centered on aligning project execution with key sales objectives, fostering deeper collaboration between sales leadership and project execution teams.

The visit served as a valuable platform to:

*  Reinforce the strategic direction of BGSW's Stellantis projects.

*  Review alignment between ongoing projects and overarching sales objectives.

*  Strengthen collaboration between sales leadership and project execution teams.

A highlight of the visit was the recognition of the MS/EOB2-IOEM project team for their outstanding contributions to PSA projects. The team received a well-deserved certificate of appreciation, with the Pune-based team present and management and team members from Bangalore joining virtually. It was a proud moment for BGSW.

This visit underscores the strong and growing partnership between BGSW and Stellantis, solidifying Pune's position as a vital hub for innovation and engineering excellence. The collaborative discussions and project reviews are expected to further enhance the alignment of strategic goals and drive continued success for both organizations.

A special thanks goes to Raghu Narayana (MS/EOB2-VM) for his essential support and facilitation during the meeting.


 


 





Celebrating Sprache & Kultur!

An evening of German language, culture & connection at BGSW.

Team Binoculus/HR–Globalization came together to host an inspiring evening celebrating the spirit of language and culture. The event kicked off with a lively quiz and an engaging session on German business culture, followed by the launch of “German Nuggets” – a fresh initiative to keep language learning fun and continuous for all levels of learners.

The spotlight moment? A vibrant showcase of skills by German language achievers through a skit, poem, and presentation – all auf Deutsch! Senior leader Philips Dayanidhi, an avid German learner himself, inaugurated the new language cohorts and gave a short talk in German. We were also honoured to have with us Dr. Michael Heinst, Director of Goethe-Institut Bangalore, who shared inspiring insights on language and cultural exploration. With over 200 associates joining from across locations, it was truly an evening to remember!


 


 






Diversity Days 2025: Celebrating Unity and Uniqueness

BGSW’s Diversity Days 2025, held from June 17–24, centered on the theme ‘United’—celebrating the strength that comes from embracing diverse identities while working towards shared goals. Over 900 associates came together across engaging formats to learn, reflect, and celebrate inclusion in action.

The celebration kick started the celebration with Beyond the Binary, an awareness session by LGBTQIA+ advocate Koninika Roy. She broke down key terminology, addressed common myths, and emphasized the power of inclusive language and allyship in creating safe, respectful spaces.

On June 20 via the event United by Purpose: Powered by Diversity we had the privilege to listen to Wing Commander Navdeep Parmar, among the first women air traffic controllers in the Indian Air Force. Through her journey, she brought to life themes of courage, purpose, intersectionality, and allyship—leaving us with the powerful message: “Inclusion is modelled when we trust, follow, and uplift, even when we have the power to lead.”

The finale on June 24 featured two impactful events. Open Doors, Open Minds, a skit by the AIM Theatre Community, depicted real workplace biases across themes Women in leadership, Neurodiversity, LGBTQIA+ and Generational inclusion. GenFusion: Tapping into Generational Strengths - brought together Gen X, Y, and Z in a dynamic panel exploring generational strengths, shifting focus from ‘generation gap’ to ‘generational synergy’.

A special thanks to our cross-functional partners—MKX, FCM, Design Factory, AIM Theater Community and ICO —whose commitment and collaboration brought this celebration to life.

Together, let’s continue building a workplace where unity and uniqueness go hand in hand.


 


 





#Fit.MS AMA June Edition – Highlights from Coimbatore

The June edition of the #Fit.MS AMA was held on June 23, 2025, at the Coimbatore campus and drew an enthusiastic crowd of over 300 associates, both in-person and virtual. The session brought sharp focus to transformation, innovation, and the evolving landscape of Mobility at BGSW.

The panel featured Rajkumar B (Vice President, HR), Panakkal Julius (Sr. Program Director, BEG), and Rajat Goel (Sr. Director, Vehicle Motion), with Akshayita Saxena (Head of Marketing & Communications) moderating the discussion.

Core themes included:

*  Why transformation now? Because the industry, technology, and customer needs are evolving rapidly.

*  AI isn’t just a buzzword, it’s a powerful enabler we can harness to improve engineering precision, leadership decision-making, and delivery outcomes.

*  Every associate has a role to play through learning, leadership, and a future-ready mindset.

From strategy to individual upskilling, the panel shared how #Fit.MS is shaping the path ahead. The open Q&A reflected strong associate curiosity, especially around AI adoption, cultural change, and career growth.

Let’s keep the momentum going. Share your feedback and join the #Fit.MS conversations on Bosch Connect!


 


 






BGSW Coimbatore Stepping in to 20th Year with a Powerful INCLUSION LAUNCH

BGSW Coimbatore proudly kicked off its 20th year with the launch of a meaningful new initiative under Sankalp, the inclusion project within the FIT.KOVAI movement. The initiative titled ‘Beyond Labels’ aims to move us from token diversity and inclusion efforts to authentic human connections. It creates space to talk about invisible identities, non-traditional career paths, and mental health journeys.

This is a three-month-long project, and you can expect a series of events and conversations that will inspire awareness, empathy, and inclusion across all levels. Get ready to participate, engage, and take the first step toward going beyond labels.

The event began with an inspiring address by our Center Head Mr. Naved Narayan who shared the remarkable journey of Bosch Coimbatore’s transformation over the years. His words set the tone for what followed, a celebration of inclusion, awareness, and the power of shared stories.

We were honored to have Dr. Srividhya Shivakumar deliver a high-energy and thought-provoking session titled ‘Beyond Obvious’. Through deep reflections, she encouraged everyone to look beyond appearances, challenge assumptions, and embrace the diversity around us.

One of the most emotional segments was ‘Walk in My Shoes’ where associates courageously opened up about the labels they had been given. They spoke about how those labels affected their confidence, growth, and sense of belonging. Their stories were powerful reminders that inclusion starts with empathy and understanding.

We also had a special moment when our associates who have been with Bosch Coimbatore since 2006 came on stage. They shared their stories, emotions, and reflections both in person and through a video. Their journey touched everyone and reminded us of how far we have come together.

The event ended on a joyful note with a balloon release by the 2006 batch of associates. It marked not just their long-standing journey with Bosch but also symbolized breaking free from labels and limitations.

This event was more than a celebration of 20 successful years. It was a meaningful step toward building a more inclusive and human workplace where we go beyond labels and truly see and support one another.


 


 








Future-Ready Project Management at #ManaHyderabad         

This week at BGSW #ManaHyderabad, we hosted an engaging and forward-looking session on “Future Trends in Project Management” led by Ravi Pandey (SDS/ECX5). The session offered valuable insights into how project management is evolving in a tech-driven world. From AI-powered tools and cloud collaboration platforms to the impact of blockchain, AR/VR, and agile practices—Ravi walked us through the key trends shaping the future of delivery excellence.

Participants actively contributed with thoughtful questions, making it an interactive and enriching experience. We’re excited to see how these takeaways will inspire smarter, more adaptive project strategies across teams.

A big thank you to Ravi for the thought-provoking session and to everyone who joined in to make it a success!

Authenticity in Action: Sara Amendola Empowers SheRise Community at Hyderabad 

The She Rise women community at #ManaHyderabad drew fresh inspiration from a powerful session with dynamic leader Sara Amendola - Vice President, Chapter Domain Expertise Data, Bosch Digital.

Sara shared valuable insights on her leadership philosophy—grounded in openness and service to people—urging us to lead with authenticity. She emphasized the importance of self-awareness and encouraged us not to wait, but to create our own opportunities.

A compelling reminder that true leadership is built on intention, sensitivity, and the courage to forge your own path.


 


 






BGSW #ManaHyderabad Joins Strategic Dialogue with Andhra Pradesh CM to Shape Future of Tech & Mobility

BGSW #ManaHyderabad recently had the privilege of participating in a high-impact industry dialogue led by the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh Shri N. Chandrababu Naidu, facilitated by NASSCOM. This pivotal session brought together top leaders from the technology and R&D ecosystem to discuss a collaborative path for advancing Andhra Pradesh’s tech ecosystem through innovation, skilling, and strategic partnerships, aligning with the state's ambitious Swarnandhra Vision 2047 to turn Andhra Pradesh into a $2.4 trillion economy with a target 15% annual growth rate of GSDP.

Representing Bosch, Amjad Khan Patan, Vice President and Center Head – BGSW Hyderabad, spoke about Bosch’s focused efforts in advancing Quantum Innovation and AI-powered Healthcare solutions. His insights highlighted how Bosch is enabling deep-tech transformation in India and collaborating to build a scalable R&D ecosystem aligned with national priorities, resonating with the policy's emphasis on partnerships with IT firms and educational institutions.

The event featured significant contributions from several industry leaders including Dr. B.V.R. Mohan Reddy – Founder Chairman, Cyient; Mamatha Madireddy – MD & Head, HSBC GSC; Debashis Neogi – MD, Renault Nissan; Lalitha Indrakanti – CEO, Jaguar Land Rover Tech Services; and leaders from Capgemini, Siemens Healthineers, Johnson Controls, State Street, and Franklin Templeton. Key Themes Discussed echoed the state's policy objectives:

*  Skilling for emerging technologies (AI/ML, embedded systems)

*  DeepTech pilot programs in mobility and diagnostics

*  Building Centers of Excellence for EV recycling, quantum, and green tech

*  Strengthening academia–industry policy frameworks

*  Discussions around advanced infrastructure models like co-working spaces, neighborhood skill centers, and IT Campuses to cater to diverse employee needs.

The discussion emphasized AP's IT & GCC Policy 4.0 (2024-29) where the key pillars include Skill Development, Investment Facilitation, and fostering Startups & Innovation, alongside building green energy corridors and MSME parks. This vision is mirrored by Visakhapatnam, India's Fastest Growing Tier-II IT/Tech City. Boasting a 20% lower operational cost, significant economic contributions, major port, and an annual influx of 10,000+ skilled graduates, supported by strong infrastructure, the city underscores AP's appeal for IT and innovation.

BGSW #ManaHyderabad is proud to be part of this collaborative journey, contributing to an integrated and future-forward innovation ecosystem in Andhra Pradesh.

Subject: The Weekly Wrap 11th July 2025
Body:
11th July 2025


 






BBM-IN Common Room | Q2 2025 Recap

The BBM-IN Common Room continues to serve as a vital forum for BBM India associates to engage with Regional Sector Board Members and GB leadership on BBM India's strategy, portfolio, and transformation journey.

The Q2 2025 edition centered around the critical role of Engineering in achieving BBM-IN’s ambitious revenue goal of 10 billion euros by 2031.

In her opening remarks, Padmaja A R highlighted the varying pace of technological advancement across regions and underscored the need to continuously deliver value through our products and solutions. She emphasized the importance of:

*  Establishing a common platform for the BBM-IN engineering community to connect and collaborate

*  Developing demonstrators and Proofs of Concept (PoCs) to influence customers

*  Enhancing competency and skills to meet cross-domain requirements

*  Fostering a culture of innovation and cross-domain collaboration

The session also featured insights from engineering leaders across EM, PS.VM, and XC, who shared perspectives on the evolving technology landscape and strategies in electrification, vehicle motion, and cross-domain computing.

Missed the session?

Watch the full recording on Bosch Tube <https://bosch.mediaspace.de.kaltura.com/media/BBM-IN+%7C+The+Common+Room+-+Q2/0_8l6qgs14/22927> 


 


 









COP-PM Café launched at #TribePune         

The Pune COP-PM team, a group of passionate professionals committed to supporting and guiding project management efforts in Pune, recently launched COP-PM Café . This initiative aims to create a welcoming and informal space where associates can freely exchange ideas, ask questions, and collaborate on finding solutions. The meet will take place twice a month, providing associates with ample opportunities to come together and engage.

The launch meet of the community was successful, marking the start of an exciting new chapter for aspiring project managers in Pune! Associates had the opportunity to ask their queries, engage in discussions, and received an overview of the training opportunities available within BGSW. 

This initiative is powered by #TribePunePolestar under the Learning and Development team, with Kanimozhi Karuppusamy (MS/EHT-XC) and Keerthana Karthikeyan (MS/EPA-PJ2-PS) leading the charge to drive this valuable topic forward.

#TribePune’s Verb-O-Vibe Has Officially Launched – And It Was a Hit! 

Last week, 22 associates came together to kick off what’s set to become a vibrant community rooted in real conversations and meaningful connections. Verb-O-Vibe is a new initiative under the Learning and Development team, designed to strengthen communication skills, build confidence in public speaking, and develop essential soft skills—all within a supportive space dedicated to fostering a strong learning culture in Pune.

Driven by Mudhliar Rudrakshi (MS/EHM-TS4) and Garud Harsh Kuldeep (BGSW/PJ-SPL1), Verb-O-Vibe is all about helping associates find their voice and connect more deeply, both personally and professionally. To break the ice, we played Two Truths and One Lie—and it did not disappoint. From surprise talents to travel stories, we discovered fun, unexpected sides of one another. The laughs were real, the guesses were hilarious, and the vibe? Instantly warm and welcoming.

This is just the beginning—there’s a lot planned, including interactive sessions, confidence-boosting activities, and plenty of opportunities to develop communication skills in a fun, engaging way. Watch the teaser here <https://bosch.mediaspace.de.kaltura.com/media/Verb-O-Vibe/0_37809vy3> . 


 


 








#TribePune’s Limitless Learning Series          

“Limitless Learning" is an initiative driven at BGSW Pune and is led by the Learning and Development team. Associates actively participate in sharing knowledge, fostering a culture of continuous learning and growth.

The third session in the series focused on Prompt Engineering, led by Ranjan Rakesh (MS/ECL5), a Generative AI enthusiast and an active member of the Gen AI Tribe in Pune.

With over two decades of experience in the IT industry, Rakesh is a seasoned technocrat known for his innovative thinking and quick learning abilities. He has consistently led the adoption of cutting-edge technologies with confidence and deep expertise.

In addition to his strong technical foundation, Rakesh brings extensive leadership experience and takes great pride in mentoring associates—both in technical skills and leadership development.

His session on Prompt Engineering was thoughtfully curated to address various business use cases and catered to different categories of learners. This initiative empowered associates to effectively leverage Generative AI in real-world business scenarios, resulting in significant improvements in operational efficiency.

Reflecting on his experience with the Limitless Learning session, Rakesh says, “My passion for upskilling my team and my unwavering motivation to learn and teach new skills drive me to empower individuals and foster their professional growth. Witnessing their success is immensely rewarding and fuels my dedication to continuous improvement.”

#TribePune’s EmpowHER Initiative Kicks Off Second Batch

Launched in 2024 as part of the Veerangana initiative, EmpowHER is an innovative program designed to nurture leadership skills among women associates. This year, in 2025, we’re proud to roll out the second batch, welcoming 29 participants on this transformative journey. Aditya Adavi, Center Head, BGSW Pune and Prakash Anil (BGSW/PJ-ESO3-PUN), BU Anchor addressed the participants, encouraging them to make the most of the training and to embrace every opportunity to grow, lead, and inspire. 

Veerangana focuses on cohort-based interventions to unlock the full potential of women associates, helping them thrive in leadership roles and beyond. At the core of this initiative, EmpowHER equips participants with critical skills such as assertive communication, emotional intelligence and literacy, and impactful influencing strategies. Spanning nine months, the program combines learning sessions, coaching, and project-based activities to ensure a holistic development experience.

The journey began with WOW (Women at Work) session—a two-day immersive program that brought participants together to interact, introspect, and gain valuable insights about themselves. This collaborative and reflective experience set the tone for the empowering journey ahead.

Led by the Learning and Development team, EmpowHER promises to be a pivotal step in equipping women associates with the tools they need to lead and excel. 


 


 








#TribePune | AIFanatics Teardown a Smart Ceiling Fan at Prayogshala        

Every month, under the Innovation team’s initiative, passionate enthusiasts come together to showcase a carefully prepared product teardown, where they explore, dismantle, and present their findings on tech to fellow associates.

This month’s teardown session at Prayogshala featured an exciting deep dive into a smart home appliance — the Havells Stealth BLDC voice-activated ceiling fan.

Led by Kesarkar Tejas Manohar (MS/ENB31-EM-PE), Buddhiman Jadhav (MS/EHM-TS4), and Kamath Bola Karthik (MS/EHM-PD1-PJ1), the team examined features like the BLDC motor, RF remote control, voice recognition module, and efficient aerodynamic design. They also delved into the power-saving potential and smart offline voice control powered by Offline AI models.

Highlighting the contributions of electronics, mechanical, and aerodynamic engineering in the fan's design, the session offered a fun and informative look at how modern engineering is transforming everyday appliances!

#TribePune | Teamwork, Laughter, and Good Vibes – Inside the SAP Fun Fiesta

The latest edition of SAP Fun Fiesta brought together employees from the SX, BD, and SDS departments for a day full of fun, energy, and meaningful connections. It was another successful event that perfectly blended team bonding with lighthearted enjoyment.

Held monthly, SAP Fun Fiesta is designed to create opportunities for colleagues to step away from their desks, connect with one another, and simply enjoy themselves. Through engaging activities and playful challenges, the event helps foster a sense of community across teams.

The goal? To:

*  Build stronger working relationships

*  Encourage collaboration and better communication

*  Boost morale and associate engagement

*  Reduce stress and promote well-being

*  Create an overall positive and vibrant workplace culture

The event reminded everyone that a little fun at work goes a long way in creating a happy, motivated, and connected team. With plenty of smiles, laughter, and team spirit on display, SAP Fun Fiesta once again delivered a memorable experience.

Looking forward to what next month’s Fiesta will bring!


 


 





Bosch SDS Secures Net New Deal with Rochdale Spears!

In a significant achievement, the SDS team has successfully secured a D365 Deal with Rochdale Spears, a renowned name in luxury, custom-made fine furniture.

Despite fierce competition from 5 other vendors, Rochdale Spears chose SDS for our:

*  Strong advisory capabilities rooted in real business outcomes

*  Deep experience in deploying Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) in manufacturing environments

*  Proven methodology with an emphasis on industry best practices and standard templates

*  Ability to align D365 capabilities with Rochdale Spears’ business vision

*  Global expertise combined with local market understanding

*  Innovative approach and scalable solutions

This partnership will focus on modernizing Rochdale Spears' IT infrastructure, streamlining operations, and enhancing end-to-end visibility through integrated digital solutions — laying the foundation for long-term growth and innovation.


 


 






Tamil Nadu is Emerging as a Premier GCC Destination — and BGSW is Part of the Story

From Coimbatore to Trichy, Salem to Madurai, Tamil Nadu’s tier-2 and tier-3 cities are redefining the Global Capability Center (GCC) landscape — and Bosch Global Software Technologies is proud to be at the forefront of this transformation.

The state is building a strong, inclusive model for GCC growth, driven by:

*  Deep academia–industry collaboration

*  A stable, skilled, and future-ready talent pool

*  Strong domain and system expertise

*  A mature, business-ready ecosystem

As part of this narrative, BGSW Coimbatore recently participated in an exclusive roundtable organized by the CII Tamil Nadu GCC Taskforce with Dr. Darez A., IAS, MD & CEO of Guidance Tamil Nadu, held on 04 July 2025 in Chennai.

The discussion, centered on the theme:

“Strategic Priorities to Position Brand Tamil Nadu as a Premier GCC Destination and Unlock the Potential of Tier 2 & 3 Cities for GCC Growth,”

brought together senior leaders from 16 top GCCs including Bosch, alongside organizations such as Expeditors International, AstraZeneca, Renault Nissan, Comcast India, Dow Chemical, TransUnion India, and more.

This reinforces our commitment to building a distributed, innovation-driven, and talent-focused future — especially through our deep roots in Coimbatore and beyond.

Let’s take pride in the role we play in putting Tamil Nadu on the global GCC map.

The future is not just in the metros. It’s right here - and it’s already happening.


 


 





Quilling Workshop at BGSW – A Creative Spin with Active Campus

On 10th July 2025, BGSW’s Active Campus initiative witnessed a vibrant and hands-on Quilling workshop, led by the talented Kavita Rani (GS/OSP-SP111). With around 50+ enthusiastic Boschlers participating, the session brought color, creativity, and community together under one roof.

Quilling, the art of rolling and shaping strips of paper into beautiful designs, gave participants a chance to explore their artistic side and unwind from daily routines. Kavita guided the session with grace and patience, walking the group through techniques ranging from basic coils to intricate patterns.

Active Campus is a unique platform at BGSW where associates step forward to share their skills with fellow Boschlers. Whether it’s an art form, a hobby, or a hands-on craft, these sessions are designed to offer a refreshing experience while helping participants discover or develop new talents.

For many, this was their first encounter with quilling—and it sparked interest in pursuing the craft further. The workshop ended with smiles, proudly displayed creations, and newfound appreciation for handmade art.

Next up on Active Campus: A Photowalk in Electronic City!

Stay tuned and get ready to explore the world through your lens.


 


 








GS India kick-starts the month with a meaningful act of community service         

“As part of GS India’s Social Engagement Program for 2025, employees took their first steps of the year through a hands-on volunteering initiative focused on creating a cleaner, safer, and more inspiring environment for children at Coimbatore. The volunteering day began at 10 AM with a heartfelt welcome from the school teacher. A passionate group of 20 volunteers, alongside our NMCT NGO partners, came together for this impactful engagement. The team painted a vibrant 300 sq. ft. mural on the school’s compound wall, spreading awareness about health and hygiene. They also cleaned the school playground to ensure a safe space for children to play. The day ended on a green note with the planting of saplings within the school premises. The heartfelt appreciation from the school and NGO partners reaffirmed the power of collective action — a wonderful start to the month for GS India’s social impact journey.”

ET Edge ‘Impactful GCCs in India’ Award 

BGSW has been recognized as one of the ‘Impactful GCCs of India’ at the ETEdge GCC Summit, 2025 held recently. This recognition celebrates excellence across the GCC ecosystem, honoring leading organizations that have demonstrated innovation, operational excellence, and strategic impact in shaping the future of Global Capability Centers (GCCs). Being a leader in setting benchmarks in capability development and transformation has secured this award for BGSW. Aditya Adavi, BGSW Center Head in Pune, accepted the award for BGSW.


 


 








#ManaHyderabad Explores the Future of Software Development         

This week at BGSW #ManaHyderabad, we had an insightful knowledge-sharing session on "Redefining Software Development Environments for the Software-Defined Future."

A big thank you to our speakers Santosh P (MS/ETH-PG MS/ECF) and Imran Abdul Rahiman (MS/ETH-TE) for taking us through CFW-Frame, BBM’s next-gen Integrated Development Experience. The session highlighted how CFW-Frame unifies development journeys with reusable components, automated scaffolding, cloud-agnostic environments, and smart tooling—driving efficiency, scalability, and innovation.

Thank you to all associates who joined the session and helped make it a success. Here's to building smarter and future-ready solutions.

Celebrating International Yoga Day at BGSW #ManaHyderabad 

This week, we embraced the spirit of wellness and mindfulness with our two-day Yoga Day celebration at BGSW #ManaHyderabad!

On Day 1, associates were surprised with an energizing Desk Yoga session — where our internal wellness champions went desk-to-desk guiding colleagues through simple, effective stretches to release tension and improve posture.

On Day 2, we hosted a 1-hour guided yoga session led by an external expert, bringing together 40+ associates to reconnect with breath, body, and balance.

A big thank you to everyone who participated — here’s to continuing our journey toward holistic well-being and workplace vitality! 🙏

Subject: The Weekly Wrap 18th July 2025
Body:
18th July 2025


 






BGSW Multimarket thoughts captured in CiOL on AI Appreciation Day 2025

On occasion of AI Appreciation Day 2025, short snippet from Mr. Srihari Bhaskara V, Tech Director – GenAI at BGSW Multimarket was published in CiOL. It throws light on how AI is impacting humans and everyday lives. 

Read More <https://www.ciol.com/tech-buzz/ai-appreciation-day-2025-intelligence-for-a-better-future-9502417> 


 


 









#TribePune | BGSW and ARAI’s Collaboration to Enhance Automotive Training for Associates         

As part of our ongoing collaboration with ARAI, a focused visit was made to the Automotive Technology & EV Lab at ARAI Academy, Chakan. T-Hub Pune SPOC Karthik Rajapaul (BGSW/PJ-ETA-FTP) along with MS Pune SPOC representation from Ramesh Palaniappan (BGSW/PJ-ESO1-PUN) viewed the available facilities and training kits, and had a walk thorough with the ARAI team on how they can enhance the practical, hands-on learning experience for BGSW-Pune associates.

The visit included in-depth discussions with ARAI faculty on a range of automotive training programs—from foundational topics like Automotive Basics and Legislation to emerging areas such as EV technologies, PoC kits, System Engineering, and even soft skills on Project Management mindset development. T-Hub explored opportunities to customize or adopt existing modules to align with the upskilling needs of BGSW associates.

A key highlight was the planning of an upcoming Automotive Technology Training Program tailored for BGSW-Pune, to be hosted at the ARAI Academy. This marks a significant step toward strengthening our technical capabilities and fostering a future-ready workforce.

#TribePune | Limitless Learning Session 6 Effective Listening 

The sixth session in the Limitless Learning series explored the art of Effective Listening, led by Rakesh Ranjan, a passionate mentor and advocate for continuous learning and mindful communication. 
Framed around the powerful quote by Dean Jackson—

“Listening is an art that requires attention over talent, spirit over ego, others over self.”— the session invited associates to reflect on the deeper dimensions of listening beyond just hearing words.

Drawing inspiration from James W. Williams’ book Listening Skills Training, Rakesh introduced practical tools and techniques to help participants truly listen, understand, and validate others—fostering deeper and more meaningful connections. What made this session especially unique was the integration of Naad Yoga, the yoga of sound, as a meditative practice to enhance focus and presence. This blend of ancient wisdom and modern communication strategies offered a holistic path to becoming more attentive and empathetic listeners. 

Reflecting on the experience, Rakesh shared,

“I believe that listening is not just a skill—it’s a mindset. When we truly listen, we create space for understanding, innovation, and trust. My goal is to help associates tap into their inner stillness and become more present in every conversation.”

This session was a meaningful step toward building a more mindful and connected workplace, where every voice is heard and valued.


 


 








#TribePune | Pouch Painting Activity: A Creative Success          

The Craft and Canvas Community had a fantastic Pouch Painting activity recently at BGSW Pune! Over 90 associates from various teams and departments participated, enjoying a creative and relaxing mid-week break.

This event really highlighted the value of our boundaryless initiatives, bringing together colleagues from different areas of the center! It was a proud moment for the Craft and Canvas Community leads, Mulleti Sailahari Brahmam (BD/PTD-H2R5) and Watve Khyati (MS/ECU21-PS) to see so many people embracing the fun and creativity. The energy was wonderful!

Check out a few glimpses of the happy faces.

#TribePune | Bring Color to a Child’s World – Boschlers in Action at Gulani Village

On July 12th, as part of BGSW’s ongoing CSR efforts, Boschlers came together for a day that was as meaningful as it was hands-on at a local school in Gulani village. With energy and heart, volunteers rolled up their sleeves to clean and repaint the worn-out benches that students use every day—turning dusty, faded seats into bright, cheerful spaces where learning can feel just a little more joyful.

What started as a simple task became something more: a day of connection. Working alongside local villagers and students, the team not only refreshed the school’s environment but built bonds through shared effort and purpose.

By the end of the day, the school wasn’t just filled with colorful benches—it carried a sense of pride and hope.


 


 








#TribePune | Software Defined Vehicle (SDV) Training Powers Pune’s Systems COE        

The Systems Centre of Excellence team went through a high-impact training focused on Software Defined Vehicles (SDVs), equipping colleagues to drive innovation in automotive architecture. From exploring market and regulatory drivers to unpacking the SDV architecture stack, participants engaged in hands-on sessions covering Docker fundamentals, MQTT, microservices, and AWS integrations.

The highlight was a hands-on simulation of zonal architecture powered by Dapr and cloud services — bridging conceptual strategy with real-world agility. With tech fluency deepening and collaboration ignited, Pune’s COE is primed to lead the software-led evolution of mobility systems.

#TribePune | Blood Donation Drive

On July 15, 2025, Pimpri Chinchwad Blood Centre organized a blood donation drive where our associates participated enthusiastically. A total of 82 associates stepped forward to donate. Thanks to their generosity, the event became more than just a drive—it served as a powerful reminder that small acts of kindness can help save lives.


 


 






#TribePune | Learning & Development Highlights

A lot has been happening in the Learning & Development space recently. Here’s a quick look back at some of the key activities that have taken place.

The Veerangana – EmpowHER Leadership Learning Journey is a nine-month, cohort-based program designed to support women associates in building leadership capabilities. The program includes learning sessions, coaching, and project-based work, focusing on key areas such as assertive communication, emotional intelligence, and influencing skills. In a recent session, participants reflected on their personal and professional journeys, identified limiting beliefs, and worked on building confidence.

Design Thinking Workshop

As part of the PROPEL Leadership Program, an immersive Design Thinking workshop was conducted in Pune by Salil Inamdar (BGSW/EII C/IDR-IN). The session inspired participants to approach business problems from a user’s perspective and unlock innovative possibilities. Through hands-on activities, leaders explored creative, empathetic approaches to real-world challenges—reinforcing the value of user-centric problem solving in leadership transitions.

Empowering Leadership through Peer Coaching

As part of the renewed PROPEL journey, Peer Coaches embarked on a transformative Coach Orientation Workshop designed to unlock their potential as people leaders. This session went beyond clarifying coaching roles—it sparked purpose.

By learning to guide others with empathy and intention, Peer Coaches are now shaping a culture of growth. In this two-step leadership development model, the coaches themselves evolve—deepening their own leadership practice while uplifting those around them.

Leadership isn't a title—it's a ripple effect. And with PROPEL, it begins with each Peer Coach.

These sessions reflect ongoing efforts to build capability and foster growth through structured learning experiences.


 


 





#TribePune | PROPEL Valedictory

Six associates from the Digital & Software Next team marked the culmination of an eight-month PROPEL journey — evolving from technical contributors to strategic business thinkers.

The valedictory began with an inspiring address by Aditya Adavi (BGSW/ECH-PUN MS/KAM-EB SDS/SAM-SE) followed by Anil Prakash (BGSW/PJ-ESO3-PUN) the Business Unit Anchor. Managers, Peer Coaches and Consultant, Padmavothi Bharadwaj shared their reflections on the cohort’s growth.

Participants were felicitated with certificates, badges, and mementos, and shared personal highlights of their transformation and the tangible impact on business.

More than a celebration, the event became a springboard — as the cohort committed to continue collaborating on business-aligned ideas, building their leadership capabilities, and driving meaningful value for the organization.

Congratulations to: Rai Divya (SDS/BSV-ES3); Parakh Sagar (SX/EAL4-MM); Sandipkumar Mundada (SDS/ECE-CE); Ambekar Ashutosh (BD/PTD-TAF5); Maliyakkal Arun Sasi (BD/PTD-TAF3); Chaturvedi Abhishek (SX/ETD1-MM) for completing your journey.


 


 





#TribePune | PROPEL 2025 Self-Leadership Journey

As part of the PROPEL, associates participated in a workshop focused on a key leadership competency — Leading Self. Facilitated by Ms. Padma Bharadwaj, the session equipped participants with practical tools and techniques to enhance self-awareness, navigate communication styles, and manage conflict effectively.

Through guided reflections and interactive frameworks, the cohort deepened their understanding of personality dynamics and how these influence interpersonal interactions. The session also sensitized participants to the role of self-awareness in fostering more thoughtful, mindful engagement at work.

With this enablement, Propellers are now better poised to lead with clarity, authenticity, and empathy — beginning with themselves.


 


 






#TribePune | Driving Collaborative Innovation: Product Strategy Workshop with TATA Motors

BGSW VM Pune recently hosted a pivotal product strategy workshop, bringing together RBIC (Bosch Chassis Systems India, Chakan) and TATA Motors' Passenger Vehicles engineering team. Led by the Sales & Engineering teams, this focused session aimed to align on development priorities, explore upcoming customer expectations, and jointly define a strategic roadmap for future solutions.

Mane Yogesh Ashok (MS/EBI-VM) shared valuable inputs from the Pune team, ensuring continued alignment between the visiting RBIC team and their customer interaction throughout the workshop.

Key discussion points included:

*  Optimizing ESP solutions for Internal Combustion Engine (ICE) platforms.

*  Outlining migration plans for ESP9.3CPi and IPB1.1.

*  Strategizing one-box solutions specifically tailored for upcoming Electric Vehicle (EV) platforms.

*  Defining the localization strategy, core requirements, and project timelines.

This collaborative engagement emphasizes a shared commitment to innovation and meeting the evolving demands of the automotive market.


 


 






GCC Summit – Bosch part of Coimbatore’s Innovation Story #FIT.Kovai

From leading India’s textile revolution to EV revolution, building in AI, cybersecurity, and global engineering, Coimbatore turns ambition into reality.

At the recent GCC Coimbatore Summit 2025 on 14th July, Zinnov, in collaboration with Confederation of Indian Industry (CII), launched “Coimbatore Rising: A New Blueprint for GCC Expansion” inaugurated by Hon. Minister for IT & Digital Services, Mr. Palanivel Thiaga Rajan, leaders from GCCs, technology companies, academia came together to explore the future of innovation-led growth.

Representing Bosch, our Coimbatore Center Head Mr. Naved Narayan, in his role as Co-Convenor of the GCC Task Force, CII Coimbatore, participated as a speaker at the summit. Bosch was a name that echoed in many sessions, as a role model in establishing an R&D Center in the city. 

The panel discussion spotlighted the example of Bosch in building the strong tech and innovation-led capability through partnerships – academic, industry and startups. This was a powerful example that validated the possibility of Coimbatore merging as resilient, innovation-led GCC destination. Coimbatore has emerged as the much sought after GCC location with its strong domain capabilities — more relevant now in the age of AI.


 


 





#ManaHyderabad hosts its 2nd Quarterly Townhall 
for 2025

On July 9, we brought together our associate community for the 2nd Quarterly Location Townhall of 2025 at #ManaHyderabad — a platform to reflect, recognize, and realign for the future. Amjad Khan Patan, our Location Head, delivered updates on BGSW’s broader goals and Hyderabad’s progress, while Shishupal Reddy shared key insights from the SDS business unit as part of the “Get to Know the GB” segment.

A special highlight was the Recognition & Rewards segment where we celebrated the outstanding contributions of our peers. We also honored associates who reached service milestones — a testament to their continued commitment and dedication to the Bosch journey.


 


 





Liver Health & Organ Donation: Facts, Habits, and Informed Choices

On 14th July 2025, over 1300 BGSW associates attended an informative session with Dr. Praveen K N, who shared practical guidance on maintaining liver health and understanding the importance of liver transplantation and organ donation. The session covered daily habits, recommended and avoidable foods, common myths, early warning signs, and preventive measures for liver wellness. It also offered clarity on when liver transplants are needed, the difference between living and deceased donors, and how the donation process works. With facts over fear, the talk encouraged informed choices around health and organ donation.

Subject: IS-CS Awareness || Importance of Vulnerability and Patch Management
Body:
Dear All,

Highlighted below is the importance of Patch Management to fix any detected vulnerabilities on timely basis, to avoid incidents or data breaches.

 





Threat actors (externals and insiders) are interested in accessing the assets of the organization (personal data, business strategy, intellectual property, mergers and integration, etc.) thereby affecting the business (like penalties, reputation loss, blacklisting, financial loss etc.).

In view of this, it is of paramount importance that associates are aware of the security risks that may exist in the 3rd party tools (non-BD managed) and the software components used (like OSS, FOSS) in realizing Products and IT Systems.

Vulnerability Management

Patch Management

1.    Timely detection of vulnerabilities (i.e., weakness in both 3rd Party and Bosch supplied components) reported either within closed networks or through public sources (NVD <https://nvd.nist.gov/> , EUVD <https://euvd.enisa.europa.eu/> , vulndb <https://vulndb.flashpoint.io/users/sign_in> , etc.,)

2.    Scanning the Software Bill of Materials (SBoM) of products and IT systems to identify vulnerabilities

3.    Analysis and prioritization of identified vulnerabilities, considering factors like false positives, chances of exploitation, impact, and the risk it poses.

4.      Identification of patches or fixes from trusted sources.

1.    Based on prioritization and impact, applying patches or fixes for the relevant vulnerabilities in pre-production environment.

2.    Testing patches in a staging or QA environment to ensure no impact on the functionality.

3.    Rolling out patches along with the documentation across all deployed production environments to minimize risk exposure.

4.      Monitoring the patch status and ensure stakeholders (B2B, B2C, B2B2C, B2G) update the patch.

Doing the Vulnerability and Patch Management in a reasonable timeframe is critical to eliminate the risks of exploitation (prevent breaches/incidents). Also, the organization is able to comply with regulations and obligations, thereby avoiding negative consequences.

 

     



 

 

Best regards, 

Pavan Srivatsa

Subject: IS-CS Awareness || Importance of Vulnerability and Patch Management
Body:
Dear All,

Highlighted below is the importance of Patch Management to fix any detected vulnerabilities on timely basis, to avoid incidents or data breaches.

 





Threat actors (externals and insiders) are interested in accessing the assets of the organization (personal data, business strategy, intellectual property, mergers and integration, etc.) thereby affecting the business (like penalties, reputation loss, blacklisting, financial loss etc.).

In view of this, it is of paramount importance that associates are aware of the security risks that may exist in the 3rd party tools (non-BD managed) and the software components used (like OSS, FOSS) in realizing Products and IT Systems.

Vulnerability Management

Patch Management

1.    Timely detection of vulnerabilities (i.e., weakness in both 3rd Party and Bosch supplied components) reported either within closed networks or through public sources (NVD <https://nvd.nist.gov/> , EUVD <https://euvd.enisa.europa.eu/> , vulndb <https://vulndb.flashpoint.io/users/sign_in> , etc.,)

2.    Scanning the Software Bill of Materials (SBoM) of products and IT systems to identify vulnerabilities

3.    Analysis and prioritization of identified vulnerabilities, considering factors like false positives, chances of exploitation, impact, and the risk it poses.

4.      Identification of patches or fixes from trusted sources.

1.    Based on prioritization and impact, applying patches or fixes for the relevant vulnerabilities in pre-production environment.

2.    Testing patches in a staging or QA environment to ensure no impact on the functionality.

3.    Rolling out patches along with the documentation across all deployed production environments to minimize risk exposure.

4.      Monitoring the patch status and ensure stakeholders (B2B, B2C, B2B2C, B2G) update the patch.

Doing the Vulnerability and Patch Management in a reasonable timeframe is critical to eliminate the risks of exploitation (prevent breaches/incidents). Also, the organization is able to comply with regulations and obligations, thereby avoiding negative consequences.
