Subject: The Weekly Wrap 25th July 2025
Body:
25th July 2025


 






BGSW Cross-Collaboration Driving Value for DC Mobile Hydraulics

The DC-MH business unit is embarking on new journey into the automation market within the mobile hydraulic industry with the launch of the Offroad Robotics Controller (ORC2) project - state of art High Performance Compute ECU catering to off road applications. 

A successful demonstrator showcased by DC-MH in the Bauma 2025 based on the VCM HW Platform developed by MS/EEX-XC and SW supported by BGSW MM Poland Team & SX/EDC-MM paved the way for this platform project initiation with BGSW. Strategic partnership with BGSW for product development developed through collaboration with SX/EDC-MM and MS/ENA-MM over the last decade has laid the foundation of trust & confidence for this project with DC.

The Multi Market team, comprising members from SX/EDC-MM and SX/ENA-MM, effectively bring together the stakeholders to form a unified project team comprising of product engineering experts from MS/NE-PG. On 22nd July 2025, Key personnel from DC-MH, including Mr. Emmert Joerg (Product Manager, DC-MH/PRM3), Mr. Ritter Roman (System Architect, DC-MH/EME4) for ORC2, and Mr. Nagaiah Nandeesh (Project Manager, ME-EC/ENG31) visited BGSW for a formal project initiation & acceleration workshop and kickoff. This gathering was crucial for aligning the teams and establishing a clear roadmap for the project. The ORC2 project encompasses a comprehensive scope, ranging from hardware definition to series production. 

This initiative highlights strong collaboration between the NE-MM Business vertical, NE-PG Product Engineering horizontal, and cross-domain teams, driving greater success for Bosch.


 


 









Exploring the Future of Workplace Safety: FiORP Session at INTEX Osaka         

At EXPO 2025 in Osaka, Bosch SDS Japan representatives Hiroyuki Kawamoto, Hiroshi Nakatsuno, and Camara Harue participated in the Global Initiative for Safety, Health, and Well-being (GISHW) session, part of the Expo’s theme “Designing a Future Society for Our Lives.” This year marked the first-ever dedicated event focused on worker Safety, Health, and Well-being (SHW) at the Expo.

Hiroyuki Kawamoto presented on Bosch’s approach to Occupational Health & Safety and Cybersecurity, emphasizing the integration of physical and digital safety in today’s workplaces. The initiative, supported by Oscar Garcia and coordinated by Camara Harue, reinforced the importance of SHW not only at work but across communities, contributing to a more resilient global society.

Driving Innovation at the SAP Conclave 2025 – 
A Step Toward the Intelligent Enterprise 

Bosch Global Software Technologies (BGSW) and Bosch SDS successfully hosted the SAP Innovation Conclave 2025 at the BGSW Pune campus, bringing together customers, industry leaders, and technology experts to explore the future of intelligent enterprises. With keynote sessions, panel discussions, and thought leadership from Bosch and SAP Labs India, the event reinforced Bosch’s commitment to SAP-led digital transformation and highlighted its strong regional presence and delivery capabilities.

A major highlight was the Innovation Marketplace, where BGSW showcased a suite of SAP solutions and accelerators, including INSTA, INSTA.AI, DealerNet Portal, FINSTA, and the Bosch Scanner. Attendees also explored offerings in AI, Data Science, Cybersecurity, and the Cognitive Factory framework. The conclave not only strengthened customer relationships but also demonstrated Bosch’s ability to deliver intelligent, scalable solutions that drive business value.


 


 






BGSW Healthcare at CII Karnataka R&D Conclave 2025

Mr. Vigneshwaran K Umapathy, Delivery Manager from BGSW Healthcare participated in the CII Karnataka R&D Summit 2025 with theme “Building Karnataka as a Strategic Global R&D Hub”

The session featured addresses from key dignitaries including Hon’ble Minister Mr. Priyank Kharge, Minister for IT & Biotechnology and Rural Development, Government of Karnataka. He outlined the state’s strategic initiatives to enhance its global R&D footprint. 

As part of the summit, Vigneshwaran represented BGSW Healthcare in a focused roundtable on the healthcare sector which included participants such as Mr. Rajesh Arasu (CTO, Sparsh Hospitals) and Dr. Gopichand Katragadda (CEO, Myelin Foundry). Vigneshwaran shared thoughts on prioritizing the adoption of locally manufactured medical devices in government healthcare institutions and establishing innovation centers within medical colleges and hospitals to improve access to domain expertise and real-world clinical data. These inputs will be consolidated and shared with the Government of Karnataka for potential inclusion in upcoming R&D and healthcare policy frameworks.

The event offered a valuable platform for stakeholders from industry, academia, and government to engage in meaningful dialogue and shape the future of Karnataka’s R&D ecosystem.


 


 








Building Braking Expertise: EBN-VM Boot Camp Drives Technical Excellence          

The EBN Boot Camp is a year-long training initiative aimed at enhancing associates’ technical knowledge of vehicle braking systems. Tailored for roles like Function Owners and Component Responsible, the sessions cover key topics such as ABS, ESP, and traction control. Led by in-house experts, the boot camp delivers practical, in-depth insights to bridge knowledge gaps and support day-to-day work. The session has been curated specifically for EBN-VM associates ensuring relevant, practical, and immediate applicable insights in daily work. Through expert-led walkthroughs, participants will leave with a stronger command of technical concepts and real-world applications.  

Read more <https://connect.bosch.com/blogs/978a83a6-7a0d-4e55-a0af-6bd1da6376a8/entry/Building_Braking_Expertise_EBN_Boot_Camp_Drives_Technical_Excellence?lang=en_us> 

Driving Growth Through NE-VM Mentoring Excellence Program

NE-VM Mentoring Excellence Program, initiated by the HR Business Partner team with NE-VM leadership, promotes continuous learning and leadership development by pairing experienced mentors with mentees to foster meaningful growth. Batch 1 successfully finalized development goals with strong leadership support and positive feedback, highlighting mentorship’s role in enhancing skills, performance, and collaboration. Batch 2 is set to launch in Q3 2025, continuing the program’s impact. The NE-VM Mentoring Excellence Program reinforces a culture of development and collaboration, aligning with the organization’s commitment to talent cultivation and collective achievement.

Read More <https://connect.bosch.com/blogs/978a83a6-7a0d-4e55-a0af-6bd1da6376a8/entry/Driving_Growth_Through_Mentoring_Excellence_Program?lang=en_us> 


 


 








Growth Mindset Training Program: Learning. Leading. Evolving        

The Growth Mindset Training Program engaged 19 associates in a practical, agile-focused learning journey covering collaboration, problem-solving, and communication. Led by Agile Leadership graduates, the sessions used real project scenarios to embed key concepts and promote continuous growth. This pilot program was conducted for the Toyota Brakes team, setting the foundation for ongoing development and cultural transformation. The program was crafted by @Mahadev Prasad Shivamahadevan (BGSW/QMM-PM-ATO), @Khade Pradeep (MS/EPX1-VM) and supported @Nithini Rajendra (BGSW/QMM-PM-ATO). The project and team specific challenges were the inputs to instill this mindset deeply into our team culture, moving beyond motivation into action. The training is piloted for Toyota in Brakes and about 19 associates participated. Read more <https://connect.bosch.com/blogs/978a83a6-7a0d-4e55-a0af-6bd1da6376a8/entry/Growth_Mindset_Training_Program_Learning_Leading_Evolving?lang=en_us> .

VMove Clubs launches AIxplore #LikeABosch to champion an AI-First Culture at BGSW-VM

AIxplore #LikeABosch, an exclusive VMove club for AI enthusiasts, creative thinkers, and innovators at Vehicle Motion (VM) was launched on 8 July. The launch of the club at VM marks a significant step towards championing an AI-First mindset across project, technology, and talent. The club also aims to harness cutting-edge AI tools and techniques to drive innovation and build a thriving, inclusive AI community.

“VMove Clubs’ initiatives are helping us build the ‘W’ of the future: work, workforce, and workplace. This launch is a step forward towards BGSW’s vision of an AI-first enterprise, integrating AI into products, processes, people, and operations. " said Sreejith Radhakrishna Pillai (MS/NE-VM MS/KAM-VM).

Read More <https://connect.bosch.com/blogs/978a83a6-7a0d-4e55-a0af-6bd1da6376a8/entry/VMove_Clubs_launches_AIxplore_LikeABosch_to_champion_an_AI_First_Culture?lang=en_us> 


 


 






Celebrating Innovation at 2WP Day 2025: The Game-Changing ABSi9.4MP and BMW-BAC-FAT

2WP Day 2025 highlighted the launch of the ABSi9.4MP — a game-changing one-box ABS with integrated inertial sensing, simplifying design and enhancing performance. The event also marked a major milestone with the BMW KS1 project’s successful BAC module integration, FAT test-bench rollout among others. 

The event provided a valuable platform for engaging with a diverse cross-section of the motorcycle community - from seasoned riders and mechanics to those with a budding interest in two-wheeled transportation. BGSW 2WP team showcased the latest modular product, the ABSi9.4MP an ABS (Antilock braking system) system featuring an integrated inertial measurement unit as a one box solution, reducing complexity by eliminating the need for an external measurement device and gathered insightful feedback directly from attendees. The Kawasaki Ninja ZX-6R and  also featured ABS9.3MP product which is predecessor of ABS9.4MP or ABSi9.4MP. This generated significant interest and sparked engaging conversations, reinforcing the passion and enthusiasm within the motorcycle world.

Unified by One Team Spirit, the celebration reflected the team's commitment to innovation, excellence, and future mobility.

Read More <https://connect.bosch.com/blogs/978a83a6-7a0d-4e55-a0af-6bd1da6376a8/entry/Celebrating_Innovation_at_2WP_Day_2025_A_Look_at_the_Game_Changing_ABSi9_4MP?lang=en_us> 


 


 





BGSW Multimarket at Industry Interaction event organized by IIT Kharagpur

BGSW Multimarket participated in the industry interaction session organized by IIT Kharagpur. The focus was to strengthen research in India along with Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF). The event brought together industry leaders from various organizations to explore industry-academia partnerships to accelerate innovation and research. Mr. Shivkumar Kalyanaraman, (CEO, ANRF) spoke about ANRF’s support in enabling fellowships and innovation in MedTech, AI & Climate sustainability. BGSW Multimarket presented its portfolio and innovations led from India emphasizing the importance of Industry-Academia collaborations creating impactful solutions for the masses.


 


 






Igniting the Learning Spirit: JKL Elevate Expo Wraps Up on a High!

In today’s fast-evolving world, the ability to learn, unlearn, and relearn is not just valuable, it’s essential. Through a carefully crafted marketplace, the HR Learning Culture team organized JKL Elevate Expo, a bold step toward embedding that mindset into our culture. At a time when adaptability and continuous upskilling are key to staying ahead, this initiative brought learning to the forefront, empowering over 4500+ associates to explore new skills, tools, and perspectives. With interactive stalls and expert demos from our esteemed learning partners KodeKloud, LinkedIn Learning, MathWorks, Simplilearn, Skillsoft, and Udemy, along with recognition of active learners, every moment reinforced our belief that growth begins with curiosity.

The overwhelming enthusiasm and heartfelt engagement at every location made the JKL Elevate Expo a truly special experience. With an impressive experience rating of 4.43/5, it’s clear that our associates felt inspired, valued, and empowered to continue their learning journey with passion and joy.

This collective success reflects more than just numbers it showcases the power of collaboration in making learning accessible, exciting, and personalized.

A big thank you to all teams and leaders who turned this vision into reality. Your efforts helped create a culture where learning is not just encouraged but celebrated.


 


 





BGSW Healthcare Thought Leadership article covered in Business World Healthcare

“One Nation, One Diagnostics Framework: The Case for Unified Lab Regulations” - Healthcare thought leadership article from Mr. Guruprasad S (Vice President & Global Director) was published in Business World Healthcare. It throws light on Unified Diagnostic framework – A strategic leap towards equitable, efficient, and modern healthcare in India.

Read More <https://www.bwhealthcareworld.com/article/one-nation-one-diagnostics-framework-the-case-for-unified-lab-regulations-564215#:~:text=The%20One%20Nation%2C%20One%20Diagnostics,goal%20of%20Universal%20Health%20Coverage> 


 


 






Fit.KovAI - AI Day 2025: A Glimpse into the Future

On July 17, 2025, BGSW Coimbatore became a hub of innovation and insight as it hosted the dynamic Fit.KovAI event. Powered by BGSW/BDO and Bosch Digital, the event brought together technologists, innovators, and industry leaders to explore the significant impact of Artificial Intelligence (AI) across various sectors.

The day began with a warm welcome from Naved Narayan, Vice President and Center Head of BGSW Coimbatore. Jacob Peter Kidangath, BD - Board of Management, delivered an inspiring video message emphasizing AI's crucial role in transforming work processes and business operations. He highlighted BGSW's commitment to becoming an "AI-first enterprise" as part of 2030 Vision and BD's efforts to optimize internal operations through AI integration.

Ganesh Mahadevan Vaidyanathan, CIO and CDO of BGSW/BDO, underscored that AI Day is a strategic initiative aimed at transitioning the organization to AI-first operations by fostering collaboration across all functions. In the past 180 days, BGSW/BDO has launched several AI solutions and has plans for further advancements, including Generative AI and Co-Agentic AI, while continuing to partner with Bosch Digital to drive innovation.

The event featured a compelling keynote presentation by Murali Kumar, Founder and CEO of NeoTrack, Teratics, and TBCM GmbH. He discussed how "AI is Reshaping the Industry – Now and in the Future," highlighting the revolutionary effects of contemporary AI infrastructure, multimodal intelligence, and autonomous agents on productivity and innovation.

The BD team shared their success story on enhancing productivity with GitHub Copilot, showcasing improvements in development, testing, and documentation across Java, SAP ABAP, and Python projects with productivity improvement of 20 percent of overall testing effort. Their insights, derived from 74 projects involving over 1,000 associates, included a live demonstration of Copilot’s Agent Mode and curated Cookbooks for SAP and web development.

Additionally, Naved Narayan, Gregor Schrott, and Sritharan S launched BGSW/BDO’s new Voice and Chat Seat Booking System, designed to streamline seat reservations for hybrid work environments through AI interactions. Additionally, BGSW/BDO also presented two use cases, namely CIA for ACCM - a conversational interface offering real-time insights into talent capacity, skills, and strategic workforce planning, and Hey BGSW – an AI-powered L1 IT support assistant, now handling high-volume queries with 24/7 availability and instant resolutions.

A thought-provoking panel discussion featuring experts Gregor Schrott, Murali Kumar, and Raajaguru Mylsamy, moderated by Mathew Nellissery, explored the transformative power of AI across various industries and its impact on empowering communities followed by an engaging Q and A session including themes of frugal innovation and impact creativity.

The Fit.KovAI event at BGSW Coimbatore concluded with a speech from Sritharan S, marking the beginning of an exciting AI journey for the organization, paving the way for future AI-driven innovations.


 


 





Building Bridges Across Regions: Christine Thelesklaf at MS/ECU-PS

In early June, MS/ECU-PS had the pleasure of hosting Thelesklaf Christine (PS-SC/RBU-NA PS-SC/CE-AM), Global-KAM for the PS-SC Customer Engineering Business in North America. Her week-long visit featured strategic discussions on market outlook, customer feedback, growth opportunities, and challenges in the CE business across the region.

Christine explored the AI-themed Marketplace organized by MS/ECU-PS associates, showcasing use cases spanning requirement engineering, design, coding, testing, validation, and project management. She also delivered an insightful presentation at the Associate Townhall, highlighting shifts in U.S. customer preferences—particularly the rise of hybrids—and the evolving landscape of the ICE business.

Focused group interactions with project managers and technical associates offered deeper dialogue and new perspectives. The visit reinforced a strong spirit of collaboration within CE-AM, emphasizing the need to leverage cross-location capabilities and seize opportunities to strengthen Bosch’s positioning with CE-AM customers in the evolving automotive space.


 


 






#TribePune | ETH-PG Management Visit – Strategic Engagement & Associate Connect

On 9th July 2025, the ETH-PG-Pune team had the privilege of hosting Santosh P (MS/ETH-PG MS/ECF) and Imran Abdul Rahiman (MS/ETH-TE) from the ETH-PG management team. The visit was part of a broader initiative to foster strategic alignment and strengthen associate engagement across locations. 

Strategic Dialogue with Leadership Team 

A focused interaction was held with Aditya Adavi (BGSW/ECH-PUN MS/KAM-EB SDS/SAM-SE), Center Head BGSW Pune, and Ramesh Palaniappan (BGSW/PJ-ESO1-PUN), Business SPOC, to discuss: 

*	The evolving business strategy in the context of service offerings. 
*	Opportunities to leverage internal frameworks across business units. 
*	How the ETH-PG services portfolio can be positioned to create traction in the external market, especially within the existing ecosystem of OEMs in and around the Pune region. 

Associate Session: “Redefining Software Development Environments for the Software-Defined Future” 

A dedicated session was conducted for Pune associates, focusing on: 

*	The transformation of software development environments. 
*	The role of associates in shaping the software-defined future. 
*	Encouraging a mindset of innovation, efficiency, and long-term technology sustainability. 

Open Discussion with ETH-PG-Pune team was focused more on the associates shared perspectives on: 

*     Their impact across regional teams and contributions to strategic goals. 

*     The importance of cross-team collaboration, quality assurance, and traceability in delivery. 

*     Aligning project practices with organizational goals and horizontal delivery models. 

The leadership emphasized the need to maintain high standards of execution and innovation, reinforcing the collective commitment to excellence across internal and external engagements.


 


 






#TribePune | VM-OSS, EOS Pune Team Outing

Recently, the VM-OSS, EOS teams conducted a focused day outing at BGSW-Pune. The VM OSS leadership team, including Sunku Sreekanth (MS/EOB-VM MS/PJ-SWP-OS-VM), Hari Prasad Tilak Swamy (MS/EOA-VM), along with program managers, actively participated in this event. The day was designed to blend productive strategic discussions with engaging team-building activities, reinforcing our business objectives while fostering closer connections with team.

The visit provided a valuable platform for in-depth conversations around our business strategy and business development initiatives. Leadership shared key insights on market trends, emerging growth opportunities, and strategic priorities aimed at enhancing our competitive positioning and ensuring long-term success. A primary focus of the discussions was gaining a deeper understanding of customers’ pain points. Being physically closer to the customer environment allowed us to identify challenges firsthand and explore ways to deliver faster, more effective support. This proximity plays a crucial role in boosting responsiveness and building stronger, trust-based relationships with our clients.

In addition to these strategic discussions, the day was filled with fun and interactive activities designed to strengthen team spirit and collaboration. The EOS Pune team took a break from their usual work routines to spend a day together at Nature Trails, Durshet. Set in a scenic location, the outing offered a refreshing change of pace centered around connection, collaboration, and a shared sense of enjoyment.

The team left the day energized and aligned on key action points, including accelerating support turnaround times, enhancing cross-team communication, and launching new initiatives for proactive engagement. This perfect blend of work and play reinforced our collective commitment to customer-centricity and operational excellence, while nurturing a motivated and cohesive team.

Voice of Associates

Naik Manasi Mahesh (MS/EOB2-VM): 

I really enjoyed the team outing! It was a great opportunity to bond with colleagues outside of work. The activities were fun and refreshing, and the relaxed atmosphere helped build a sense of camaraderie.

Khandetod Rushi Yashwant (MS/EOA21-VM):

"Truly a refreshing and well-organized outing! Every detail was thoughtfully planned, creating the perfect environment to relax, recharge, and foster meaningful connections across teams. A heartfelt thank you to everyone who made this possible!"

Dhage Nilakantheshwar (MS/EOB12-VM):

"Overall, it was a memorable day filled with laughter, adventure, and relaxation. I can’t wait for our next outing! We spent most of the day exploring the area and enjoying peaceful nature walks.

Srivastava Manzil (MS/EOA21-VM):

Being a fresher, this was my first office outing—and it was truly an energizing and joyful experience that encouraged team bonding.

The collaborative team games made the day even more enjoyable. It was a wonderful opportunity to connect, unwind, and share memorable moments with everyone. Thank you all for making this such a memorable experience!

Govind Jaykishan Maniyar (MS/EOD3-VM):

It was really a fun time relaxing with the team at a nice location. We had lot of fun games which would definitely help in team building. It was also good to bond with leaders who travelled all the way from Bengaluru for the outing and also with people beyond our respective teams/accounts.


 


 






#TribePune | Highlights from the recent MS/EBS Leadership Visit

Shastry Karthik K M (MS/EBS-VM MS/EBS6-VM MS/PJ-EMP-BS-VM) recently visited BGSW Pune. The aim of the visit was to foster strategic alignment and strengthen associate engagement across locations. The EBS7 Pune team seized this opportunity to interact with Karthik, showcasing our latest achievements and engaging in impactful discussions. 

An HR-focused interaction was held with Chintamani Neha (BGSW/HRL-BP-PUN) to discuss talent development and updates on the available talent pool. Strategic discussions on the future path of EBS7 and RBIC collaboration were conducted with business SPOC Ramesh Palaniappan (BGSW/PJ-ESO1-PUN) and with VM-IOEM SPOC Shanmugasundaram Angamuthu (MS/EBI-VM), focusing on IOEM VM strategy and OE project anchored & contributions from Pune. 

A dedicated session was conducted for Pune associates where we had the opportunity to highlight Pune’s exceptional talent and technical depth through conversations about:

*	Frontend Complete IOEM SysEng
*	Frontend FuSa for IOEM – Key Topics
*	Support for CBDS & Pilot MBD (Simulation) for IOEM
*	Enhanced Value Capture in OBD (PCO India) & Legal Topics (LRE)
*	SoS System Testing
*	Seamless Transition of iB2 Safety in Customer Projects
*	AI/ML, GenAI, Automation Innovations

The EBS7 team had open discussion with Karthik without formal barriers. This spirit of openness highlighted our drive for bold ideas and innovation.

Team aligned on a goal: to build one strong, skill-based team for EBS7 in Pune while collaborating seamlessly with teams in Bangalore and Coimbatore. 

The team also showcased our achievements from automation wins to fostering a strong, inclusive culture reflecting the passion, agility, and accountability. 

Beyond work, Karthik joined us for an EBS7 team get-together.


 


 





#TribePune | CSR | Creating Math Tactiles

As part of our ongoing commitment to social responsibility, 25 enthusiastic volunteers from BGSW participated in a heartwarming CSR initiative to support visually impaired students by creating Math tactiles. This engaging walk-in activity saw our volunteers craft over 25 educational tactiles featuring shapes like squares, rectangles, circles, and even a tactile map of India. Each tactile was designed to aid the students in better understanding mathematical and geographical concepts through touch. The activity was filled with joy, creativity, and a shared sense of purpose, as volunteers poured their love and effort into each piece—making a meaningful impact on the future learning journey of VI (Visually Impaired) children.


 


 






Strengthening the Ecosystem for Women Entrepreneurs | #ManaHyderabad x WE Hub

On 16th July 2025, Amjad Khan Patan, our Location Head at BGSW #ManaHyderabad, along with our CSR Lead Bezaleel Johnson and members of the SheRise community Pujitha and Manasa, visited WE Hub, the Government of Telangana’s pioneering initiative and India’s first state-led incubator dedicated to promoting women entrepreneurship across urban and rural landscapes. As part of the collaboration, Bosch and WeHub explored several promising initiatives including the co-creation of a structured program for strengthening Women entrepreneurship within and outside Bosch, hosting a Bosch Day showcase for WeHub entrepreneurs, and inviting Bosch women leaders to participate in WeHub’s rural and urban graduation ceremonies. The discussion also covered opportunities for Bosch leaders to engage in WeHub’s Masterclass on Investing, potential support in building an AI-powered mentorship platform under the Deep Tech Global Network, contributions to the Telangana Government’s "Million Women Leaders to Millionaires" initiative, and the possibility of sourcing products from WeHub entrepreneurs for Bosch’s employee gifting occasions.

This visit marked a promising step towards deepening our shared vision of enabling inclusive growth, fostering innovation, and creating impactful opportunities for women changemakers. The dialogue was rich with ideas for future collaboration and touched upon several key areas of mutual interest.

This powerful collaboration reinforces our commitment to enabling opportunities that drive gender equity, entrepreneurship, and societal transformation


 


 





Celebrating the Spirit of Culture and Community at #ManaHyderabad

At BGSW #ManaHyderabad, we recently came together to celebrate the vibrant spirit of Bonalu — a cultural festival that beautifully reflects the richness of local traditions and the power of community.

The event was filled with energy, color, and joy as associates embraced the festive spirit with traditional music, dynamic folk performances, and vibrant ethnic attire. Delicious sweets and cheerful moments added to the atmosphere, creating a space where everyone could connect, celebrate, and appreciate the diversity that makes our workplace so unique.

Moments like these go beyond just celebration — they help us strengthen bonds, foster inclusivity, and honor the cultural fabric that connects us all. A heartfelt thank you to everyone who participated and made this event truly special!

Subject: The Weekly Wrap 1st August 2025
Body:
1st August 2025


 






BGSW Spectrum 2nd Edition is Now Live!

Inside, you’ll find stories of innovation, leadership, and transformation. From hydrogen engines and electric ecosystems to the voices of eco warriors, coders, and creators shaping tomorrow. This edition brings together the voices, ideas, and innovations of Boschlers, showcasing who we are and where we’re headed.

Read Now <https://rb-design-factory.de.bosch.com/01_projects/BGSE_Spectrum/30072025_BGSW%20Spectrum%20Flipbook%20file_V1/30072025_BGSW%20Spectrum%20Flipbook%20file_V1.html#p=1>  -->


 


 






Bosch Quality Award

Bosch Quality Award is a prestigious award to reward the projects across various domains and category of products and service across Bosch Divisions, globally. For the year 2025 the awards were given for the below six categories:

*  Product Launch: 16 Nominations            

*  Software Quality: 31 Nominations

*  Sustainable Quality: 16 Nominations

*  Logistic Quality: 14 Nominations

*  Customer Journey: 18 Nominations

*  Open Category: 66 Nominations

Of the 31 nominations in Software Quality, the top three projects were all from BGSW-IN 

1.    Functional Safety ECU SW for JLR – from MS/NE-PS

2.    Tool Apps “Levelling Remote” and “Thermal On” from SX/NE-MM

3.    DCDC Converter Software for Daimler Trucks from MS/NE-EM

The final winner was the Tool Apps “Levelling Remote” and “Thermal On” from SX/NE-MM.

CONGRATULATIONS to the Team of SX/NE-MM for being the winner of this prestigious award.


 


 






Lighting the Spark: FIT.Kovai WiL representation in Udyog Utsav 2025

The 13th Udyog Utsav by Project Puthri, held on July 26, 2025, at Hindustan College of Arts & Science, Coimbatore, marked a powerful capstone—connecting over 700 government schoolgirls with inspiring career role models and industry leaders.   The event was graced by Chief Guest Ms. Selvarani Mylsamy, Senior Cloud Architect, BGSW Coimbatore, and a strong advocate for women in STEM. Her keynote message, “Believe in yourself, set a goal, and achieve it. Minimize distractions and value your time,” resonated deeply. 

BGSW Career Stall – Led by Women in Leadership #FIT.Kovai

Representing FIT.Kovai’s Women in Leadership from BGSW Coimbatore, Abinaya Chandrasekaran and Pournimaa Venkatraman hosted the Bosch career stall in which they

*	Showcased Bosch’s innovations in Automotive, Power tools, Industry automations and Smart Home
*	Guided students on STEM careers and breaking gender stereotypes 
*	Encouraged girls to dream big and pursue tech with confidence 

Udyog Utsav 2025 was more than an event, it was a movement which created an impact. Together with Project Puthri and BGSW, the FIT.Kovai WiL community is empowering every girl to know she belongs and to believe she can lead.


 


 









BGSW Coimbatore representation at GITAM Deemed University | #FIT.Kovai         

It was a proud moment for BGSW to have Mr. Narayan Naved (MS/NE-ES, Center Head-Cob) as the Chief Guest at the graduation ceremony at GITAM Deemed University. His inspiring address beautifully bridged the connection between academia and industry, message highlighted the dynamic changes shaping industries amidst global disruptions reshaping businesses worldwide and the importance of staying agile, resilient, and future-ready.

He emphasized the importance of nurturing strong University–Industry relations, ensuring that graduates are not only prepared with knowledge but also with the skills, adaptability needed to thrive in the real world.

For the graduating students, it was more than a ceremonial send-off—it was a call to embrace challenges, stay curious, and be future-ready. 

BGSW continues its journey enabling industry-academia partnership.

Kovai Boschlers Toastmasters Club | Area G4 Conclave 2025 | Empowering Leaders, Elevating Bosch | #FIT.Kovai 

Kovai Boschlers Toastmasters Club (KBTC) proudly hosted the Area G4 Conclave 2025, a power-packed event that brought together 5 Toastmasters clubs across Coimbatore. Planned and executed in short time, the event was a true showcase of leadership in action — from managing the venue and logistics to curating impactful experiences. The event was inaugurated by our dynamic comperes Kalyanaraman S (MS/EKI1-XC) and Sonia Shivshankar (MS/ECC-EE-XC), whose engaging presence set a vibrant tone for the day. The conclave exemplified what’s possible when a shared vision is matched with teamwork and ownership.

Highlights included sessions by DTM Joe R, Humorous Speech Champion 2023, who delivered an engaging session on The Art of Humour, and DTM Raghavan Sridhar, International Speech Champion 2022, who conducted a masterclass on Evaluation Reimagined. A lively cultural performance by Bosch associates added colour and energy to the day. With over 100 participants, seamless coordination, and high-energy delivery, the conclave felt like a mini division conference. It was not just an event — it was an experience that inspired, connected, and elevated everyone involved. Special thanks to Area Director G4 Janani Arumugam (BD/MSA-IPM1 BD/MSA-CSR-Sq3) and the entire KBTC crew for setting a new benchmark in leadership, collaboration, and excellence.


 


 








RCK Collaboration Workshop: Strengthening Innovation and Market Strategy

SDS Japan’s Korean partner, RCK CEO Ms. Soojin Park and CTO Mr. Joseph Yi, recently visited Bangalore for a focused workshop aimed at enhancing our business presence in Korea. This collaborative session was instrumental in driving strategic alignment and business growth. Through in-depth discussions and hands-on engagement with the SAP, EFD with AI, and D2D teams, we identified key priorities and explored innovative solutions tailored specifically for the Korean market. The workshop strengthened our partnership with RCK and provided key insights to boost market efforts and deliver greater value to Korean customers.

Bridging Borders Through Innovation: Youth Leaders from Sri Lanka Visit Bosch Bangalore

Recently, a group of youth leaders from Sri Lanka, part of an initiative by the Ministry of External Affairs, visited the Bosch Campus in Bangalore. The visit offered them an in-depth look at how Bosch is pioneering advancements across AIoT, automation, sustainable mobility, and digital manufacturing. During their time on campus, the leaders engaged in meaningful discussions about the evolving technology sectors, its global implications, and how it shapes our future. The visit was more than just a tour, it was an exchange of visionary ideas, highlighting Bosch’s unwavering commitment to innovation and customer-centric solutions.


 


 






#TriebPune | Culture as a Competitive Edge: Insights from Sonal Vaidya (Global Head – Organizational Development & Effectiveness, L&T Technology Services)

The Learning & Development team in Pune regularly hosts Leadership Connects, and this session stood out.

As Pune deepens its cultural journey, it was inspiring to hear Sonal Vaidya, Head of OD & DEI at L&T Technology Services, share her wisdom on culture as a strategic differentiator. With over 25 years of experience, her reflections on Project Avatar—LTTS’s transformation initiative—offered a profound lens into how culture is being anchored to Lakshya 2031 at L&T.

She effectively showed how culture is lived, not just hoped for. Her emphasis on paradoxical leadership, courage, and daily rituals gave associates concrete ways to embrace values and act on them.

A standout message was her redefinition of leadership: “Every associate is a leader.” This perspective champions collective ownership, where cultural transformation is fueled not just by hierarchy, but by shared commitment and co-created behaviors aligned to the business’s future success.

The session left participants energized—with actionable insights that promise to ripple across teams and initiatives. Sonal’s storytelling powerfully demonstrated its ability to drive cultural change.


 


 





 


 





BGSW #ManaHyderabad Hosts German Indian Round Table on Skilling the Future Workforce

On July 30, BGSW #ManaHyderabad had the privilege of hosting the German Indian Round Table (GIRT), centered on the critical theme of "Skill Development and Workforce." The event brought together distinguished leaders, policymakers, and industry professionals for a rich and meaningful dialogue on shaping the future of talent.

We were honored to welcome Dr. Bala Ramani (Academic Director, German-Indian Management Studies, Hof University) and Mr. Srikanth Sinha (CEO, Telangana Academy for Skill and Knowledge) as keynote speakers. Dr. Bala shared a powerful message about the growing demand for nearly 400,000 skilled professionals every year in Germany, highlighting the urgency for global talent mobility and upskilling. Mr. Sinha shed light on skilling initiatives and innovations happening across Telangana and India.

We were also pleased to have Mrs. Amit Desai, Honourable Consulate of Germany - Hyderabad, join the session, further strengthening Indo-German collaboration.

As part of the discussion, we shared BGSW’s strong learning culture, showcasing our seamless and personalized learning journey for associates that enables continuous upskilling, reskilling, and professional empowerment across domains. The event also served as a platform for exchanging ideas, best practices, and co-creating strategies to future-proof the workforce.

We look forward to continued engagement and collaborative efforts to build a resilient, future-ready talent ecosystem!


 


 






BGSW #ManaHyderabad Shuttlers Take the Court at CII Badminton

Tournament 2025Ask ChatGPTWe’re thrilled to share that BGSW #ManaHyderabad proudly participated in the CII Badminton Tournament 2025, marking our first-ever collaboration with CII Hyderabad. While we didn’t bag the trophy, the experience was a celebration of team spirit, preparation, and perseverance. From conducting internal evaluations to selecting top talent and organizing dedicated practice sessions, our players showed incredible discipline and passion. The Sports Community extended unwavering support—providing equipment, jerseys, and managing logistics—ensuring the team was tournament-ready. Throughout the journey, our participants demonstrated true sportsmanship, mutual encouragement, and unity. This initiative not only reflected our commitment to fitness but also strengthened our internal culture of camaraderie and wellness. A heartfelt thank you to all who played, practiced, and cheered — here’s to many more such inspiring journeys together!


 


 








SX/NE-MM Chess Tournement Across Locations

The SX/NE-MM Section successfully hosted a well-received Chess Tournament across four locations this past weekend, bringing together associates to engage in the ultimate battle of minds.

At the Hyderabad location, the event saw enthusiastic participation, even on the weekend, with employees showcasing impressive strategic thinking and focus. The tournament not only tested mental agility but also fostered collaboration, concentration, and a strong sense of community.

Kudos to all the participants and organizers for making this intellectually enriching experience a success!

In person German Language Training – Batch 2 at #ManaHyderabad

BGSW #ManaHyderabad successfully hosted Batch 2 of “Deutsch – Stufe 1” German language training at the Hyderabad location on 24th & 25th August 2025.

Conducted in person, the session brought together enthusiastic associates eager to embrace new linguistic skills, cross-cultural communication, and global collaboration.

It’s inspiring to see the growing interest and participation in language learning as we continue to foster a globally connected workforce.

Viel Erfolg (Good luck) to all the participants on this exciting journey!

Subject: The Weekly Wrap 8th August 2025
Body:
8th August 2025


 






BGSW Spectrum

Whether it’s a fresh take, a thoughtful insight, or a story that connects to our shared journey we’re listening.

Explore the themes, select what resonates, and let your words bring them to life.

1.	Small Shifts, Big Impact: Micro-Transformations at Work
2.	The Change I Feared — and Why I’m Grateful for It Now
3.	How I Learned to See Strength in My Own Struggles
4.	From ‘I Can’t’ to ‘I Can’: My Turning Point

SUBMIT NOW <https://forms.office.com/e/8mRutivFcG> 

Read BGSW Spectrum 2nd edition here <https://connect.bosch.com/wikis/home?lang=en-us#!/wiki/Wcd2ef57e468b_42ab_bf2b_3180ec0d9471> 


 


 









The Power of One: MS/NE-PG Cob Leadership Confluence         

Held on July 31st and August 1st, the MS/NE-PG leadership summit at Coimbatore was a vibrant showcase of seamless collaboration and connection. Led by Section Head Shrikanth Hegde (MS/NE-PG MS/KAM-ME) and the team of 20+ Product Engineering leaders, along with BE3 HR Lead Ranganathan Srinivasan (BGSW/HRL-BP3 BGSW/HRL/TA) and the extended HR team, the 2 days harmonized strategy, people, and purpose.

Day 1 began with a mid-year business review, with a focus on revenue, efficiency, opportunities, and agility. The launch of two Communities of Practice came next — Project Management Cohort and Techies at NE-PG — designed to drive innovation and cross-functional networking. A standout moment was the associate connect at Cob GTP, a heartfelt leadership interaction with 80+ associates, sparking meaningful dialogue and inspiration across levels (the magic continued the next day at IndiaLand, with 200+ associates!) This memorable day ended with team-building activities, service milestone celebrations and dinner.

Day 2 opened with a dynamic workshop designed by the HR Leadership and OD team, inviting NE-PG leaders to explore their creative strength beyond boundaries. An insightful open house with BP3 HR Lead Ranganathan Srinivasan followed, offering a deep dive into HR strategy. Next, the future of AI in Product Engineering took center stage to target use cases to drive tangible impact. The energy peaked with the mega-launch of the NE-PG Cricket Tournament, flagged off by 13 teams competing for the coveted trophy.

The summit embodied the Power of One—a united force of trust, purpose and a winning mindset.

MoU exchange between BGSW and Tamil Nadu Technology Hub (iTNT) at IN2TN IP Conclave 2025 

A proud moment from the IN2TN IP Conclave 2025, where Bosch Global Software Technologies formally signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Tamil Nadu Technology Hub (iTNT), Chennai. 

Representing BGSW at this important event were our Center Head, Mr. Naved Narayan, and our CTO, Mr. Mohan Krishnaswamy. This milestone exchange took place in the esteemed presence of:

Thiru. Udhayanidhi Stalin, Hon’ble Deputy Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, Dr. Palanivel Thiaga Rajan, Hon’ble Minister for Information Technology and Digital Services, Senior government dignitaries, policymakers, and key ecosystem stakeholders

This MoU marks the beginning of a strategic collaboration to strengthen the Deep Tech ecosystem in Tamil Nadu. Through this partnership, BGSW and iTNT will jointly focus on:

*  Fostering innovation and IP-led initiatives

*  Advancing academia-industry collaboration

*  Contributing to the growth of the state’s tech and startup ecosystem

*  Creating channels for our teams to engage with and seek solutions from startups incubated at iTNT

This collaboration also opens up opportunities to co-develop proofs of concept, explore joint innovation models, and engage with emerging technologies driven by early-stage ventures.

Importantly, this aligns with BGSW’s strategic goals of ecosystem enablement and collaborative innovation — reinforcing our long-standing commitment to strengthening the startup and technology ecosystem around us. While this is just the beginning, we look forward to unlocking high-impact outcomes through this association — not just for BGSW, but for the broader innovation ecosystem of Tamil Nadu.


 


 






Global Business Services India Turns 5: Empowered by Purpose, Driven by Impact

As a trusted service partner and the commercial backbone of Bosch, we — Bosch Global Business Services — celebrate five incredible years of delivering high-impact service solutions that drive business excellence.

Since 2019, our journey has been one of strategic growth—fueled by innovation, operational excellence, and cross-functional collaboration. We’ve shaped new capabilities, strengthened digital foundations, and grown in deep partnership with our customers. As part of the Bosch Global Business Services (GS) organization of over 12,400 associates, supporting 300+ Bosch legal entities, GS India contributes to a global network with over 1,100 passionate colleagues in India. Our E2E structure and mindset enable seamless collaboration, agility, and efficiency—always anchored in one belief: start with the customer need and enable customer success. Our contributions to Bosch’s financial performance reinforce our belief in customer centricity, performance, and digitalization. 

As we celebrate our fifth year, we’re not just reflecting on our journey….we’re stepping boldly into the future with a deep understanding of Bosch’s evolving business landscape, customer needs, and GBS industry best practices. 

What Sets Us Apart? Our People. If there’s one thing that helps us rise to every challenge with confidence, clarity, and collective ownership, it’s our people. GS India is proud to have a passionate team that is committed to WIN—customers, competition, services, people, and digitalization.

Thank You for 5 Incredible Years. This milestone is more than a number; I believe it is a tribute to the people who made it possible. To every colleague, every leader, every customer—thank you for your trust, energy, and commitment.

As we look to the future, we continue our pursuit of excellence, powered by high performance, digital maturity, and service excellence that create real value for Bosch. We remain committed to supporting our internal customers so they can focus on what they do best: creating products and services that are Invented for life. Empowered by GS.

Here's to five remarkable years—and many more to come! We didn’t just celebrate, we showed up across locations…You can see the energy, the smiles, and the spirit that makes GS India what it is. 😄


 


 






GS India Sports League 2025 Kicks Off with Twin City Buzz!

The GS India Sports League 2025 began with a burst of energy in Coimbatore and Bangalore, promising a season full of excitement and team spirit. Coimbatore kick-started the league on July 16 with Tug of War. The event began with the traditional lighting of the lamp and cake cutting ceremony. Over 70 associates participated—including associates from other Jaipur, Nashik, Pune, Ahmedabad and other locations of GS India. GS Leaders at COB including Mr. Madhan Kumar Rajendran, Ms. Narmatha Ramesh, Ms. Shreenidhi, and Ms. Sindhu Suresh added to the energy on ground.

Bangalore followed with a spirited Volleyball event on July 17, with 143 registrations & a strong turnout. The ceremony opened with lamp lighting and a musical welcome, setting an energetic tone for the day. GS India Leaders including Mr. Krishnan N, Ms. Vanitha Chengappa, Mr. Murugappan Ramaswamy, and Mr. Rajesh Ranjan inaugurated the event. 

With a strong start in both cities and sports like Football, Cricket, TT, Chess, Throwball, and more coming up, GSL 2025 is set to be a grand showcase of sportsmanship, collaboration, and community spirit across GS India. Stay tuned!


 


 








GCC ONE Awards – GCC X Hyderabad         

We’re proud to announce that Bosch Global Software Technologies has been recognized as one of the Exemplary GCCs in AI & Analytics at the GCC ONE Awards, hosted during GCC X Hyderabad 2025 — India’s largest platform celebrating the power and potential of Global Capability Centers.

This prestigious award spotlights GCCs that are not only driving impact and transformation but also leveraging AI and data analytics to build future-ready, intelligent enterprises. Our recognition underscores the innovative work and strategic leadership demonstrated by teams at BGSW.

Amjad Khan Patan, our VP and Center Head BGSW Hyderabad, received the award on behalf of the entire BGSW family, stating:
"I am deeply honored to accept this distinguished award for our work excellence in "AI & Analytics" which has been integral part our Engineering DNA. At Bosch, we are driven by strong purpose "Invented for Life" where we see AI not just as a technology but a way to solve real world problems across Mobility, Manufacturing, Sustainability and other impacting areas. We thank HYSEA & 3AI for the recognition. It inspires us to push the boundaries of responsible and impactful AI even further. Thank You.".

 A huge thanks to all those involved in crafting the nomination and bringing this win home. Your hard work, data-driven thinking, and future-oriented approach continue to raise the bar!

Let’s celebrate this milestone as we stay committed to shaping the future with purpose and intelligence.

Check out more about the awards: GCC ONE Awards – GCC X Hyderabad <https://gccxhyderabad.com/gcc-one-awards/> 

Nasam Srinivasulu S (BGSW/PJ-MiDAS M/PJ-MiDAS), Kota Prashanth (MS/ESD-XC) & Ganesh Mahadevan Vaidyanathan (BGSW/BDO BGSW/BDO-DT)

#RiseToInspire: Exploring Automation & AI at BGSW #ManaHyderabad 

This week’s Rise to Inspire sessions spotlighted the power of automation and AI-driven solutions, showcasing how innovation can significantly enhance productivity and reduce manual effort in our workflows.

🚀 Session 1: Release Orchestrator
Led by @Rajput Rajesh (SDS/EIF2) and team, the session gave participants a deep dive into the automation of release execution, covering:

*  Triggering automation and understanding orchestration flow

*  JSON-based configuration for seamless release sequencing

*  A live demo showcasing real-time automation

*  Tangible benefits like minimized errors, reduced manual interventions, and faster deployments

💡 Session 2: AI-Powered Regulation Analysis
In an insightful session led by Swapna Vaddamaan, we explored how AI and NLP can transform the traditionally manual process of analysing automotive and non-automotive regulations. The session highlighted:

*  Challenges with manual regulation reviews and requirement extraction

*  How AI models improve accuracy, scalability, and productivity

*  Real-world use cases showcasing increased efficiency and smarter compliance

💬 Both sessions featured interactive Q&As and enthusiastic participation, reinforcing the spirit of learning and collaboration across teams.


 


 





BGSW #ManaHyderabad | Supporting the Future of Mobility Innovation

Amjad Khan Patan, VP and Location Head of BGSW #ManaHyderabad, joined esteemed leaders from Hyundai, ZF, and Automotive TG at the launch of #Charge Cohort-4 – 
a curated initiative by T-Hub under the Atal Innovation Mission in partnership with ARAI.

The launch spotlighted 22 promising mobility startups redefining the automotive and EV ecosystem in India. From AI-enabled diagnostics to next-gen EV platforms, the diversity and innovation showcased reflect the transformative future we are heading toward.

We're proud to be part of this vibrant ecosystem enabling co-creation and acceleration of emerging tech solutions in mobility. Looking forward to more such collaborations that shape the future, today.


 


 








Senseonics Inc customer visit to BGSW Healthcare

Ms. Vallikannu Somasundaram, Senior Director of Quality Sciences at Senseonics Inc, USA visited BGSW, Coimbatore location. Senseonics, a leading medical technology company, revolutionizes diabetes care with its flagship implantable Continuous Glucose Monitoring system, Eversense®, offering up to 365 days of continuous glucose monitoring.

The visit included team interaction sessions, where Ms. Valli engaged with members across functions. She appreciated the collaborative culture and expressed her gratitude for the team’s dedication and contributions toward milestone achievements. She expressed enthusiasm about the capabilities showcased and noted the strong alignment with Senseonics' goals for continuous improvement and excellence. Overall, the visit reinforced the strength of our partnership with Senseonics and highlighted the shared commitment to delivering impactful, next-generation healthcare solutions.

BGSW at Fusion AI Summit 2025

Fusion AI Summit 2025, a strategic initiative by DeepTech Naipunya Foundation and Andhra Pradesh Government was organized last week. BGSW actively took part in the event. 

Mr. Mohan B V (MS/ETI, BGSW/ETS) delivered a keynote presentation on "Decentralized AI," exploring the emerging frontier of distributed and de-centralized intelligence systems. 

Mr. Pavan M Laxmeshwar, (Head Data Intelligence) participated as an expert panelist for "Physical AI," contributing insights on challenges, breakthroughs, and real-world applications of AI and Robotics and the Physical World. Pavan also moderated a strategic fireside chat on "AI-empowered Edge-Cloud Synergy," facilitating discussions among industry leaders on real-time AI processing and intelligent decision-making frameworks; and how edge and cloud are converging to create powerful, scalable, and efficient ecosystems

Mr. Veera Reddy (BGSW/PJ-SNB-GOV) joined the thought leadership activities, contributing to the organization's visibility in the AI innovation ecosystem.

The summit provided valuable networking opportunities with AI experts, industry leaders, digital technology professionals, researchers, and academic leaders, reinforcing our organization's position in the AI landscape while exploring future collaboration opportunities.


 


 








NE-MM Leaders Meet Q2 2025

The NE-MM Leaders Meet was held last week which brought together leadership team across all Business Verticals and Horizontals, Talent family and KAM within BGSW NE-MM. The event saw active participation from supporting functions QMM, HR, IP teams, fostering a comprehensive, cross-functional dialogue. Leaders from Vietnam, Mexico, Poland, Germany team joined the session, ensuring a truly global representation. The session focused on high level updates on business and emerging market trends about BGSW Multimarket business segments.

BGSW MM participated at Quantum India Conference 2025

Quantum India Conference 2025, jointly organized by the Department of Science and Technology (DST, Govt of India) and the IISc Quantum Technology Initiative, was held in Bangalore. Mr. Bhaskara Srihari V (Technology Head at MM) and Mr. Murali Mohan (Healthcare Head at MM) participated in the conference. The event brought together a broad spectrum of stakeholders—Nobel laureates, academic experts, industry representatives, and startups on same platform.

Subject: Incidents@Bosch: Important message from G1 – in WhatsApp?
Body:
Incident @ BOSCH



 

Incidents@Bosch: Important message from G1 – in WhatsApp?

 

In a recent case, fraudsters pretended to be Managing Director Stefan Hartung via WhatsApp and tried to entice other Bosch managers to communicate externally. The fraud attempt was uncovered when the executives contacted became suspicious and reported the incident. The case impressively shows how important vigilance is when it comes to unusual communication channels.



The fraudsters used WhatsApp to contact members of the BEG and DC management, posing as Managing Director Stefan Hartung. After an initial missed call, the subsequent text messages contained instructions and a link to a video call to discuss further details regarding a confidential matter. As this did not happen, another message asked to use the private e-mail address to communicate with an unknown external e-mail address for security reasons. This seemed strange to the two managers, and they reported the incident to CERT and their ISP Office. After information and consultation with G1 secretary, it was confirmed that this was not an official number of Stefan Hartung.

Lessons Learned:

*	Unusual lines of communication: Be suspicious if you are contacted through unusual channels for business matters, especially when it comes to financial transactions or sensitive information
*	Verification is crucial: Always verify the sender's identity through official communication channels before responding to requests
*	Beware of urgency and pressure: Don't let urgency pressure you and take your time to review the request
*	Distrust of links: Avoid clicking on links or joining meetings from unknown sources
*	Trust your instincts: If something is wrong, take a moment to check it before you act

What to do with suspicious messages?

If you receive a suspicious message, please report it immediately to CERT@Bosch.com <mailto:CERT@Bosch.com>  and your ISP Office <https://rb-wam.bosch.com/my-isp/en/#/> . Don't reply to it.

Important reminder: The Board of Management will never contact you via WhatsApp or other unauthorized channels for business matters. The business use of WhatsApp is not allowed at Bosch.

Subject: Incidents@Bosch: Important message from G1 – in WhatsApp?
Body:
Incident @ BOSCH



 

Incidents@Bosch: Important message from G1 – in WhatsApp?

 

In a recent case, fraudsters pretended to be Managing Director Stefan Hartung via WhatsApp and tried to entice other Bosch managers to communicate externally. The fraud attempt was uncovered when the executives contacted became suspicious and reported the incident. The case impressively shows how important vigilance is when it comes to unusual communication channels.



The fraudsters used WhatsApp to contact members of the BEG and DC management, posing as Managing Director Stefan Hartung. After an initial missed call, the subsequent text messages contained instructions and a link to a video call to discuss further details regarding a confidential matter. As this did not happen, another message asked to use the private e-mail address to communicate with an unknown external e-mail address for security reasons. This seemed strange to the two managers, and they reported the incident to CERT and their ISP Office. After information and consultation with G1 secretary, it was confirmed that this was not an official number of Stefan Hartung.

Lessons Learned:

*	Unusual lines of communication: Be suspicious if you are contacted through unusual channels for business matters, especially when it comes to financial transactions or sensitive information
*	Verification is crucial: Always verify the sender's identity through official communication channels before responding to requests
*	Beware of urgency and pressure: Don't let urgency pressure you and take your time to review the request
*	Distrust of links: Avoid clicking on links or joining meetings from unknown sources
*	Trust your instincts: If something is wrong, take a moment to check it before you act

What to do with suspicious messages?

If you receive a suspicious message, please report it immediately to CERT@Bosch.com <mailto:CERT@Bosch.com>  and your ISP Office <https://rb-wam.bosch.com/my-isp/en/#/> . Don't reply to it.

Important reminder: The Board of Management will never contact you via WhatsApp or other unauthorized channels for business matters. The business use of WhatsApp is not allowed at Bosch.

Subject: ISP Awareness: BGSW - ISMS Policy
Body:
Dear Associates,

Good Day!

Requesting you to go through the BGSW- ISMS Policy and familiarize yourself with it.

 	
 	 	
	
	
 	
	
Our Information Security Management System provides assurance of information security to all stakeholders by addressing the following principles. 	
	
Confidentiality








Company and personal information are available to authorized persons only 



	Integrity








Information can be updated only when intended and authorized 

	
	
Availability








Information systems and data are available in accordance with service levels agreed with customers


	Privacy








The collection and storage of personal data is reduced to an absolute minimum and processed or utilized solely for the intended purpose and in compliance to the regulations

	
	
Legality








Participants in business processes and communications are identifiable, traceable and accountable in conformance with legal requirements

	Continuous improvement








With Commitment to continual improvement, we continue to improve the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the Information Security Management System

	
ProView link to the ISMS Policy <https://kor2vm0022.apac.bosch.com/stages/> 	
	
 	
 

Best regards, 

Pavan Srivatsa

Subject: ISP Awareness: BGSW - ISMS Policy
Body:
Dear Associates,

Good Day!

Requesting you to go through the BGSW- ISMS Policy and familiarize yourself with it.

 	
 	 	
	
	
 	
	
Our Information Security Management System provides assurance of information security to all stakeholders by addressing the following principles. 	
	
Confidentiality








Company and personal information are available to authorized persons only 



	Integrity








Information can be updated only when intended and authorized 

	
	
Availability








Information systems and data are available in accordance with service levels agreed with customers


	Privacy








The collection and storage of personal data is reduced to an absolute minimum and processed or utilized solely for the intended purpose and in compliance to the regulations

	
	
Legality








Participants in business processes and communications are identifiable, traceable and accountable in conformance with legal requirements

	Continuous improvement








With Commitment to continual improvement, we continue to improve the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the Information Security Management System

	
ProView link to the ISMS Policy <https://kor2vm0022.apac.bosch.com/stages/> 	
	
 	
 

Best regards, 

Antony J

Subject: Refresher ISP Awareness mail - Clear desk policy, disposal of storage media and hard copies
Body:
Dear All,

 

Here are a few pointers on clear desk policy, disposal of storage media and hard copies.

 



 

 

 

Would we leave our home open, as in the picture on the left? Of course not! Then why would we do it at work?

At Bosch sites, there are many incidents that can be traced back to non-compliance with the Clear Desk rules.

Here, we believe that a clear desk fosters clear thinking. It's not about being a genius—it's about creating an environment where focus and productivity can thrive. After all, work flows best when clutter is kept at bay.

In addition to loss of business benefits, non-compliance with the clear desk policy can result in:

*  Cybersecurity risks

*  Data security risks

*  Physical security risks

To help prevent these risks, we would like to remind you to:

*                 Secure your laptop and hardware with an anti-theft cable or even better, store them in a locker

*                 Lock IT end devices when you are away from them. 

*	Identify and store all confidential documents and data media (CSC2, CSC3, personal data) securely, ensuring they are never left unattended. 
*	Minimize hard copies and dispose them off securely using designated shredders. Collect printouts of C-SC2 or C-SC3 documents promptly from the printer to safeguard sensitive information from unauthorized exposure.
*	Erase C-SC2 and C-SC3 data on digital storage devices Irretrievably before disposal or reuse of the devices. Disposal must be carried out by the responsible department.
*	Never leave your Bosch ID card unattended, do not write any passwords on paper and do not leave any notes with passwords on your desks.
*	Never display any personally identifiable information (PII) such as personal phone numbers and personal e-mail IDs, either of self or of others, at the workstation areas.

 

 

 

If you have comments or information on this topic, please contact the ISP Partner responsible for your area.

 

For more information on storage media, refer BD storage guidelines <https://inside-docupedia.bosch.com/confluence/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=2807858543>  .

 

Security is in our common interest!

 

 

 


 

 

 

 

Best regards, 

Pavan Srivatsa

Subject: The Weekly Wrap 22nd August 2025
Body:
22nd August 2025






Honoring the Spirit of Freedom, Together @ BGSW

This Independence Day, our campuses were filled with colors, energy, and emotions that truly reflect the essence of India. With the tricolor soaring high, the occasion not only celebrated our nation’s journey but also created a bridge across generations. The echo of the National Anthem reminded us of the values that bind us together—pride, resilience, and a shared purpose.

The celebrations @ BGSW saw enthusiastic participation from our GLs, respected senior citizens from employees’ families, and the vibrant presence of children. We were privileged to be joined by esteemed guests from the armed forces across locations – Brig. Jayaraman Nambiar (Bangalore), Maj. Gen. Rajiv Krishnan (Coimbatore), Brig. Raghavendra Rao (Retd.) (Hyderabad), and Commodore Pravin Kulkarni (Retd.) (Pune).

Inspiring messages from our leaders and special guests, coupled with soulful cultural performances, made the day memorable. Body:

You can also read just the respective topics by clicking below in the topic boxes.

 

 



 



 

H B Thontesh (BMSI/COR)

	 

I am extremely happy to bring to you the second volume of the house newsletter ‘Symphony’. Our newsletter made its comeback in February, and six months on, we’re back with another edition. What began as an idea for a one-time annual report soon sparked a larger thought — why not revive the house newsletter originally launched by then BMSI Director, Mr. Lovekar Subhash. I sincerely thank all the business leaders and departments who have reposed trust in BMSI and continue to engage our consultants.

 

Happy reading ....

 

  To continue to read, click here <https://bosch-my.sharepoint.com/:b:/p/hbt3ban/EXPaMl7dAGNFtuMix3AlpHwBh2gLNjadMSZnV_pNvTGDEA> 

 

 



	 

About BMSI

BMSI provides knowledge and expertise of retired Bosch associates to support projects/need based requirements in various functional areas on temporary basis including training, coaching etc. BMSI provides this support to all Bosch entities in India. 

 

In this write up, you will get the complete process to engage BMSI consultants and the process to be followed by consultants all of which happens in an exclusive application called BeXs.

 

  To continue to read, click here <https://bosch-my.sharepoint.com/:b:/p/hbt3ban/EYJgVaYJvC9OoMSLJ56TE58B5lBEZsrleW0_5KZLTb2GqA?e=Pztj6F> 

 

 



 

Ganesh Shenoy (BMSI/COR)

 



 



                                  Shrikant Kulkarni 

	 

When I left Bosch in August 2020, I never imagined I would have the chance to be associated with the organization again. This truly reinforces the saying - ‘once a Boschler, always a Boschler.’

 

Being a metallurgist by profession, my career at Bosch Nasik involved everything around ‘materials’. My journey with BMSI began towards the end of 2020, when I supported the Jaipur Plant Metallurgical Lab for about three months, during which I was based in Jaipur. Since mid of 2024, I support PQT team at Bangalore for various raw material, supplier development activities and heat treatment/surface treatment supplier support. #ChampioningInclusion!

 

At BGSW, we wholeheartedly embrace diversity as our cornerstone, recognizing its pivotal role in our organization's strength and success. Our commitment to inclusivity extends to creating a secure and nurturing environment where every member feels empowered to share sensitive information.

 

We request you to join us in this journey by voluntarily disclosing any disabilities you may have. Your openness not only aids us in providing tailored support but also lays the foundation for a workplace where everyone can flourish and contribute to BGSW's triumphs.

 

Rest assured; any information you provide will be treated with utmost confidentiality.

29th August 2025


 






AI in Higher Education 

On 23rd August, Saravanakumar C. Shanmugam from the ETI team at BGSW delivered a keynote address on “AI in Higher Education: From Assistance to Transformation” at a workshop organized by the Association of Self-Financing Arts, Science, and Management Colleges.

In his session, he highlighted how AI is reshaping learning, research, and teaching, while underscoring the need for ethics, equity, and responsible adoption. His address encouraged participants to see AI not merely as a tool, but as a transformative partner in shaping the future of education.

The one-day, state-level workshop brought together professors, deans, and principals from various Arts, Science, and Management colleges, offering a platform for meaningful dialogue on the role of AI in academia


 


 









Wellness Initiatives in MS/ENA-MM        

In our continued commitment to fostering a culture of health and well-being, the MS/ENA-MM department proudly launched the second edition of its flagship fitness initiative, alongside several other HR programs aimed at enhancing associate well-being. This 80-day challenge (from April 1st to June 19th) was more than just a fitness program—it was a movement toward building sustainable habits, encouraging personal growth, and strengthening team spirit across our Coimbatore and Bangalore locations. With enthusiastic participation and meaningful outcomes, the challenge marked another milestone in our wellness journey.

What made this challenge truly impactful was its inclusive and flexible format. Associates were encouraged to choose activities that aligned with their personal fitness goals—be it walking, running, gym workouts, or any form of exercise. This approach empowered individuals to take ownership of their wellness journey while contributing to a collective culture of health. The challenge also fostered team bonding, healthy competition, and a renewed sense of purpose— making wellness a shared experience rather than a solitary pursuit.
