GS India Social Engagement Initiative : Spreading smiles! 

“As part of its commitment to community development, GS India recently undertook a meaningful social engagement initiative at the Government Tamil Primary School  in Bangalore. The initiative focused on enhancing the school’s environment and creating a more vibrant and educational space for its students.GS India volunteers came together to plant saplings in the school playground, contributing to a greener and more sustainable future. In addition to this, the team transformed the school walls with colorful mural art, creatively depicting educational themes such as Traffic Signals, Indian Monuments, Alphabets, and Indian Geography. These murals not only beautify the space but also serve as engaging learning tools for the children. The day was made even more special as volunteers had the opportunity to interact with students and teachers, sharing stories, smiles, and heartfelt moments. The team expressed their gratitude for the warm welcome and cherished the chance to contribute to the school’s growth and spirit. This initiative stands as a testament to GS India’s dedication to social responsibility and its belief in the power of collective action to make a lasting impact. By the end of the day, the volunteers were filled with joy and fulfillment, knowing that their efforts had become a small yet meaningful reason behind the smiles of these children.”


 


 






Software Cluster Charts the Path Ahead

The Software Cluster (SWC) leadership, alongside SWC HRBPs, convened on August 19th and 20th for a two-day workshop aimed at shaping the future direction of both people-centered and business-driven strategies for the newly formed SWC organization.

Julius Panakkal Francis, Head of MS/ENG-SWC, outlined the SWC’s vision for value growth and transformation. A standout moment was the address by Jacob Peter Kidangath, Head - MS/ESH who emphasized the significance of horizontal organizations in shaping the future of Mobility. These addresses set the tone for the workshop and energized the SWC Leadership Team.

The SWC NOVA Workshop (New, Opportunities, Vision, and Alignment) centered on defining processes for SWC across Operating Model, Business Strategy, Competency Development, Communication, and Associate Engagement. Leaders and HRBPs collaborated to co-create a roadmap aimed at driving alignment, unlocking opportunities, and ensuring seamless execution.

The workshop concluded with a strong sense of collaboration, energy, and purpose. By the end of the two days, the SWC team emerged motivated and ready to lead SWC toward sustained success.


 


 






CSR Initiative at MS/EPJ-PS: Empowering Underprivileged Children through Art, Craft, and Plantation Activities

As part of our ongoing commitment to social responsibility, EPJ-PS along with Bosch India foundation recently organized a meaningful CSR activity at government school in Kolagi, Shikaripura, Shivamogga district, Karnataka on 22/08/2025, catering to underprivileged children. 

The initiative focused on nurturing creativity and environmental awareness among the young minds, around 80 students participated and benefitted from this art and craft camp.

Children enthusiastically participated in art and craft sessions, allowing them to express their creativity and build confidence. 

Alongside, a plantation drive was conducted with the help of forest department to instill the importance of nature conservation and environmental stewardship from an early age.

This activity not only brought joy and learning to the children but also aimed at fostering a sense of community, responsibility, and holistic development.

We believe that small steps like these can make a big difference in empowering the future generation.


 


 








BGSW #ManaHyderabad Hosts Business Acumen Session          

On August 19, BGSW #ManaHyderabad hosted a successful Business Acumen & Organizational Awareness Session for 60 associates. This session provided critical insights into corporate finance and strategic decision-making, covering key topics like financial metrics (EBIT, TP, CAGR, Cashflow) and the BGSW & Bosch business models.

A huge thank you to Shakya Reshma (BGSW/CTG1) and Rohit Vishnuthirtha Y S (BGSW/CTG2) who traveled from Bangalore to lead this impactful session. We also appreciate the seamless coordination by Nagendra Prasad Mandaloju (MS/EED22-PS) and Bhongiri Srikanth (MS/EHM-PD3).

Due to the enthusiastic participation, we are excited to announce a third session scheduled for Q4-2025. Stay tuned for more opportunities to grow and excel!

#TribePune | Celebrating Ganesh Chaturthi with Creativity & Joy 

This year too, just like every year, we celebrated the spirit of Ganesh Chaturthi with our Ganesh idol-making workshop in Pune. Over 100 associates came together, rolling up their sleeves to craft their own eco-friendly idols from scratch. And the best part? Each associate got to take home their handcrafted idol—making the celebration even more personal and memorable. Here are some beautiful glimpses from the day!


 


 





#TribePune | BGSW Recognized as Strategic Partner at PMI Pune’s 20-Year Celebration 

Recently, our team had the honor of representing BGSW at the 20-year celebration of the PMI Pune-Deccan India Chapter—a milestone that brought together emerging project managers, industry leaders, and past and present board members to commemorate PMI Pune’s remarkable journey from its ideation in 2003, formal incubation in 2005, to its growth into a thriving professional community.

BGSW was proudly recognized as a Strategic Regional Partner, with Keerthana Karthikeyan (MS/EPA-PJ2-PS) and Ramesh Palaniappan (BGSW/PJ-ESO1-PUN) representing us at the event. As part of this recognition, they were felicitated with the Pillar of Progress memento, celebrating Bosch’s contributions to project management excellence and ecosystem engagement—a moment of pride for all of us at BGSW.

In a strategic dialogue with Mr. Rinoo Rajesh, President of PMI Pune Chapter, we shared our IOEM-centric vision and scaling the AUTO SIG through ADAS validation, Automotive Industry trends, regulatory foresight session, and mentorship. With this SIGs last event on SDV trends held in October, we emphasized energizing the SIG in current year to position Pune as a hub for automotive project leadership.

We also explored opportunities to strengthen PMI’s Women’s League, focusing on deeper engagement and leadership pathways for women professionals within Pune’s PM ecosystem. These ideas were warmly received, paving the way for continued collaboration through SIG councils and forums.

A special thanks to our COP-PM community, led by Keerthana, for driving these engagements and sustaining meaningful collaboration with PMI Pune.


 


 








#TribePune | Turning Risks into Opportunities – Key Takeaways from REX Session

As part of COP_PM Pune’s learning initiatives, we had an insightful REX session by Prabhakaran S (MS/EBV-VM) on how risks should be perceived.

He highlighted that risks are not always negative — if identified early, they can be turned into opportunities. Drawing from his own projects, he shared how risk-to-opportunity conversions brought significant benefits.

Key takeaways included:

• View risks from a higher-level perspective.

• Involve the team in risk management to build trust and collaboration.

• Use tools like risk workshops and repositories for effective handling.

Over 30 colleagues joined via Teams and offered great learning on making risk management a success driver.

ACTIVE CAMPUS – CROCHETING

On 21st August 2025, Active Campus at Bangalore came alive with creativity as nearly 100 associates gathered to explore the intricate art of crocheting.

The engaging session was led by Mahalakshmi Talakadu Hanumanthe Gowda (MS/EAC1-XC), who guided participants through the basics of crochet patterns, weaving techniques, and tips to bring designs to life. What began as a simple thread-and-hook activity soon transformed into a vibrant display of patience, focus, and artistic expression.

The atmosphere was buzzing with enthusiasm as participants, both beginners and enthusiasts alike, worked on their stitches, exchanged ideas, and discovered a new skill that combined mindfulness with creativity.

Active Campus continues to be a unique platform at BGSW where associates come together to learn, upskill, and connect through engaging activities beyond their daily work routines. This crocheting workshop was another step towards encouraging associates to explore their hidden talents and nurture a spirit of continuous learning.

“Every stitch tells a story – and on this day, BGSW associates stitched together creativity, collaboration, and joy.


 


 





ACTIVE CAMPUS – TEXTURE ART 

The spirit of creativity and learning thrived at Active Campus Coimbatore on 21st August 2025, where associates came together for an inspiring Texture Art Workshop.

The session was led by Nithya Rajeswari Ramakrishnan (BD/SWD-TMA6), who introduced participants to the fascinating world of texture techniques, blending imagination with hands-on practice. With 66 enthusiastic associates in attendance, the workshop became a platform for self-expression, mindfulness, and upskilling.

From exploring different materials to creating unique surface effects, participants immersed themselves in the joy of learning a new skill, while also rediscovering the power of patience and creativity.

Active Campus continues to be a hub where associates across BGSW gather to learn, connect, and upskill—fostering not just talent, but also collaboration and community.

“Every stroke of texture opened a new dimension of creativity for our associates.”

Subject: Physical Verification of Fixed Assets at BGSW

 



Dear everyone,

 

As part of strengthening the controls and governance at BGSW, Physical Verification of Fixed Assets (IT and non-IT) would commence from September 2, 2025. We would provide coverage to all BGSW locations in India (Bengaluru, Coimbatore, Hyderabad, and Pune). It will be carried out by external consultants: PwC and Matrix.

 

What is required from you:

*	Ensure assets assigned to you (such as laptops, desktops, peripherals, furniture, etc.) are available and accessible during the verification period.
*	Cooperate with the verification team when they visit your workstation/department.

 

Your support and cooperation are essential to complete this activity smoothly. 

 

Should you have any questions, please reach out to Madhava.Shenoy@in.bosch.com <mailto:Madhava.Shenoy@in.bosch.com>  who would be driving this initiative from BGSW/ICS supported by BGSW/LOG. Thank you for your assistance in ensuring the accuracy of our asset records.

Subject: Apply for Citibank Corporate Credit Card: Important for Business Travels!
Body:
Dear Colleagues,

To ensure seamless business travels and to align with standards towards bTravel system roll-out in Q2 2026, it is mandatory to apply for the Citi Credit Card which will be the desired mode of payments for all domestic and international business travels.

All active On-Roll Associates are eligible to apply for the Citi Corporate Credit Card as deemed fit.
Whether you have travel plans or not, please apply as this will be required for your future use.

*	To access the Citi Credit Card Application Process Guide – Click Here <https://connect.bosch.com/communities/service/html/communityview?communityUuid=3ac351e7-0ab7-4927-b9d3-2af69fcd6b98> 
*	To access the FAQ’s and Best Practices Guide – Click Here <https://connect.bosch.com/files/app/s/7M5G7RLGjDtZrqbOKNwbfD7DW18d> 
*	For queries or clarifications, please email to BoschIN.CitiCreditcardSupport@in.bosch.com <mailto:BoschIN.CitiCreditcardSupport@in.bosch.com> 
*	If you have already applied or hold an active Citi credit card, then please do not re-apply.

Subject: ISP-Awareness | New Look, Same Power – New “Report” Button
Body:
Dear All,

Starting August 25th, a new button is available in the Outlook toolbar - Microsoft’s integrated “Report” button, which replaces the “Report Spam” button.





The new Report button offers two options, namely, ‘Report Phishing’ and ‘Report Junk’ options - Report Phishing is for suspicious or malicious mails that can cause harm to Bosch. Report Junk is for annoying junk emails.

 

Note: The rollout being in progress, the Report button may still not be available to some associates. Also, there is an overlap period in which both the Report and Report Spam buttons would be visible to the associates, but it is recommended to use the Report button only.

For more details and updates, please refer to the Docupedia page <https://inside-docupedia.bosch.com/confluence/display/OSKB/Microsoft+Report+Button> . 

One Security Community blog reference : Link <https://connect.bosch.com/blogs/faf822b7-a9df-4e6f-a868-59b6eece2471/entry/New_Report_Button?lang=en_us>

Dear Interns,

 

This is a reminder that the selection process for the SAP C4C Sales Cloud (L1/L2) role will take place on Monday.

All candidates are expected to begin their preparation immediately.

 

Please focus your efforts on:

*	Core concepts of SAP C4C Sales Cloud
*	Common L1/L2 support scenarios and resolutions
*	Communication skills and handling client queries
*	User creations

 

Ensure you are well-prepared, as this is a key opportunity to advance into a specialized role.

Further details (timing, format, etc.) will be shared soon. Stay tuned and prepare thoroughly.

 

Best regards,
Ravi Kumar Mocharla

Subject: The Weekly Wrap 12th September 2025
Body:
12th September 2025


 






BGSW successfully completes second surveillance audit of ISO/IEC 27001:2022

We are pleased to announce the successful completion of the 2nd surveillance audit for ISO/IEC 27001:2022, which took place at four different sites of BGSW: COB-SEZIL, Pune, EC-360, and KOR.

Between August 18th and August 29th, the external agency Bureau Veritas (BVI) conducted a total of 14 project audits and 12 process audits. The project and process teams at all four sites effectively demonstrated their scope of activity and how Information Security and Data Protection aspects are seamlessly integrated into their projects. This was met with positive feedback and appreciation from the auditors.

We are proud to report that there were no minor or major non-conformities (NCs) identified during the audit, except for a couple of Opportunities for Improvement (OFIs). These OFIs are valuable insights that will drive our continuous improvement efforts.

Our kudos to all the participants involved in the surveillance audit for their thorough preparation and provision of relevant information and artifacts for the audits, which was ably supported by the respective ISP Partners.


 


 






The BGSW Adugodi location has successfully completed its TISAX assessment and been awarded the TISAX label

The ISP Office is pleased to share that the BGSW Adugodi location has successfully completed its TISAX assessment and has been awarded the TISAX label, valid until August 2028. This achievement marks a significant milestone in ensuring business continuity for ongoing projects in the Mobility Solutions (MS) area.

The assessment was conducted by DNV, the agency identified by C/ISP, on September 2nd, 2025, and focused on the following key areas for buildings 601 and 602:

*      Information Security

*      Data Protection

*      Prototype Protection

The evaluation witnessed active participation from stakeholders across multiple domains, including Lab Infrastructure, Information Security Office, Cybersecurity Office, Physical Security Office, Lab Owners, BD in India, and C/ISP. Their collaborative efforts demonstrated a robust and integrated approach to safeguarding both confidential and sensitive information of OEMs and ensuring secure handling of prototypes.

We are proud to report that the overall assessment status is ‘Conform’, with a few Opportunities for Improvement (OFIs) identified. These OFIs are constructive recommendations that will be incorporated into our continual improvement initiatives.

We extend our sincere appreciation to everyone involved in this accomplishment. Their dedication and teamwork have played a vital role in achieving this important certification.


 


 









BGSW Multimarket Healthcare Thought Leadership         

BGSW Multimarket Healthcare Paper Titled “Computational-Efficient Morphology Zone search in Peripheral Blood Smear for Identification of Atypical Blood Cell Morphologies” is published in 2025 IEEE Applied Sensing Conference (APSCON) Proceedings, now available in IEEE. This article is based on the core suite of edge algorithms in Vivalution, AI-powered Digital Pathology Solution. 

Authors: Yogeswarr Sathish, Sree Niranjanaa Bose, Aarthi Sathya Narayanan, Shivani Parayil, Bharathi Kannan Natarajan, Varalakshmi Perumal, Shefali Karve Hemanth, Murali Mohan

 <https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/11144419/authors#authors> Read More

BGSW Multimarket Home Comfort Thought Leadership 

BGSW Multimarket team’s whitepaper on leveraging Red Teaming principles in HVAC systems has been published. The paper talks about the implementation of Red Teaming to identify security flaws early in code, architecture, and deployment pipelines.

 <https://www.bosch-softwaretechnologies.com/media/documents/downloads/ai_and_bigdata/red_teaming-generativeai_guide_hc-gb_v2-0.pdf> Read More


 


 






AI with Purpose - Women Leading the Shift by WiL FIT.KovAI

BGSW Coimbatore lit up with ideas, inspiration & impact at WiL.AI Day 2025, a celebration of FIT.KovAI WiL (Women in Leadership) leading the AI revolution.  With the theme “AI with Purpose: Women Leading the Shift”, the day spotlighted innovation, leadership & inclusivity.

FIT.Kovai’s WiL Team had privilege to host three seasoned leaders – Mahima (Sr. Director & Site Leader, Blue Yonder), Sujana Arul Selvi Alaguraj (Vice President & Head Of Enterprise Architecture, Thought Works) & Abinaya Mahendiran (CTO, Nunnari Labs)  who shared their insights on shaping the future of AI. 

The day kicked off with a vibrant Marketplace: Hackathon journeys, Product.AI showcases & GenAI use cases already reshaping work at Bosch. The vision for WiL.AI Day was shaped & championed by Naved Narayan, VP , Center Head -Coimbatore who believes that amplifying women’s voices in AI would not only bring visibility to the talent already shaping our future, but also unlock new perspectives and drive inclusive innovation. This set the perfect tone for what followed: a day of purposeful conversations, bold ideas, and inclusive leadership.

Leadership address by Girish Murahari, VP - BEG, highlighted how women long-known for their creativity should take a leading role in adopting AI. He emphasized inclusive innovation, reminding us that technology thrives when diverse perspectives shape its future.

Then came the voices that mattered most - Keynote address by Mahima who showed us how AI is rewriting supply chains, not just with efficiency but with trust, inclusivity, and resilience. Her story of embracing change and growth was a reminder that true leadership is about being open, adaptable, and bold followed by another keynote address by Sujana Arul Selvi Alaguraj who brought history’s quiet revolutionaries into the room & beautifully articulated with great examples on Women from different decades and how they have created a revolutionary change in technology & culture. She also did highlight on the current gap which exists – Only ~22% of AI professionals are Women. Sujana’s session had a high impact & ended with silence in room with Thought provoking messages. 

Another highlight of the day was the Panel “Navigating the AI Hype Cycle – What Matters for Business and Society?”

Abinaya Mahendiran (CTO, Nunnari Labs), visionary CTO, urged us to look beyond trends and deliver tangible, high-impact AI solutions.  Panakkal Julius F (Sr. Program Director, BGSW), the strategic powerhouse, emphasized responsible AI adoption that balances innovation with measurable business value. Renju Kuriakose (Program Manager, AI & Databases, BGSW), our analytical innovator, showcased how data-driven AI implementation can be efficient, inclusive, and ethical. The panel was moderated by Srinivas Karatholuvu Chandrasekaran (Expert, Cross Domain Computing), who facilitated a lively and informative discussion, bringing out diverse perspectives and actionable insights. Together with Mahima and Sujana, the panel reminded everyone that AI’s true power lies in purpose, precision, and people.

And it was not all talks, creativity stole the show with the “AI vs Human” performance, enacting how AI can amplify rather than replace human ingenuity. 

Adding to the vibrancy, the “1-Minute Productivity Hacks” Infographic Contest encouraged bite-sized tips for daily efficiency-proving tiny changes can spark big impact.

Takeaway: WiL.AI Day wasn’t just an event - It was a call to action: lead boldly, innovate responsibly & shape an AI future that amplifies humanity.

Here’s to more women in AI. More purposeful leadership. More impact.


 


 





ETI at GenAI Day 2025 by ETAS

On 9th September, Saravanakumar C. Shanmugam from the ETI team at BGSW delivered a keynote address at “GenAI Day 2025”, organized by ETAS at COB–GTP. The flagship event was dedicated to exploring the transformative impact of Generative AI and emerging technologies. In his keynote, Saravanakumar shared insights and a forward-looking vision on the future of Generative AI


 


 





#TribePune | Deloitte – NASSCOM Roundtable: Navigating Workplace Shifts in the Age of Generative AI

Ramesh Palaniappan (BGSW/PJ-ESO1-PUN) and Prakash Anil (BGSW/PJ-ESO3-PUN) represented us at the recent Deloitte – NASSCOM roundtable, which focused on the transformative impact of Generative AI and exponential technologies on the workplace.

The discussion highlighted key themes shaping the future of work and technology delivery models:

*   AI’s transformative impact: How AI is reshaping solution delivery from manual processes to intelligent, adaptive models.

*   Current vs. future delivery models: The transition from linear approaches to agile, pod-based implementations.

*   Automation in lifecycle: How automation is streamlining critical tasks like data migration, enabling speed and scalability.

*   Staying future-ready: Strategies for organizations and professionals to remain relevant and resilient amid AI-driven change.

This roundtable brought together industry leaders to exchange insights on workforce upskilling, technology implementation, and the evolving workplace landscape in the era of generative AI.


 


 








🌍 BGSW #ManaHyderabad at the 9th ET Edge GCC Summit 2025         

We’re proud to share that our Center Head, Amjad Khan Patan, represented BGSW at the 9th Edition of the ET Edge GCC Summit 2025, presented by Quess Corp Limited.

In his talk, Amjad highlighted the pivotal role of Global Capability Centers (GCCs) as the heart and engine of global enterprises, evolving from volume to value and from scale to strategy. He emphasized the importance of innovation that addresses local needs while thinking globally, and how teams must approach their work with a global mindset from day one.

He also shared how Bosch fosters rapid experimentation to tackle real-time challenges, building scalable and impactful solutions that ensure GCCs continue to deliver strategic value across markets.

👏 Kudos to Amjad for championing the vision of innovation-driven growth and positioning BGSW at the forefront of shaping the future of GCCs!

360 Pixtures: Monsoon Wildlife Photography expedition to Kabini 

This On 6th September, 28 enthusiastic Boschlers from the 360 Pixtures community set out at the crack of dawn for a monsoon wildlife expedition to the Kabini forest. The safari unfolded through misty trails and lush greenery, where participants witnessed animals in their natural element.

From herds of elephants strolling gracefully to the powerful Indian gaur, vibrant peacocks dancing in the drizzle, spotted deer blending into the thickets, and mischievous langurs leaping between branches—every sight offered a perfect capture. Cameras clicked, but often the group paused simply to soak in the raw beauty of the wild.

It was an experience that combined adventure, photography, and nature at its best. The community returned with unforgettable frames and a unanimous thought—this is a must-do again!


 


 






BGSW #ManaHyderabad Volunteering – Inclusive Cricket with Children 🤝

On 4th September, associates from BGSW #ManaHyderabad volunteered under the project “Development and Translation of Digital Content for Hearing-Impaired Students” in partnership with Ashray Akruti. This long-term initiative focuses on making education accessible, inclusive, and impactful for students with hearing impairment.

🔹 About the Project

The project aims to create educational videos in Indian Sign Language (ISL) across core subjects such as Mathematics, Science, and Social Studies, while also translating content into local languages like Marathi. Alongside content creation, the project is building a robust Learning Management System (LMS), setting up digital infrastructure in schools, and providing teacher training & empowerment. With a goal of reaching nearly 9,000 students across 4 states, this initiative ensures equitable education and better learning outcomes.

Key impact indicators include:

Wider access to inclusive digital content for students with hearing impairment

Increased engagement between teachers, students, and parents

Standardized materials and infrastructure to support deaf schools across India

🔹 Volunteer Engagement

As part of this initiative, 11 Boschlers spent a meaningful afternoon with 25 children with hearing impairment, engaging in an inclusive game of cricket. Beyond fun and play, the activity offered associates valuable sensitization to the PWD space, helping them understand the challenges and strengths of differently-abled students.

The day ended with a shared lunch, fostering warm interactions and creating lasting memories for both associates and the children. Together, volunteers contributed 3 hours of engagement, strengthening the project’s commitment to inclusion and empathy.

✨ With many more volunteering activities planned under this initiative, Bosch associates continue to play an active role in driving inclusive education and community impact.

Subject: Badminton Mela - Season 2
Body:
Dear Participants,

Team Shuttlers is pleased to inform you that we have received an overwhelming number of registrations for Badminton Mela Season 2. 
Please note that registration is now closed.
All participants, including those registered as a group or individually, are required to report to the venue tomorrow by 9:30 AM sharp. 
Matches will commence promptly at 10:00 AM.

Individual participants will be assigned to a team by the committee on the day of the event. Therefore, your punctuality is essential.

The tournament schedule and fixtures will be provided on the day of the event. 
We kindly request all participants to review the rules (as outlined in the shared PPT) before the start of the matches.

Please note the following:

1.	A limited number of rackets and non-marking shoes are available for rent at your own expense. 
	We encourage you to bring your own equipment if possible.
	Playing barefoot is also allowed. 
2.	Refreshments will be provided.
3.	Please ensure you carry your ID cards.

We look forward to seeing you at the tournament.

Date : Saturday 13th September.

Location : Sportygen Badminton Arena

DP Road, Medipoint road, Terraza Rd, Opposite to Indian Bank, Near Terraza Society, Aundh, Pune, Maharashtra 411007

Subject: The Weekly Wrap 5th September 2025
Body:
05th September 2025


 






CFO STRATECH SUMMIT 2025

We are delighted to share that Kaushik has been awarded the prestigious “Finance Leader Shaping the Future”: 

A recognition—that celebrates only the most forward-thinking leaders redefining the global finance landscape.

This prestigious award celebrates his visionary leadership, AI-first approach and ability to transform finance into a true strategic partner and a value driver at BGSW.

A proud moment that reflects not just achievement—but a commitment to shaping the future of finance leadership at Bosch.


 


 





CIO of the Year 2025         

The 9th Edition of the CIO Conclave & Awards 2025, organized by UBS Forum in Bengaluru on 21st August, recognized Ganesh Mahadevan as CIO of the Year 2025. He earned this prestigious honor for pioneering AI-driven use cases across CIA for Finance, ACCM, and AgentRed, competing with top CIOs from Healthcare, ITES, and Energy. Ganesh also joined an elite panel on “Secret of Success: Cost Effective IT Strategies” alongside leaders including Kamesh Babu R (CISO, Subex), Sudip Dey (CIO, Aster Healthcare), Vikram Balakrishna (CTO, Atos), and Shuvankar Pramanick (Senior Director, Manipal Health Enterprises).


 


 






Driving Excellence: GS India Honored with Silver at CII IQ National Excellence Practice 2025

“Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) Institute of Quality is the leading authority in Quality Enhancement among organizations and industries. Over the past century, CII has provided Indian Industries with the support, systems, and tools to make a mark in the competitive world. It is realized that the best way to enhance an organization’s competitiveness is through the quality route. The 13th CII IQ National Excellence Practice Competition 2025 was recently held, and we are proud to share that GS India earned the silver recognition in the Customer Experience category for the topic ‘Enhancing Customer Experience through Business Relationship Management (BRM)’. The BRM network represents a group of passionate and proactive leaders who serve as the first point of contact for all GS India customers in India. Established to give customers a recognizable face of GS India, the network acts as a trusted bridge connecting customers with the right experts within our teams. Over the last three years, this initiative has become a true customer favorite, fostering trust, transparency, and delight through a proactive and people-centric approach. It stands as a shining example of what customer centricity looks like in action. This recognition was made possible by the outstanding efforts of Rajesh Ranjan (GS/CTG-IN), Naik Suresh (GS/PUI74), and Murugappan Ramaswamy (GS/OSP-SP16, GS/OSP-SP17), proud members of the BRM network. Congratulations to the entire team for this achievement and for continuing to set benchmarks in creating meaningful customer experiences.”


 


 





BGSW Multimarket Engagements at BAN & COB locations          

BGSW Multimarket team gathered for townhalls at Bangalore and Coimbatore. It was engaging and interactive sessions with the MM associates on topics of MM business scenarios and updates. The cherry on the top was to see an overwhelming participation across. 

“Munch Talks with Guru” – forum for the young and key talent at MM to have discussion was initiated. The platform provided them to discuss on various topics.

Furthermore, updates from various locations will be coming soon.


 


 









Celebrating VM’s Wins at AIspire Day 2025         

The AIspire Day was recently held at BGSW with the objective of inspiring growth through AI. The event featured experience zones, keynote sessions, challenges, a hackathon, awards, and celebrated AI Champions. Congratulations to the VM associates who were recognized as AI Champions and Hackathon Runners-Up. 

Congratulations to the AI Champions Desai Harish (MS/EBB3-VM) for pioneering Copilot adoption, Vignesh Natarajan (MS/ESY9-VM) for leading MiDAS use case development within TDA-ST, and Subrahmanyam Gampala (MS/EBG-VM) for driving the GenAI initiative at VM as an early adopter.. 

3 VM India teams emerged as Runners-Up. Team Chatapata: Dineshkumar Perumal (MS/EBN34-VM); Raj Prithiv Nanthan Selvarajan (MS/EBN34-VM); Nandha Kumar M (MS/EBI21-VM); Girish Narasimhaiah (MS/EMT3-VM); Thota Ganesh (MS/EBN34-VM).  Team Neutrons: Yuvaraj Kandasamy (MS/ESV21-VM); Stanly Christoper Dhanabalan (MS/ESV11-VM); Vardhani Shree K (MS/ESV21-VM); Iswarya M (MS/ESV11-VM); Dayananda Suresha (MS/EMT2-VM). Team Visionary Vectors : Nithish Harikrishnan (MS/EBN31-VM); Aswathi G R (MS/EBN31-VM) @Immanuel Raja Karuppiah (MS/EBN31-VM); Pradeep M (MS/EBN32-VM); Girish Narasimhaiah (MS/EMT3-VM).  Read More <https://connect.bosch.com/blogs/978a83a6-7a0d-4e55-a0af-6bd1da6376a8/entry/Celebrating_VM_s_Wins_at_AIspire_Day_2025?lang=en_us> 

Redefining Human-Centric Benchmarking through Human2Bench

Human2Bench is an interactive tool that enhances efficiency by converting human test inputs into automated CAPL scripts. It simplifies test case creation, minimizes errors, and automates data retrieval from Excel. With its user-friendly design, it boosts productivity, consistency, and maintainability across teams and testing workflows.

At Automation Day 2025, this tool concept was first introduced and recognized significantly last year. Initially designed to streamline CAPL script generation and improve automation efficiency, it has now taken a major step forward with AI integration. This year, the team showcased the H2B AI Agent prototype, an AI-powered extension that enhances test case and test script generation for Bench Testing. The demo received strong interest, as attendees saw the potential of AI in reducing manual effort, improving accuracy, and making automation more adaptive  <https://connect.bosch.com/blogs/978a83a6-7a0d-4e55-a0af-6bd1da6376a8/entry/Human2Bench_by_VN_Steering?lang=en_us> Read More.


 


 





SmartLab – Powering Global Lab Digitization         

SmartLab is Bosch’s global lab digitization platform that streamlines booking, diagnostics, inventory, budgeting, and reporting. By leveraging automation, real-time insights, and traceability, it boosts efficiency, reduces costs, and enhances collaboration. This empowers teams worldwide to make data-driven decisions and optimize lab operations. 

SmartLab streamlines every aspect of lab interaction — from reserving test systems and automated usage tracking to diagnostics and accessing them remotely without manual intervention. It eliminates scheduling conflicts, improves resource visibility, and ensures optimal usage of infrastructure. With automated usage tracking and detailed insights, project users can justify time spent, plan better, and avoid redundant investments. The platform keeps lab activities organized and audit-ready, maintaining traceability across users and systems. Read more <https://connect.bosch.com/blogs/978a83a6-7a0d-4e55-a0af-6bd1da6376a8/entry/SmartLab_Powering_Global_Lab_Digitization?lang=en_us> .


 


 

Shakti Welfare Trust @ BGSW - Boschlers Unite to Support their Own! 

 






 


 






BGSW #ManaHyderabad at Navigyaan – Shaping the Future of Mobility

We’re proud to share that Ravi Madan N, Technical Director (MS/EED-PS), BGSW #ManaHyderabad, addressed the Navigyaan event series organized by ARAI-AMTIF at T-Hub, Hyderabad, on 3rd September 2025.

In his session, Ravi highlighted the future of mobility with a focus on powertrain technologies, sharing insights on ongoing developments in Internal Combustion Engines (ICE) for EU7 and the promising role of Hydrogen Engines (H2).

The event brought together a vibrant audience of start-ups, engineering students, and industry professionals, creating an engaging platform for learning, exchange of ideas, and collaboration. Ravi’s session not only sparked thought-provoking discussions but also inspired young innovators to explore sustainable and future-ready mobility solutions.

This engagement reflects Bosch’s active role in shaping industry conversations and empowering the next generation of changemakers in the mobility ecosystem.


 


 








BGSW #ManaHyderabad Center Head Amjad Khan Patan Shares Insights with Analytics India Magazine         

We’re proud to share that our Center Head, Amjad Khan Patan, recently spoke with Analytics India Magazine on how Hyderabad is fast emerging as a powerhouse for innovation and why Bosch Global Software Technologies is at the forefront of this transformation.

In the feature, Amjad highlighted BGSW’s pivotal role in driving the future of automotive innovation, powered by our strong engineering DNA, deep expertise in AI & Analytics, and our commitment to building sustainable, future-ready solutions from Hyderabad for the world.

📖 Read the full article here:  <https://analyticsindiamag.com/gcc/bosch-global-builds-the-future-of-automotive-innovation-in-hyderabad/?utm_source=chatgpt.com> Bosch Global builds the future of automotive innovation in Hyderabad

BGSW #ManaHyderabad at VNR VJIET: Bridging the Gap Between Academia and Industry 

our BGSW #ManaHyderabad team had a productive meeting with the leadership, Industry Cell, and HODs at the VNR VJIET Campus.

Celebrating the Unsung Heroes: FCM, Security, and Support Staff at BGSW #ManaHyderabad

On our 78th Independence Day, we proudly took a moment to honor the invaluable contributions of our Facility Management (FCM), Security, and Support Staff — the true unsung heroes of our workplace.

Working tirelessly behind the scenes, these teams ensure a safe, clean, and efficient environment for all of us, often without seeking recognition. To celebrate their dedication, the event began with a heartfelt video showcasing the vital role they play in keeping our organization running seamlessly. The video also featured warm and genuine messages from associates, expressing gratitude for their relentless efforts — a moment that was met with resounding applause and heartfelt appreciation.

By shining a spotlight on their contributions, we not only recognized their hard work but also reinforced our culture of appreciation, inclusivity, and respect. Unlocking Human Potential: Breathing Techniques, Anatomy Trivia, and Physical Fitness Insights at EPJ-PS!

Breathe in… Stress Out…

“Start where you are. Use what you have. Do what you can.” - Arthur Ashe

Long working hours can take a serious toll on both our mental and physical well-being. Often, we don’t even know where to start when it comes to taking care of our health. Caught up in busy schedules, we tend to neglect ourselves.

A simple yet powerful way to begin is by practicing breathing exercises for just 10 minutes a day. While it might seem basic, breathing exercises offer a wealth of hidden benefits. They not only enhance physical health but also improve mental well-being.

Regular breathing exercises help reduce stress, lower blood pressure, and support managing anxiety, depression, and insomnia. Despite busy schedules, incorporating even small physical activities—sometimes while working—can make a meaningful difference.

These benefits lead to increased focus, better work performance, and a more positive outlook on life.

To share this knowledge, a brief session was conducted to explore different types of breathing techniques, their benefits, and the correct methods to practice them effectively.

Subject: ISP Awareness: Stay Vigilant! - Simple Human Error Can Cause Major Breaches
Body:
Dear All,

 

A couple of months ago, we looked at a Social Engineering incident, which involved face to face conversation between the attacker and the victim. Such an incident can occur at a larger scale also, which is the content of this awareness mail. Please be informed about such incidents, to become more vigilant. 

 

 <https://vmsbgswprodstorage.blob.core.windows.net/vms/Logo/footer.png?sv=2021-10-04&st=2025-08-25T10%3A59%3A51Z&se=2025-09-24T10%3A59%3A51Z&sr=c&sp=r&sig=XJVB56ZkWL91box4ROs%2Bq7twraP35vsSKE02Vc8%2BzlI%3D> 

The extent of damage caused by a cyberattack by a hacking group can be shocking, as seen from an incident in the second half of 2023 (published in NBC news). A product development company has filed a lawsuit against its IT Provider, alleging that gross negligence on the part of the IT Provider led to the cyberattack. They claimed that the hackers pulled off the intrusion simply by asking the IT Provider’s staff for employees’ passwords, which the IT Provider’s staff provided without verification. This indicates that the IT Provider was not duped by any sophisticated hacking techniques, but rather by basic Social Engineering. Partial transcripts included in the lawsuit reportedly show the IT Provider’s support staff resetting and providing passwords to the hackers without verifying their identity, for example, by asking them for employee ID numbers or manager names.



The 2023 hack caused an estimated $380 million in damages for the product development company, of which $50 million were attributed to remedial costs and the remaining $330 million to the inability of the company to ship products to retailers. The company further alleged that other failures of the IT Provider, including failure to de-activate certain accounts or properly restore data, hindered the cleanup efforts by the company. 

To protect yourself and our company:

*	Always verify: If you receive an unexpected request for credentials, even if it seems to be from an IT personnel or a manager, verify the request through a trusted, separate channel (e.g., call them back at a known number).
*	Do not share: Never share your passwords or MFA (Multi-factor Authentication) codes with anyone, ever.
*	Report suspicious activity: If a request feels "off" or makes you feel pressured, report it to the ISP Partner immediately. Trust your instincts.

The key takeaway: Your vigilance is our best defense.

Thank you for your commitment to keeping our company secure.



 

Best regards,

Subject: Opportunities in Product Engineering Team & Role Briefing Call
Body:
*Please Do not forward*

 

Dear Apprentices,

 

We are excited to inform you about upcoming opportunities within the Product Engineering team. 

 

Upon successful completion of your apprenticeship program, there is a possibility of conversion for full-time role in this team, based on business demand and your performance during the program.

 

To prepare you for this potential path, we would like to highlight some fundamental electronics topics that are essential for the Product Engineering role:

 

1.	Resistors, Capacitors, Inductors - Basic characteristics, fundamental usage, and series & parallel circuit topologies using R, L, C.
2.	Diode - Basic characteristics, types, and applications.
3.	Transistors (BJT, MOSFET) - Types, basic characteristics, and fundamental uses.
4.	Operational Amplifiers - Ideal op-amp characteristics and basic application circuits.
5.	Filters (High-pass, Low-pass) - Characteristics and behavior.
6.	Digital Electronics - Logic gates and truth tables.
7.	Communication Protocol Basics - CAN, I2C, SPI protocols.
8.	ADC and DAC - Basic types and conversion principles.

 

Attached is a one slide on the portfolio of different activities in Electronics Engineering.

 

To provide further clarity and answer any questions, we will be organizing a role briefing call soon. Please keep an eye out for the calendar invite and make sure to join.

Subject: [SAVE THE DATE]: Cybersecurity Awareness Event in India 2025, 11th, 12th  November 2025
Body:
Dear colleagues,

 

In today’s fast-evolving digital landscape, cybersecurity is no longer just about firewalls and passwords - it’s also about people, collaboration, and adapting to new technologies like AI.​

Whether you work in a technical or non-technical role, your mindful actions help secure Bosch. This is your chance to connect, learn, and empower yourself with a deep dive into the following topics:

 

*	Cybersecurity in 2025: Threats, Trends & What Everybody Needs to Know
*	Cybersecurity meets AI: How AI is Changing the Cyber Threat Game
*	Cybersecurity on Wheels: Protecting the Future of Mobility
*	Regulations & Privacy: Mastering Compliance in a Regulated World

 



  

Next steps:

*	Add this save-the-date to your calendar: Safe the date.ics <https://connect.bosch.com/files/form/anonymous/api/library/46460f98-c043-40b0-a167-1e7d6c0fc9be/document/a5b84780-6d2f-48b7-906e-cd738864c0c7/media/Cybersecurity%20Around%20the%20World%20%23India2025.ics>  (when clicking check your downloads for the ics file)
*	More details coming soon here: Landingpage <https://inside-docupedia.bosch.com/confluence/cyseca-bosch/events-5928572826.html> 

 

Don't miss out on the event and save the date now.

 

 

Protect yourself. Protect us.

Subject: The Weekly Wrap 19th September 2025
Body:
19th September 2025


 






Penetration Testing Roadshow – BGSW Coimbatore

The MS/ECY team hosted a successful Penetration Testing Roadshow at BGSW Coimbatore, highlighting the critical need for penetration testing in today's cybersecurity landscape. Attended by nearly 100 delegates and opened by Centre Head Mr. Naved Narayan, the event showcased MS/ECY's comprehensive hardware and enterprise penetration testing capabilities.

Key Highlights:

*	Embedded Penetration Testing (Morning): Covered methodology, compliance, attack paths, and demonstrated fuzz and wireless testing for IoT products. Use cases in Automotive, Healthcare, and IoT/OT were also discussed.
*	Enterprise Penetration Testing (Afternoon): Focused on current trends, enterprise attack paths, and walkthroughs of application, cloud, and network testing. Special attention was given to GenAI products and LLM models. Live demos illustrated social engineering and supply chain attacks, and the event concluded with a powerful Red Teaming demonstration bypassing perimeter security.

Key Takeaways for Leaders:

*	Penetration testing is a strategic necessity for compliance and resilience.
*	Structured testing strengthens security across IoT, enterprise apps, cloud, networks, and GenAI.
*	Non-traditional attack vectors like social engineering and supply chain attacks demand attention.
*	Red Teaming is crucial for proactive defense against sophisticated threats.

The roadshow effectively demonstrated how penetration testing enhances organizational security, thanks to the dedicated efforts of the MS/ECY team.


 


 





GS India Honored at National Excellence Practice 2025         

The Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) Institute of Quality is a leading authority on quality enhancement across industries. At the 13th CII IQ National Excellence Practice Competition 2025, GS India earned Silver recognition in the Customer Experience category for the initiative “Enhancing Customer Experience through Business Relationship Management (BRM).” The BRM network serves as the first point of contact for GS India customers, offering a trusted bridge to the right experts. Over the past three years, it has become a customer favorite, building trust, transparency, and delight through a proactive, people-centric approach. This achievement was made possible by the outstanding efforts of Rajesh Ranjan (GS/CTG-IN), Naik Suresh (GS/PUI74), and Murugappan Ramaswamy (GS/OSP-SP16, GS/OSP-SP17). Congratulations to the team for setting benchmarks in customer centricity.


 


 









BGSW Multimarket presents at the 75th anniversary of Aeronautical Society of India (AeSI)         

Mr. Somanath Sharma (Program Manager - Physical AI & Robotics) and Mrs. Sowjanya Bollu (Program Manager – Home Comfort) from BGSW Multimarket presented at the 75th anniversary of Aeronautical Society of India (AeSI) seminar on the topic of “Advances in Aerospace Technologies: AI & Structural Analysis” at the Old HAL Management Academy, Bengaluru. Their presentation offered insights into AI's transformative power, Generative Design, Energy Optimization,  Predictive Maintenance, Autonomous Flight, Factory Automation and Responsible AI. The seminar attracted a distinguished audience, including the CEO of Helicopter complex- HAL, Director & Associate Directors from DRDO, IAF Commanders from ASTE, Directors of PSUs/MSME/Corporates. The audience expressed interest in the role of AI in industrial and energy domains.

Thank you to Mr. Veera Reddy (BGSW/PJ-SNB-GOV) for providing valuable insights to AeSI and Academia.  

Cybersecurity Good Practices in Responsible AI session  

On September 17th, the BGSW/ISP office in collaboration with MS/ECL, hosted an engaging session on Cybersecurity Good Practices in Responsible AI, delivered by Munikumar.

The hybrid event's attendance of 230 associates reflects the growing interest and importance of Responsible AI. The speaker began with a primer on the emerging risks in AI systems such as Bias exploitation attacks, Privacy and copyright violations, Transparency and trust exploitation.

Further, the focus shifted to strategies for strengthening AI security through the core principles of Responsible AI - Fairness & Inclusivity, Transparency & Explainability, Accountability & Governance, Privacy & Security, Reliability & Safety. A key highlight of the session was exploration of the global regulatory landscape that can shape Responsible AI. Participants gained insights into international frameworks and standards, including the OECD AI Principles, the EU AI Act, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and the newly introduced ISO/IEC 42001 standard for AI management systems. The session also underscored the importance of robust AI system testing methodologies to ensure compliance, trust, and resilience. Conclusively, this session explained how effective Cybersecurity practices can be an agency for Responsible AI thereby securing the trust of all stakeholders of the AI system and the imperative need to adapt them.


 


 






BGSW Multimarket engagements at Vietnam 

BGSW Multimarket visited Vietnam MM stakeholders and management. It was a complete circle involving meeting with highly motivated leadership team and connecting with many of the talented associates of Bosch Multimarket team. The townhall and get to know connects provided a closer view of the diverse competencies and capabilities that have evolved in Vietnam.


 


 








#TribePune | CSR | Math Tactiles Project         

After the overwhelming success of the Math Tactiles project, Boschlers once again came together with compassion and creativity to empower visually impaired students through education. This time, the focus shifted from numbers to science concepts – bringing to life complex processes like photosynthesis, germination, and the water cycle through touch and feel.

Understanding abstract scientific concepts can be challenging for students with visual impairments. To bridge this gap, 35+ volunteers worked collaboratively to design and create 40+ tactile learning aids. These tactile models transform difficult textbook explanations into interactive, sensory-based tools that allow students to “see” science with their hands.

The initiative brought together Bosch associates from diverse teams, all united by a shared vision – to make education more inclusive. Through brainstorming, designing, and hands-on crafting, the team created a series of durable, easy-to-use tactile models that will be distributed across schools in Pune.

These efforts are not just about creating teaching aids; they are about opening doors to curiosity, confidence, and equal learning opportunities. With these Science Tactiles, visually impaired students can better understand how plants make their own food, how seeds transform into saplings, and how nature’s water cycle sustains life on Earth.

This initiative stands as a testament to Bosch’s commitment to inclusive education and social responsibility. Together, we are making classrooms more accessible and learning more joyful – one tactile at a time.

#TribePune | Badminton Mela – Season 2: A Smash Hit 

Season 2 of Badminton Mela turned out to be nothing short of spectacular, thanks to the enthusiasm, energy, and sportsmanship of our Boschlers!

This year, we achieved a record-breaking footfall of 122 participants — the highest ever! With 115 exciting matches played, the courts buzzed with passion, friendly rivalry, and unstoppable energy.

From powerful smashes to edge-of-the-seat rallies, every game brought alive the spirit of badminton. The atmosphere was electric, filled with cheers, camaraderie, and unforgettable moments that made the event feel like a true mela. Badminton Mela once again reminded us that beyond the competition, it’s the collective spirit, togetherness, and celebration that make it truly special.

Our associates, along with Mind Buddies and our in-house counsellor, Smriti Shah (HCL Avitas, BGSW/HRL-HWB-MED), recently participated in an engaging session on attachment styles. Through fun activities associates gained valuable insights into how attachment styles shape relationships.

Takeaways:

*  Confidence to build deeper, more meaningful connections.

*  Tools to apply this understanding at work by fostering trust, managing conflict, and enhancing emotional intelligence.

The session left associates more equipped to strengthen both personal and professional relationships.

#TribePune | NDA signed between RBIC, BGSW, and ARAI 

As a continuation of our August 2025 engagement with ARAI, a general (non-project-specific) NDA has been signed between RBIC, BGSW, and ARAI. This agreement is designed to keep an open yet confidential dialogue across entities, enabling smoother collaboration in ongoing and future initiatives spanning business & legislative framework insights, services, and co-development. The NDA ensures that all discussions (written, verbal, or visual) between ARAI and BGSW/RBIC remain confidential for a duration of one year, with an option to extend by two more years. This strengthens our collaborative spirit for deeper engagement with ARAI. Ramesh Palaniappan (BGSW/PJ-ESO1-PUN) BU Anchor, represented us during the signing.


 


 








Pedaling Towards Wellness: 🚴‍♀️ BGSW #ManaHyderabad – Cyclothon with a Purpose         

This week, BGSW #ManaHyderabad pedaled towards a healthier lifestyle with an exhilarating Cyclothon at the ORR Narsingi Cycling Track. With 150+ associates participating across 5K, 10K, and 15K rides, the event celebrated fitness, well-being, and togetherness. The energy, camaraderie, and spirit of participation made it truly special.

🌍 In addition to fitness, the event carried a strong CSR message:

Associates were sensitized on plastic usage and introduced to sustainable alternatives.

As part of the activity, associates painted cloth bags, which will be distributed to tribal communities as a step towards reducing single-use plastic.

✨ A big thank you to all participants for making this event a success — combining health, awareness, and social responsibility into one inspiring initiative. Here’s to many more such purposeful engagements!

Rise to Inspire @ BGSW #ManaHyderabad – Driving Quality, Reliability & Efficiency

This week’s Rise-to-Inspire sessions showcased how innovation is driving impact at BGSW #ManaHyderabad.

*  The ReDe tool is transforming deliverable preparation by standardizing formats, improving quality, and cutting errors – with a projected saving of 900 hours (27.9 T€). Thanks to @Sahu Indra Kumar (MS/EAX13-EC) for the insightful session.

Debate Contest 2.0 – Words, Wit & Winning Moments @ Bosch Hyderabad Toastmasters

The Bosch Hyderabad Toastmasters recently hosted Debate Contest 2.0, transforming the amphitheater into an electrifying arena of ideas. Spirited speakers took the stage, showcasing sharp wit, powerful reasoning, and eloquent delivery.

The contest kicked off with two dynamic teams debating the age-old question – “Is happiness tied to money?” – leaving the audience with fresh perspectives. The energy only grew stronger as enthusiastic Boschlers from the audience jumped in, debating impromptu topics with passion and flair.

The event concluded with commendations and prize distribution, celebrating not only the winners but also the courage and brilliance of every participant. ✨

👏 A big shoutout to all the speakers and supporters for making this contest a true celebration of communication, confidence, and community!

Leap Felicitation @ BGSW Hyderabad – Nurturing Future Leaders

On 11th September, BGSW Hyderabad proudly celebrated the successful completion of the first batch of Leap: Future Leader’s Program. Launched in October 2024, this program identified 25 high-potential associates from the center to undergo a rigorous 6-month journey of growth and leadership development.

The program included 1:1 coaching by external coach George Cherian, personalized Individual Development Plans, and classroom sessions anchored on the Bosch Competency Model and Leadership Qualities. Participants also worked in teams to solve real business problem statements, guided by senior leaders, and presented their solutions to Centre Head Amjad Khan Patan. A special thanks to our mentors — Bhargav S Gorti, Krishna Kishore Amara, Ankireddy Praveen, Sundarasamy Nambi, and Praneeth Kumar Kotagiri — for their time and guidance in shaping these leaders.

The felicitation was led by Amjad Khan Patan, Priya Menon, and Aravind Raman, who shared their encouragement and best wishes with the associates. 👏 Congratulations to all the participants who took the Leap, and heartfelt gratitude to the mentors for investing their energy in building the future leaders of BGSW #ManaHyderabad!


 


 








She Rise @ CII IWN Uplift Leadership Conclave – Voices of Change

On 12th September, She Rise, the women’s community at BGSW Hyderabad, proudly represented at the CII IWN Uplift Leadership Conclave held in Hyderabad.

Our associates — Priya Menon (BGSW/HRL-BP-HYD), Manasa Mogudampally (MS/ENS-XC), and Nandi Nagalakshmi (BD/SPB-APB11) — participated in this engaging platform built around the theme “Voices of Change.”

The conclave featured keynotes, panel discussions, and a leadership masterclass, bringing together inspiring women leaders from academia, business, and government. The day concluded with valuable networking opportunities, making it a truly enriching experience.

COP-PM REX Conversation on Risk Management Excellence @ BGSW Hyderabad

This week, the COP-PM REX team engaged in an insightful conversation with Amjad Khan Patan, VP and Centre Head, BGSW Hyderabad, on the topic of Risk Management Excellence. Amjad emphasized the importance of transparency and shared ownership in building a robust global risk management culture. He spotlighted the Fit.MS transformation program, designed to drive agility and future-readiness for 25,000+ associates across Bosch.

Sharing his vision for Hyderabad’s growth, Amjad highlighted key focus areas such as AI, cloud, DevOps, and strategic sectors like life sciences, with a clear shift towards value creation over volume. On the role of AI, he underlined the significance of ethical accountability, data quality, and a mindset shift — moving beyond just adopting tools to building sustainable, responsible innovation.

Subject: Submit GST Invoices by 15th October 2025 for FY 2024-25 Input Tax Credit
Body:
Dear Boschlers,

As you are aware, the Goods & Services Tax (GST) charged by our suppliers on materials and services invoices, or debit notes can be claimed as GST input tax credit.

According to the GST Act, to avail the GST input tax credit for invoices dated during FY 2024-25 (April 1, 2024, to March 31, 2025), they must be recorded in our books on or before 31st October 2025.

As per the standard process, suppliers are required to submit invoices directly to the GS/OSP-SP17 team via either the ePortal email ID or the Scanning Services email ID- Digital.Archiving@in.bosch.com- <mailto:Digital.Archiving@in.bosch.com->  within 3 days of the invoice or GRN date.

However, we understand that some suppliers are still sending invoices to users for certification. If you have received any invoices from suppliers, please ensure that after certification, they are promptly handed over to the GS/OSP-SP17 SPOC at your location or sent as a PDF scan to Digital.Archiving@in.bosch.com <mailto:Digital.Archiving@in.bosch.com>   well before 15th October, 2025. This will allow us to process the invoices and claim the eligible GST credit.

Additionally, if any invoices have been placed on hold due to pending clarifications regarding service quality, pricing, or other issues, please resolve these matters and submit the invoices before 15th October, 2025.

Best regards, 

GS/OSP-SP17

C/TXR-IN

Subject: Importance of Business Partner Compliance
Body:
Upholding Integrity in Our Business Relation with Intermediaries

 

Dear Boschlers,

 

At BGSW, conducting business with the highest standards of ethics and integrity is paramount and fundamental to our success and reputation. A key part of this commitment involves how we select, engage, and manage our business relationships with Intermediaries.

 

This communication serves as an important reminder of our shared responsibility to ensure these relationships are transparent, properly documented, and compliant with all applicable laws, including anti-bribery and anti-corruption regulations and Bosch Group Directives.

 

Why is this so important?

 

Intermediaries, while often essential to our business operations, can also pose significant legal and reputational risks and may expose BGSW and our employees to severe penalties, including large fines and even criminal liability. A robust due diligence and risk management process is our first line of defence.

 

Your Role and Responsibilities

 

Every OE involved in engaging or managing Intermediaries must adhere to our company's established procedures. Key responsibilities include:

1.	Conduct Due Diligence: Before engaging an Intermediary, conduct an Integrity Check using the “Business Partner Due Diligence” (BPDD) tool and Risk Assessment to determine corruption risk and the appropriate level of due diligence. The diligence level aligns with the engagement's risk (low, medium, or high).
2.	Compliance Screening and Risk Mitigation: The Requestor must verify 'Alerts' against intermediary data from onboarding and evaluate risks ('Red Flags') identified during Risk Assessment, Due Diligence or Compliance Screening. They are then required to define, implement, and document appropriate mitigation measures for these identified risks.
3.	Approval: The Requestor may not obtain approval until all the process steps have been fully processed and completed. The responsible manager based on intermediary’s pre-determined corruption risk may approve or reject the business relationship with the Intermediary:

 

Risk level

Approvals required

Low

Responsible Manager

Medium

Responsible Manager + Subsequent recommendations and notes as needed by CPO

High

Superior Manager (Senior Management) + Subsequent recommendations and notes as needed by CPO

 

4.	Requirements for Drafting Intermediary Agreements: All Intermediary agreements must in writing and include:

	*	Detailed description of the services provided by the Intermediary
	*	Amount/ Calculation basis of the agreed remuneration
	*	Details on payment methods

Note: The payment of the remuneration in cash is inadmissible

	*	Invoicing, invoice verification and payment terms
	*	Compliance clauses
	*	Obligation to comply with the Code of Conduct for business partners
	*	Obligation to notify changes on the part of the Intermediary

5.	Speak Up: If you encounter any red flags or have concerns about a potential or existing relationship with an Intermediary, you have a duty to report it immediately to your manager, the Legal Department, or the Compliance Department. You can also use our confidential reporting platform – “Speak Up”. 

 

Key Definitions and Policies

 

For clarity, please refer to the following definitions and policies that govern our approach to working with Intermediaries. 

Definition of an Intermediary: Any person (natural person) or any company (legal person) commissioned to act on behalf of Bosch or to represent Bosch´s interests (e.g., consulting and support services in the initiation, negotiation and/or conclusion of contracts/orders or the application for licenses or permits).

*	Intermediaries in this sense are in particular (not exhaustively): sales intermediaries, commercial agents (in the sense of a sales assistant of Bosch), agents, brokers, representatives, freight forwarders (including border traffic and customs clearance), lobbyists, and other interest representatives.
*	No intermediaries within the meaning of this C-Directive are, in particular: customers (including resellers on their account), end customers, and suppliers. Furthermore, lawyers, tax consultants, and auditors are also not intermediaries (in this case, the respective existing Bosch order processes are to be applied). Legal entities of the Bosch Group and their associates are generally not intermediaries. Associates can be intermediaries if they act as such outside their employment contract with Bosch.

 

Applicable Policies and Procedures:

*	C-Directive 03010 "Business relations with Intermediaries of Bosch" – Link <https://rb-wam.bosch.com/socos-rb/SOCOS/documents/ccm01/cd/10070/CD-03010-000_VAW_N_EN_2022-08-01.pdf> 
*	Attachment 1 "Compliance Clauses" to C-Directive 03010 – Link <https://rb-wam.bosch.com/socos-rb/SOCOS/finder.cgi?CD-03010-001_ANH_N_XX> 
*	Attachment 2 "Detective Controls (DC)/Monitoring Procedures (MP)" to C-Directive 03010 – Link <https://rb-wam.bosch.com/socos-rb/SOCOS/finder.cgi?CD-03010-002_ANH_N_XX> 

 

Our Commitment

 

Compliance is a collective responsibility. By diligently following our procedures for engaging Intermediaries, you are not just protecting the company-you are protecting yourself and upholding the integrity that defines us.

 

Thank you for your continued dedication to doing business the right way.

 

If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to reach out to C/CMR-BGSW-IN.

 

Sincerely,

C/CMR-BGSW-IN



 

 

 

 

 

Best Regards,

BGSW Marketing and Communications

Subject: The Weekly Wrap 3rd October 2025
Body:
03rd October 2025


 





 

Famfare with Kids 2025: A Globe-Trotting Celebration!

With the theme Globe Trotters, with Boschlers and their children embarked on a colorful journey through India, Vietnam, Germany, Poland and Mexico, celebrating the countries where BGSW has its presence. Across six sites, nearly 10,000 participants immersed themselves in culture, creativity, and interactive activities, making the day truly unforgettable. One of the most heartwarming highlights was seeing children step into their parents’ workstations, creating lasting memories of pride and connection.

Famfare 2025 was not just a celebration of cultures, but of community, togetherness, and the true spirit of BGSW. 

 





 


 






Bosch SDS Celebrates a Milestone with First-Ever Team Event at MBRDI & DTICI

In a proud moment for Bosch SDS, the team celebrated its growth from just 5 associates in 2014 to over 250 in 2025, working with key clients MBRDI and DTICI. Despite in the automotive sector, SDS has continued to grow—driven by strong culture, commitment, and collaboration.

Marking this milestone, SDS associates across EVS, ETS, IT, and more came together for the first-ever joint Team Event & Dinner. The evening featured inspiring leadership messages, interactive team-building activities, recognition of outstanding contributors, and meaningful conversations over dinner.

More than a celebration, the event reinforced the unity and shared purpose among associates across diverse domains. It served as a powerful reminder of the impact SDS teams make every day.


 






Vibe Coding Hackathon Jurying at Coimbatore Institute of Technology

On September 20, 2025, the vibrant atmosphere of innovation and creativity filled the halls of our college as the Vibe Coding Hackathon unfolded. Invited by the Head of Department from the AI/ML division, we (Vishnu Karthiklu, Ragulsuriya, Mano Bharath, Sudhakar) had the unique opportunity to serve as a jury member for this exciting event. 

The hackathon brought together enthusiastic second and third-year students from the AI/ML department, as well as MCA students, all eager to tackle real-world challenges. The problem statements, carefully selected by the jury, focused on two innovative projects: an Emoji Translator that converts words into emojis and a Toxic Word Detection system designed to identify and replace harmful language.

As the students dove into their projects, it was inspiring to witness their passion and determination. Utilizing cutting-edge tools like Cursor AI, ChatGPT, and Gemini, they approached the challenges with creativity and a thirst for knowledge. Their enthusiasm was palpable, and it was a refreshing experience to engage with the next generation of tech innovators.

After a day filled with coding, collaboration, and problem-solving, we gathered to evaluate the students' work. The insights gained from their projects not only highlighted their technical skills but also showcased their ability to think critically and work as a team. Announcing the winners was a proud moment for all of us, as we celebrated their hard work and ingenuity.

This hackathon was more than just a competition; it was a valuable learning experience for both the students and the jury. As industry professionals, we gained fresh perspectives on emerging trends and innovative solutions, while the students benefited from our feedback and mentorship. Events like the Vibe Coding Hackathon are essential in fostering connections between academia and industry, paving the way for future collaborations and advancements in the field of AI and machine learning.


 


 





Tata Group Data Privacy Forum         

The forum was hosted by Titan at The Oterra Hotel, Bengaluru, on 24th September 2025. It brought together over 140 senior leaders and data privacy practitioners (both in person and virtually from more than 40 Tata companies) from privacy offices, IT, legal compliance, and Information Security.

The sessions were focused on strengthening their preparedness for implementing the DPDPA. In addition to internal deliberations, the Forum engaged with external speakers to broaden its perspective and learn from their experiences in managing data privacy at scale.


 


 








BGSW Hyderabad Honoured at HYSEA Sustainable Development Summit & Awards 2025         

On 29th September, BGSW Hyderabad was proud to be part of the HYSEA Sustainable Development Summit & Awards 2025, held at HICC, Hyderabad, under the theme “Leading with Purpose and Delivering Impact.” 

Our Centre Head & VP, Amjad Khan Patan, joined an engaging panel on “Education to Employment,” moderated by Mr. Amit Vatsyayan (EY), alongside leaders such as Ms. Manisha Saboo (Infosys Foundation) and Mr. Madhav Chavan (Pratham Education Foundation). The discussion explored how corporates, government, and NGOs can come together to create sustainable skilling and employment pathways for youth, empowering communities while driving inclusive growth.

✨ The highlight of the day was BGSW receiving the HYSEA Sustainable Development Award 2025 in the category of Education & Skilling, presented by the Hon’ble Governor of Telangana, Shri Jishnu Dev Varma. A big thank you to our CSR team for their outstanding efforts and to our volunteers for embodying Bosch’s commitment to community engagement.

The summit also featured inspiring sessions on:

*  Sustainability Practices by Corporates – reducing environmental footprints and driving green initiatives.

*  Innovations in CSR – leveraging technology and digital solutions for community development.

*  Partnerships for Impact – showcasing collective action between corporates, academia, and NGOs.

This recognition reaffirms our belief that purposeful action and collaboration can create lasting impact. At Bosch, we continue our commitment to shaping solutions that serve industries and uplift communities through education, sustainability, and innovation.

BGSW Wins Prestigious Surakshit Hyderabad Award 2025  

BGSW Hyderabad has been honored with the coveted Safe and Secure Global Capability Center award at the Surakshit Hyderabad Awards 2025. The award ceremony was held on the 26th of September at Anvaya Conventions, Financial District, Gachibowli, Hyderabad., recognizing outstanding contributions to safety and security in the corporate sector.

The prestigious accolade was presented by Dr. Gajarao Bhupal to Balakrishnan V, GR/FCM 2 BGSW. The event’s chief guest, Shikha Goel IPS, graced the occasion and highlighted the importance of secure workplace environments in today’s rapidly evolving digital landscape.

The Surakshit Hyderabad Awards 2025 were sponsored by SymX, ASIS International and PSP Pune Security Professional, with strong support from partners FSAI and GACS. This recognition underscores BGSW commitment to creating a safe, secure, and resilient global capability center, fostering an environment where innovation and security go hand in hand.


 


 






#TribePune | Parivaar Utsav 2025: A Day of Joy, Beats, and Togetherness

Saturday was one for the books at our Pune campus – Parivaar Utsav brought so much joy, laughter, and energy, it honestly felt like the whole place was buzzing.

From the giggles in the kids’ activity zones to the little stars lighting up the stage with their performances, it was pure magic watching families make memories together.

And just when we thought the excitement couldn’t get any bigger, our Leadership team kicked things off with a Dhol-Tasha welcome that had the entire crowd on its feet – the beats, the colors, the energy… unforgettable! Adding to the magic was a special performance by our Art In Motion team, who left families cheering with their incredible talent.

As the evening rolled in, the celebrations only grew louder. With every beat of dandiya and Bollywood, kids, parents, and grandparents lit up the floor – a perfect reminder of the joy of being together.


 


 





#TribePune | Verb-O-Vibe Empowering Voices, Building Confidence!         

What an incredible journey it's been! Verb-O-Vibe recently wrapped up its final spotlight, marking the successful conclusion of our inaugural season. From humble beginnings in March with 30 enthusiastic registrations, we've witnessed remarkable growth and transformation.

We are thrilled to announce that eight participants successfully completed the sessions, having masterfully navigated all five pathways: Anecdotal, Humorous, Inspirational, Narrative, and the ultimate improv challenge, "Sell the Inconvenient." 

Kudos to all the associates who completed the sessions – your commitment made this season a resounding success!

Mohmmadsafdar Vahora (MS/EVV3-SWC), Koul Sakshi (BD/SWD-TMA5), Joshi Udit (MS/ECF2), More Atharva Anil (MS/ECF2), Sisodiya Pratima (MS/EVC-PA2-XC), Vyas Aditi (BD/TOA-SPL3), Patange Pradnya Prasad (MS/ETM1-MA), Agrawal Bhoomika (MS/EVC-PA5-XC)

And a colossal thank you goes out to our phenomenal mentors – Agrawal Bhoomika (MS/EVC-PA5-XC), Phulaware Adish Dinesh (MS/EAI2-PS), Khandelwal Kunika Deepak (MS/ETA6-ETAS), Garud Harsh Kuldeep (BD/TCA-DSD7), and Mudhliar Rudrakshi (MS/EHT-ES). 

Verb-O-Vibe, a proud program of Pune’s Learning and Development initiative, is dedicated to empowering our associates to build essential communication skills and express themselves with confidence. We eagerly anticipate the continued impact of these newly honed voices! Stay tuned for more L&D initiatives designed to unlock your full potential.


 


 





MILAN 2025 : Two Days. One Team. Countless Memories! BD/ERA-AMS & ASL Tribes         

On 12th & 13th Sep 2025, something magical happened at Bangalore, 150+ colleagues from BD/ERA-AMS ; BD/ERA-ASL tribes from all IN locations came together, Pure magic and that’s exactly under the vibrant banner of MILAN 2025 all about!! 

From the moment we checked into the resort and enjoyed a hearty lunch, the excitement was already in the air. And then came the Opening Ceremony, setting the perfect stage packed with energy, laughter, and inspiration. 

We took a beautiful walk down memory lane with “Milan 2024 Rewind”, reliving all the fun moments we created last year.  This was followed by a proud showcase of our Key Achievements, reminding us how far we’ve come together. 

The spotlight also shone bright on the Associate Engagement Activities that kept our spirits high throughout the year from coffee cheers to co-working days, potlucks to birthday celebrations, small steps that made a big difference in bringing us closer.


 


Hackers Garage Diaries


 








Computational physics for product engineering Hackers Garage Diaries x Samvad 


Date

29/09/2025


Speaker

S Ganga Prasath, Asst. Prof., DoAM, IIT Madras


The session highlighted how computational physics drives product engineering, tackling challenges through CFD, FEA, and digital twin applications.

Link <https://bosch.mediaspace.de.kaltura.com/media/Computational%20physics%20for%20product%20engineering%20%20Hackers%20Garage%20Diaries%20x%20Samvad/0_w8dubs87> 

Context Meets Vision: The Future of Spatial XR  


Date

30/09/2025


Speaker

COMPLIANCE TRAINING PROGRAM



 	
 

 	
 

 	
 

 	


What is it about?

 

Due to substantially increased importance and complexity of export control regulations, an increasing number of company areas are impacted by export controls and sanctions the following mandatory Compliance training measures was rolled out on October 01, 2025:

New Web-based Training (WBT) ‘Export Control and Sanctions’ (V2025-B)
