05th December 2025


 






 

Thank you for joining us for a thoughtful and engaging conversation with Datta in Hyderabad. The session explored how BGSW is navigating change, anchoring our AI-first shift, and shaping our strategic priorities toward 2030.

In case you missed the session or would like to revisit the conversation, click  <https://bosch.mediaspace.de.kaltura.com/media/Candid+with+Datta%3A+AMA+Session+%28Ask+Me+Anything%29/0_fpevka23> here to watch the recording.

 


 






Transforming Tomorrow: BGSW PM Week Coimbatore Delivers Excellence 

November 27, 2025 marked a landmark PM Week at BGSW Coimbatore under the transformative theme "Project Management Transformation," uniting industry leaders, AI innovators, and passionate professionals for an extraordinary day of learning and collaboration.

The event opened with an inspiring inauguration by Center Head Mr. Naved Narayan, followed by Mr. Baskar Palaniappan's comprehensive COP PM overview that energized attendees for the transformative journey ahead.

Ms. Padma Priya delivered an exceptional masterclass on Agile Project Management with AI implementation, providing actionable strategies through hands-on sessions with AI. The momentum continued with Ms. Shanthini Suresh's engaging "What's What in BGSW" game, fostering team spirit.

The thought-provoking panel discussion on "Collaborative Intelligence: Human + AI Copilots in Daily Workflows" featured distinguished panelists Ms. Radha S, Mr. Anoob Varughese, Ms. Premalatha Subramaniam, and Mr. Anbu Kumar Rajendran, expertly moderated by Mr. Sandeep Rajan. They explored revolutionary in-house AI applications and practical strategies to adopt AI in everyday tasks.

Ms. Anjana Devi Narayanan's captivating "AI Now, What Next?" presentation unveiled six essential irreplaceable human super skills for the AI-driven era, providing strategic frameworks for development with impact.

The celebration concluded by honoring Quiz Champions Sathish Gopalakrishnan, Kathirvel Subramaniam, Anjana Devi Narayanan, and Arun Kumar Parameshwaran, and Haiku & Meme Winners Kamini Devaraj, Dhivya Arumugam, and Anbu Kumar Rajendran.

Heartfelt gratitude to the organizing team Sandeep Rajan, Shanthini Suresh, Keerthiga Raja, Sathya Priya N, Abinaya Rajendran, Vadivukkarasi Balakrishnan, Eswari Marudhanayagam, Rahul Ravindran, Kathiravan Rajendran, Priya Pitchai Rathinam, Mahalakshmi Dhanashekaran, and photographer Janakaraj Govindasamy for making this transformative event seamless.

Stay connected for upcoming initiatives!


 


 








GS India emerges victorious in the All-India Bosch Tennis Ball Cricket Tournament 2025 

The Bosch Sports Club in Adugodi, Bengaluru, recently hosted the All-India Bosch Tennis Ball Cricket Tournament 2025, a thrilling competition for Bosch India associates. A field of 16 strong teams, drawn from Bosch facilities in Pune, Nashik, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Naganathapura, Chennai, Coimbatore & Gangaikondan, competed fiercely over two stages. BidP1/PC launched the tournament, and after two days of spirited play, PS/RP-IN presided over the closing ceremony. It’s a proud moment that the GS India team, under the leadership of Karthik Muniraju (GS/OSP-SP135), conquered the competition and claimed the championship title. This isn't just a win on the scoreboard; it's a moment of immense pride for GS India and a testament to their hard work. With exceptional determination and cohesive teamwork, GS India delivered an undefeated run of five consecutive matches, consistently outplaying their rivals. All India Bosch Cricket Tournament – The Remarkable Run of BGSW Coimbatore

At the All India Bosch Cricket Tournament held on November 22–23 in Bangalore, 16 teams from across the country came together for two days of intense competition. Among them, BGSW Coimbatore stood out as one of the most dynamic and talked-about teams of the event.

The team made an explosive start, posting an impressive 106 runs in just 6 overs, a performance that became one of the highlights of the tournament. Their aggressive batting display, marked by a flurry of sixes, earned them the distinction of having the highest number of sixes recorded by any team.

Their bowling unit was equally commanding. BGSW Coimbatore secured one of the largest victory margins of the tournament a 70-run win showcasing disciplined pace, tight lines, and exceptional teamwork. With each match, their confidence grew, and their presence on the field drew admiration from spectators and fellow teams alike.

Their journey reached the quarterfinals, where they faced a challenging contest. Although they were edged out of the competition, the sportsmanship and energy they displayed left a lasting positive impression. Players and officials from various teams praised their fearless approach, cohesive team spirit, and overall impact on the tournament.

While BGSW Coimbatore may not have progressed beyond the quarterfinals, they earned something equally significant respect, recognition, and the reputation of being one of the standout teams of this year’s tournament.

With the experience gained and the strong performances delivered, the team is expected to return next year with even greater determination and focus..

Subject: BUSINESS TRAVEL CRITICAL : Apply for Citibank Corporate Credit Card Immediately!
Body:
Dear Colleagues,

To ensure seamless business travels and to align with standards towards bTravel system roll-out in Q2 2026, it is mandatory to apply for the Citi Corporate Credit Card which will be the desired mode of payments for all domestic and international business travels. All active On-Roll Associates are eligible to apply for the Citi Corporate Credit Card as deemed fit.

Whether you have travel plans or not, please apply as the travel advance issuance through the Forex cards will be stopped for all business travels effective 15th Jan 2026.

Effective 15th Jan 2026, if you do not hold a Citi card, then you will have to use your personal credit / debit card for all your travels.

*	To access the Citi Credit Card Application Process Guide – Click Here <https://connect.bosch.com/communities/service/html/communityview?communityUuid=3ac351e7-0ab7-4927-b9d3-2af69fcd6b98> 
*	To access the FAQ’s and Best Practices Guide – Click Here <https://connect.bosch.com/files/app/s/3Y3Q54EP99TYWk0ljPPOF5oz7dlW> 

*	For queries or clarifications, please email to BoschIN.CitiCreditcardSupport@in.bosch.com <mailto:BoschIN.CitiCreditcardSupport@in.bosch.com> 
*	If you have already applied or hold an active Citi credit card, then please do not re-apply.

Travel2Expense service (GS/HRS92-IN) – Credit Card Operations Team

Subject: BGSW (All Locations) Holidays List for 2026 and Outlook update
Body:

BGSW Statutory and Festival Holidays list 2026 for Bengaluru, Coimbatore, Hyderabad and Pune locations have been released in BGN.

Click here <https://bgn.bosch.com/FIRSTspiritWeb/permlink/wcms_rgap_-bgsw_holidays_2026_59t5nl7mnsom-EN>  to view the list of Statutory (Mandatory National Holidays and State Compulsory Holidays) and Festival holiday list for 2026.

*  In the top-right corner, download the .ics file.

*  Once the download is complete, locate the file in your Downloads folder.

Subject: Teaching guide: How to report phishing emails
Body:
<data:image/png;base64,> 
This message is a quick learning moment focused on teaching you how to report suspicious emails at Bosch. All you need to do is report THIS email. 

If you already know how, do it now!




1. Select mail and click report

In Outlook do the following steps:

*	Select the suspicious email message from the list.
*	Click the Report button from the action bar.







2. Select Report type

*	Clicking the report button will open a dropdown menu. 
*	Select the 'Phishing' from the list.
*	The email message will be removed and you will receive a response from REACT <https://inside-docupedia.bosch.com/confluence/spaces/OSKB/pages/1067417582/REACT+Reported+Email+Analyzer+Classifier+Tool> . 

 


Outlook for mobile devices

  






The email below is an excellent example of a suspicious message that may be a phishing attack.

By promptly reporting such messages to your Security team, you can help them quickly react to potential security threats and safeguard both your personal and the company’s data.





Now take a moment and report THIS message!

Once you have reported this message, the learning moment is complete, congratulations! 

Remember: whenever an email seems suspicious, always report such emails and wait for the response from REACT.  

 

Further information
For more detailed information, please visit this Docupedia page <https://inside-docupedia.bosch.com/confluence/display/OSKB/Microsoft+Report+Button> .
In case of specific concerns or questions contact PhishingAwareness@us.bosch.com <mailto:PhishingAwareness@us.bosch.com>

Body:
Dear All,

 

Greetings from BTC-IN !

 

In today’s ever-evolving business world, learning isn’t just an option - it’s an advantage. To help you stay ahead and continue growing both 

personally, and professionally, we’re excited to bring in a bunch of Learning & Development Programs crafted to inspire curiosity, 

strengthen capabilities and empower excellence.

 

As we step into the final stretch of 2025, we have this last opportunity to end the year with renewed energy, sharper skills, 

and forward-thinking capabilities. 

 

Here’s your chance to explore, learn, and lead better - one skill at a time:

 

 

 

Negotiation and Conflict Management – B (10 Seats available)

Social & Emotional Intelligence – A (15 Seats available)

 

 

Build the skill to navigate disagreements with confidence and clarity. Learn structured negotiation techniques to reach productive, win–win outcomes.

Improve self-awareness, empathy, and emotional control in professional settings. Learn to manage emotions—yours and others’—to build stronger influence and rapport.

 

 

Inter-Personal Skills – B (10 Seats available)

The Art of Being Assertive (10 Seats available)

 

 

Enhance your ability to connect, communicate, and collaborate effectively. Strengthen day-to-day interactions to build trust and stronger working relationships.

Master the balance between confidence and respect in communication. Learn how to express your needs clearly while maintaining healthy boundaries.

 

 

Positive Leadership – B (15 Seats available)

Managing Difficult Conversations – B (10 Seats available)

 

 

Develop a leadership mindset that inspires, empowers, and energizes teams. Focus on strengths-based approaches that foster a positive and productive work culture.

Gain practical tools to handle sensitive, high-stakes, or uncomfortable discussions. Learn to stay composed, objective, and solution-focused under pressure.

 

 

 Art of giving Feedback-B (15 Seats available)

Business Communication – A (11 Seats available)

	 

 Learn how to deliver feedback that is clear, constructive, and motivating. Build the confidence to guide others’ performance while strengthening trust and collaboration.

Strengthen clarity, professionalism, and impact in your workplace communication. Learn techniques to present ideas effectively across written and verbal formats.

Subject: Integrity in Everyday Business | Anti-Corruption Day 2025
Body:
Dear Boschlers,

Today, on Anti-Corruption Day, we reinforce our shared commitment to conducting business the right way. Even in challenging times, our foundation of integrity remains constant. 

To support this commitment, we invite you to watch a short video. 

🎥 Click here to watch the video <https://bosch.mediaspace.de.kaltura.com/media/Integrity+in+Everyday+Business/0_jcqreuyx> 


This video illustrates how our deeply embedded corporate principles of integrity and Compliance serve as a reliable compass for our associates to navigate difficult business situations. 

Understanding and applying these principles helps us build trust, protect our reputation, and maintain a respectful and ethical work environment.

Test your knowledge this Anti-Corruption Day! Take our quiz now by clicking the link <https://forms.office.com/e/q4Tdq8t3hy>  or scanning the QR code below for a chance to win exciting prizes (top 5 winners from BAN, COB, HYD, & PUN)!



If you ever feel uncertain about a situation – whether it's a gift, an invitation, or a potential conflict – please don’t hesitate to reach out to C/CMR-BGSW-IN. Your commitment to integrity makes a difference.

Thank you for being part of our shared responsibility.

Best regards,
Narottam Kumar
Compliance Officer
Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited

BGSW Marketing and Communications

Subject: IMPORTANT: Policy updates effective Nov'25 - Leave & Effort Regularization
Body:
Dear Colleague,

 

We hope this message finds you well! We want to take a moment to remind you about our Bosch effort-based attendance system (BEST) guideline and Leave policy which ensures smooth operations and accurate payroll processing.

 

Key highlights of Leave policy revision effective Nov’25 is as follows:

 

1.	Unused General Leaves cannot be carried forward to the following calendar year. There will be no exception to carry forward all lapsable leaves to the following calendar year (including new joiners of 2025).
2.	Accumulated Earned Leaves in excess of 60 days will be automatically encashed by Jan’26 payroll instead of Mar’26.

Key highlights of BEST policy revision effective Nov’25 is as follows:

 

It is essential to book your efforts daily and submit weekly for approval in the Digital PPM solution - Planisware <https://rb-wam-ap.bosch.com/rbei-plw-prod/plw/collaboration/Time%20cards/TimeCard%20Input>  Additionally, you are required to plan your leave in advance and apply them pro-actively through Employee Self-Services (ESS). Failure to do so, could result in significant compliance and statutory impacts on retiral contributions, which we aim to avoid. In case you have missed the opportunity to update your efforts, the ESS tool must be used to book effort.

 

1.	No more waiting period (1 week) between closure of Timecard window <https://rb-wam-ap.bosch.com/rbei-plw-prod/plw/collaboration/TimeCard%20Due%20Date%20Details>  in the BGSW effort booking tool and enablement of Effort Not Booked (ENB) window in Employee Self-Services (ESS). Eg: For CW46 (09.11.2025 to 15.11.2025), the timecard window closes on 24.11.2025 and the ENB window will be enabled on the following day, that is, by 25.11.2025
2.	All pending leave requests (except ENB, Deputation, Business reason, Forgot ID) in the manager queue pertaining to previous month corrections will be auto-approved on the early hours of 24th calendar day of the month. ONLY ENB, Deputation, Business Reason, Forgot ID should be manually approved by the manager and within the monthly cut off date (23rd) to avoid payroll and / or Hybrid office presence impact to the associate.
3.	Failure to comply will result in missed days being recorded as 'blank' days (NRF) leading to payroll processing them as Leave Without Pay (LWP) and irreversible payroll deductions for the associate.

 

Managers/Timecard controllers – Please encourage your teams to book their effort on time. In the circumstances where associates have not booked effort, please ensure that the ENB is raised well in time for you to approve by the 18th of the month. Sufficient reminders between 18th to 23rd are being sent. Failure to approve leave or ENB requests by 23rd would result in disciplinary action.

 

For more information, please refer to BEST <https://kor2vm0022.apac.bosch.com/stages/#/workspace/705/_vv/process/guidance/_uhM00DGElBCG4_Vdp-zl2A>  and Leave <https://kor2vm0022.apac.bosch.com/stages/#/workspace/705/_vv/process/guidance/_MLUlAMzscWSqMYStzJkZsA>  policies. Further clarification (if any), please reach out to your respective HR-Business Partners.

 

Your cooperation is greatly appreciated.

 

Thank you for your attention to these updates.



 

Best Regards,

BGSW/HRL-CBP

Subject: The Weekly Wrap 12th December 2025
Body:
12th December 2025


 






Active Campus – Digital Vision Board Session by Rajshree Sengupta 

On 9th December, Active Campus wrapped up its final session of the year with an inspiring workshop on Digital Vision Boards, led by Rajshree Sengupta (MS/ECA2-XC). The session brought together creativity, reflection, and goal-setting to help associates step into the new year with clarity and purpose.

Active Campus, throughout the year, has been a platform that encourages Boschlers to explore new skills, embrace meaningful hobbies, and engage in enriching experiences beyond work. From art and fitness to personal development and creative expression, every session has been designed to spark curiosity, build community, and promote holistic well-being.

This final session perfectly captured that spirit.

Rajshree’s warm, motivating, and interactive approach made the workshop truly memorable. She expertly guided participants in translating their aspirations into visually powerful digital boards, helping them reflect on what matters most and envision the future they want to create. Her thoughtful facilitation ensured that even first-time participants felt confident, inspired, and deeply connected to the process.

Ending the year on such a reflective and energizing note was the ideal way to close the Active Campus calendar.

Thank you to everyone who participated, contributed, and kept the spirit of Active Campus alive all year.

See you all next year with more engaging, creative, and exciting sessions!


 


 






BGSW MultiMarket’s Industrial Tech Townhall: Charting Growth and Strategic Alignment 

BGSW MultiMarket’s Industrial Tech team (SX/EBI-MM) from India, Vietnam & Mexico locations convened for a pivotal townhall and business update. Led by Deba Prasad Tripathy, the session provided crucial insights into success story 2025 and ambitious aspiration 2028, outlining our strategic roadmap for future growth and competitiveness. Key discussions highlighted robust growth in Connected Factory (CF) and Drives and Controls (DC) portfolios, alongside the imperative of maintaining our competitive edge. Innovation was a central theme, with updates showcasing advancements and our unwavering commitment to quality across all operations.

Specialized engineering domains, including Product Engineering (SX/ENA-MM), Data and AI (SX/EDS-MM), Application Engineering (SX/EAE-MM), and Embedded Solutions (SX/EES-MM), presented their strategic direction to align with the team. This demonstrated an integrated technical prowess and its impact on industrial applications. The Townhall concluded with an engaging Q&A, reinforcing transparency and collective alignment. The event solidified our shared vision, emphasizing collaboration, continuous improvement, and leveraging our comprehensive technical capabilities to drive significant value and sustainable growth for BGSW within the dynamic industrial technology landscape.


 


 








Celebrating Success!! 

Felicitation – German language course Level 1- 24.11.25 – Virtual and in person

Team BINOCULUS (HR- Globalization) felicitated 135 associates on 24th Nov2025 who had successfully completed the German Language -STUFE 1 program across all the BGSW locations.

Team BINOCULUS introduced the revamped blended learning course of German Level 1 in virtual mode. The course curriculum is customized to meet the business requirements of BGSW 70 hours of live classes and supplemented with lot of digital assignments. The associates attended the felicitation ceremony virtually and in person at their respective location with great enthusiasm.

The Chief guest of the event was Mr. Damian Dyrbusch, Senior vice President, Cross Domain Computing Solutions at BGSW.

Damian reiterated the importance of knowing German in a German MNC like Bosch which has a global presence. He emphasized how language helps build bridges and better rapport with our colleagues and customers in Germany and help reduce misunderstanding that stems from language and culture barriers. 

The participants grabbed this opportunity and showcased their German language skills

#TribePune | CSR| Pedaling Towards Dreams: "Build A Bike, Change A Life" Hits Top Gear! 

The "Build A Bike, Change A Life" CSR initiative recently brought together over 80 passionate associates in a powerful display of unity and purpose. Across two vibrant phases, culminating on December 9th, we proudly assembled 24 brand-new bicycles!

This hands-on activity brought everyone together with a shared mission: to support school-going girls in tribal communities who often drop out due to the long and difficult distances they must walk each day. Every bicycle built is more than just a mode of transport—it symbolizes access, opportunity, and a renewed chance at education.

As we prepare for the joyous distribution drive, we couldn't be prouder to close our 2025 volunteering efforts on such a high note. The energy, the participation, and the heartfelt commitment poured into this initiative reflect our dedication to serving communities in meaningful and lasting ways. We're not just celebrating bikes; we're celebrating the futures they will help propel forward-one meaningful mile, one confident pedal, one empowered girl at a time.


 


 






#TribePune | Mobility Day

BGSW Pune recently celebrated a significant milestone, marking its third anniversary with a successful Mobility Day event! The event featured dynamic stalls from the XC, VM, EHM, ETAS, and PAC teams, who came together to present their products, innovations, and project successes. This collective effort demonstrated our commitment to boundaryless initiatives and the deep pride our teams take in their work.

The event was inaugurated by Rajkumar B, Aditya Adavi, Gopinath Mujumdar, Anil Prakash, Dattatraya Kurade, and Ramesh Palaniappan. The stalls drew an enthusiastic audience of associates and key business leaders, all keen to witness the future of mobility taking shape.

Feedback was overwhelmingly positive, with particular appreciation for how multiple business units presented integrated solution portfolios. Attendees highlighted a clear "solution mindset" that transcended specific technologies, showcasing our ability to approach challenges holistically.

This successful Mobility Day also serves as an exciting precursor to our planned MS Days 2026. We envision an even broader engagement for this future event, with more business units joining the journey. Our goal is to connect more associates, offer a wider business overview both internally and to external OEs, thereby strengthening our ecosystem and precisely aligning client challenges with our innovative solutions.


 


 






#TribePune | CSR | Our Volunteers Champion Inclusive Education

Recently, our volunteers generously offered their time to serve as scribes for eight visually impaired students during their examinations. Their role was essential, listening carefully, writing accurately, and providing a calm, supportive presence so each student could confidently demonstrate their knowledge. The commitment and compassion shown by these volunteers transformed a challenging task into an empowering experience for the students.

This activity not only ensured equal access to education but also highlighted the power of community involvement. By stepping in as scribes, the volunteers helped create an inclusive environment where every learner could succeed. Their effort stands as a reminder that small acts of service can make a significant impact, opening doors and uplifting students who simply need the right support to shine.


 


 






#TribePune | Samanvay Utsav Limitless 2026 

Our recent Samanvay Utsav Limitless 2026 was a wonderful celebration, truly reflecting the spirit of BGSW Pune. The event highlighted our bold vision, our boundaryless approach, and the significant achievements we've made together.

This year held special meaning as we marked our 3rd anniversary – a proud milestone in our journey of growth. The event provided an opportunity to honor the outstanding accomplishments of our associates, recognizing the hard work and dedication that drives us forward. 

We also took this opportunity to welcome our new Center Head, Gopinath Mujumdar (MS/NE1-XC), who will be taking over the role from January 2026. 

Samanvay Utsav was filled with inspiring moments and warm camaraderie, reinforcing the collective strength and pride we share as a unified team.

We look forward to continuing our path of progress, pushing boundaries, and celebrating future successes – together.




 


 






ETH-PG Hackathon 2025

Towards strengthening and speeding our AI journey, to stay ahead in AI

The power of Tools House was at play in the last week ETH-PG Hackathon The challenge was to conquer the MCP peaks (Production Usable) and guess what the Tool Power House delivered it.

We had 23 teams, 75 Hackathoners participated, and it was as 24hour challenge

MCP is a foundational capability that will define the next generation of productivity and quality in our development ecosystem. Teams were having close competition which made evaluation a difficult task.

Congratulations to all winners and thank you to each and every participant! 


 


 





Celebrating 3 Years of BGSW #ManaHyderabad ✨

On November 27th, we hit a special milestone—celebrating three incredible years of our journey in Hyderabad. Our Annual Day wasn't just an event; it was a vibrant expression of the togetherness and collective energy that sets this location apart.

From business insights to the beat of the music, the evening had it all:

Inspiring Updates: A look at how far we’ve come.

Heartfelt Appreciation: Celebrating the people who make it happen.

Unforgettable Fun: An evening filled with laughter, performances, and camaraderie.

A massive thank you to everyone who contributed to making this celebration memorable. Here is to the milestones achieved and the many more yet to come!


 


 



BGSW #ManaHyderabad Reaches Semi-Finals at All-India Bosch Cricket Tournament! 🏏

The BGSW #ManaHyderabad cricket team participated in the All-India Bosch Tennis Ball Cricket Tournament 2025 in Bangalore, a thrilling two-day, 6-over event featuring 16 teams. Placed in Group B alongside the Bangalore Sports Club team, Team Chakan, and Team Chennai, the Hyderabad squad performed exceptionally well, winning two out of their three group matches. Their impressive performance and superior Net Run Rate earned them a coveted spot in the semi-finals. Although their run ended with a loss to the BAN_PH team in the semis, the entire team demonstrated tremendous skill and great sportsmanship throughout the tournament. We are incredibly proud of the whole BGSW #ManaHyderabad team for their effort and spirit.




 


 






🚀 FIT.Fest’25 – December Edition: A Powerful Celebration of Innovation, Talent & Technology @ #ManaHyderabad

This week, BGSW Hyderabad came alive with energy, creativity, and breakthrough ideas as we hosted FIT.Fest’25 – December Edition, bringing together innovators, tech enthusiasts, leaders, and creators under one vibrant platform. The event kicked off with an inspiring opening ceremony that set the tone for two days of technology-led celebration and learning.

The knowledge tracks were highly engaging. In partnership with WE-Hub, Govt. of Telangana, over 50 associates participated in an insightful Entrepreneurship Workshop, exploring mindset development through hands-on simulations. The excitement continued with the Tech Debates – Prelims & Finals, where our associates showcased exceptional talent and sharp reasoning on thought-provoking arguments, with winners and runners-up earning recognition for their brilliant performances. The knowledge marathon concluded with the Beat the Bots – Tech Quiz, which saw 60+ participants buzzing around AI, emerging tech, and digital trends.

Innovation and engineering prowess were on full display in our challenge arenas. Ten teams competed fiercely in the electrifying Robotics Arms Challenge, with Team Bot Bashers claiming the top prize and Team Robo Rookies securing the runners-up spot. The Innovation Marketplace was a major highlight, featuring ten impressive stalls that showcased internal solutions across GenAI, braking systems, cybersecurity, and EV innovation. Furthermore, the Hackathon pushed problem-solving boundaries, resulting in outstanding work from Prompt Predators (Software Track Winner) and BrainBots (Electronics Track Winner).

We were privileged to host industry leaders, including Mr. Nitin Sharma, Sr. Director – Tech & Patent Council, Qualcomm, and Mr. Vijay Selam, CEO – Svaya Robotics, whose keynotes on tech transformation and robotics innovation truly energized the audience. A special thank you goes out to all the core teams, dedicated volunteers, and event leads whose commitment and hard work made this edition of FIT.Fest a truly memorable and successful celebration of our talent!


 


 






FIT. KovAI Gala Evening – An Evening That Touched Hearts and Celebrated a Shared Vision 

The third anniversary of FIT.KovAI unfolded as an evening filled with warmth, gratitude, and togetherness. The evening opened with a soul-stirring musical journey by Art in Motion, weaving classical melodies with expressive cinematic compositions followed by our traditional Mridangam performance and Carnatic musical song by our budding Music club. Followed by a humorous speech by TM Surya of Kovai Boschlers Toastmaster Club.  The hall instantly filled with a sense of laughter and joy. With his gentle presence and reassuring calmness and humour, our host of the day, Vairamuthukumar Sankaran (MS/EES11-PS) guided the audience through the evening like a trusted friend. 

360¡pixtures beautifully crafted community showcase video reminded everyone why FIT. KovAI exists, bringing people together, to grow together, and to create an impact that goes beyond the workplace. The film captured moments of collaboration and purpose behind every community under the bigger umbrella. 

Then came a deeply moving documentary compiled by our photography club-360 pixtures about the silent heroes of our ecosystem - Vultures. The storytelling touched every heart, reminding us how even scavengers play an important role and left most of us with misty eyes. 

The most emotional part of the evening was when members came forward to share how FIT. KovAI had changed their lives. Their voices carried stories of newfound confidence, meaningful connections, and the courage to step beyond comfort zones. These reflections revealed what the community truly stands for - a place where passion leads, hierarchies fade, and everyone matters. 

The moment that tied the evening together was the heartfelt address by our Cob Center head Naved Narayan, the visionary behind FIT. KovAI. As he spoke about how it all began, the hall fell silent. His words carried sincerity, hope, and a belief that communities can transform people in ways that structures never will. Leaders from VM and HR echoed this spirit, celebrating the power of collective purpose. 

Janani Arumugam (BD/MSA-IPM1 BD/MSA-CSR-Sq3) from Program Office closed the evening with a warm vote of thanks, followed by the Program Office team stepping forward to acknowledge everyone who brought this celebration to life. The night ended on a beautiful note with dinner, laughter, and meaningful conversations.

The FIT.KovAI Gala Evening wasn’t just a celebration. It was a reminder of who we are when we come together - kinder, stronger, and more inspired. It was a tribute to a vision that continues to change lives, and to a community that has become a family.

Subject: The Weekly Wrap 19th December 2025
Body:
19th December 2025


 






Leadership Connect 2025 

Leadership Connect 2025 created space for leaders across BGSW to pause, reflect, and align on the strategic framework shaping our journey toward future ready, intelligent systems. Anchored in the theme of Human AI Convergence, the conversations focused on strengthening leadership capability, scaling innovation, and enabling smarter decision making through meaningful collaboration between humans and AI.

The event began on a festive and welcoming note with engagements that brought together BGSW leaders. The Tech Tree of Thanks and Secret Santa created moments of gratitude, connection, and joy, while the Mirror of Erised offered a reflective experience where leaders revisited meaningful memories reimagined through AI, blending emotion with technology.

The dialogue was enriched by diverse perspectives. Pratyush Kumar, Co-Founder of Sarvam AI, shared insights from his entrepreneurial journey and real-world AI applications. Brigadier Ajay Singh Thakur spoke on Leadership Muscle in the AI World, drawing parallels between leadership in the Army and corporate environments. Alexander Firsching, President Bosch Mexico, reflected on regional growth and excellence.

Adding a lighter yet thoughtful dimension, Kanan Gill’s Eye for AI offered an insightful take on technology, leadership, and the essential human role in an AI driven future.

Through shared experiences, reflection, and open dialogue, Leadership Connect 2025 reinforced a collective commitment to build future ready capabilities and shape BGSW’s intelligent transformation journey together.


 


 






DC-AE/PAD Leadership Visit to India: Charting the India Market Strategy with BGSW & DC-IN 

As part of India market strategy, DC-AE is prioritizing the packaging and labelling segment, initiating this approach through structured visits to key end customers. This focus was reinforced by a pivotal week-long visit from Dr. Bartosz Korajda (DC-AE/PAD) and Dr. Holger Schnabel (DC-AE/PAD1), underscoring DC-AE’s strong commitment to the Indian market.

During the visit, the leaders engaged extensively with customers alongside DC-IN sales teams and BGSW , gaining first-hand insights into market dynamics, customer expectations, and growth opportunities in India. The visit culminated on 11th  Dec with a focused strategy session at BGSW, where Mr. Gopakumar Nair from DC-IN  and his leadership team joined BGSW EBI leaders for an in-depth brainstorming discussion on shaping and accelerating the India market strategy.

BGSW’s Multimarket horizontals showcased their capabilities and ongoing contributions to DC-AE. Teams from Embedded Solutions, Data & AI, GeM, and Green Tech presented how they enable DC-AE’s product and solution roadmap. In addition, Product Engineering (Hardware and Mechanical) highlighted their support for Mid Performance & Price product (MPP) tailored to the Indian market, along with a walkthrough of lab-capabilities.

Further strengthening engagement, Dr. Bartosz hosted an impactful townhall session with BGSW Multimarket associates, where he shared insights on ctrlX Automation, discussed market challenges, and outlined future priorities. Overall, the visit combined customer interactions and collaborative strategy discussions, establishing a strong foundation for DC-AE’s ambitious growth plans in the Indian market, with BGSW and DC-IN as key partners in execution





 








BGSW Multimarket Industrial Tech showcases Intent-Driven Automation to BGSW Leadership team 

On 9th December 2025, BGSW MultiMarket’s Drives and Controls team (SX/EDC-MM) presented the Intent-Driven Automation initiative to the BGSW Leadership, receiving exceptionally positive feedback and recognition for both the vision and the execution. The showcase highlighted not only the maturity of our solution but also the innovative spirit driving this effort. It was a proud moment for the team as leadership acknowledged the project as a significant step toward Bosch’s next generation of intelligent automation.

Intent-Driven Automation is a technical Breakthrough that redefines how robots are programmed and deployed. By leveraging Generative AI, our Intent-Driven Automation enables users to express tasks using simple Natural Language Programming, allowing the system to interpret the user’s intent and translate it directly into robotic actions. This capability becomes especially powerful when paired with Kassow Robots, whose agility and 7-axis dexterity complement the cognitive intelligence of the GenAI models. This sets a new standard for how BGSW can approach automation, showcasing a pathway where robotics becomes more accessible, more efficient, and easier to integrate into a variety of workflows.

🚀 BGSW Hyderabad at Agile Conference 2025 – Driving Product-Centric Agility 

Three associates from BGSW Hyderabad proudly represented us at the Agile Conference 2025 held on 13th December, themed “Product Centric Agility: Leading, Organizing and Measuring What Matters.”

This cross-industry gathering brought together agile practitioners, product leaders, and transformation experts for powerful conversations on shifting from process-centric to value-driven ways of working. Through candid discussions and real-world case studies, our associates gained rich insights into modern product thinking, outcome-based measurement, and evolving organizational agility.

A proud moment for #ManaHyderabad as we continue to learn, grow, and champion future-ready agile practices!


 


 






#TribePune’s FIT.Fest '25: A Recap

The December installment of FIT.Fest’25 delivered a two-day technology event.

The competitive spirit was high with our Technical Quiz Competition, where teams demonstrated impressive knowledge and quick thinking. This was followed by engaging Tech Debates, sparking lively discussions on cutting-edge topics and future technology trends.

The Hackathon took a comprehensive approach to innovation, featuring dedicated tracks for Hardware, Mechanical, and Software. Teams from diverse engineering backgrounds collaborated, brainstormed, and developed solutions, highlighting ingenuity and problem-solving skills. Workstations were busy with activity, from 3D printing to coding, as teams focused on developing their innovative solutions.

Ashwin Shankar, Founder, Battery Pool served as our keynote speaker. His insightful address explored the world of sustainable energy and the innovative solutions shaping our future, perfectly aligning with FITFest's core theme of innovation and technology. Ashwin's vision deeply resonated, inspiring attendees to contribute to future technological advancements.

FIT.Fest’25 demonstrated our collective commitment to innovation and continuous learning. It showcased the talent within BGSW and reinforced our dedication to technological excellence. The enthusiasm and ideas presented, particularly in Pune, were noteworthy.

We extend our congratulations to all participants, winners, and organizers for making FIT.Fest’25 a success.


 


 





Rise to Inspire @ BGSW #ManaHyderabad – Innovation in Action

We hosted three powerful Rise to Inspire sessions that showcased how teams across our organization are driving transformation, efficiency, and intelligent automation.

🔧 Client Migration Engine (CME) – 16 Dec 2025
The project team demonstrated how CME is revolutionizing carve-out migrations at Bosch by reducing user downtime by 90–100%, boosting productivity from 10 to 100 devices per day, and ensuring >99.9% data integrity. This scalable automation framework has delivered significant operational savings and established a best-in-class migration capability for future projects.

💰 SMITE Cost Savings Initiative – 09 Dec 2025
@Stanley Christopher A (BD/SLP-IN3) shared how the SMITE team drove measurable cost savings through systematic process improvements and disciplined execution. Their approach offers a practical blueprint that other teams can adopt to enhance operational efficiency and optimize resource utilization.

🤖 Agentic AI Ecosystem – 28 Oct 2025
A fascinating deep dive into how Agentic AI is transforming static documents into intelligent, context-aware digital assets. By enabling autonomous agents to reason, collaborate, and act across knowledge systems, this ecosystem accelerates compliance, creation, and decision-making while powering smarter, connected workflows.

👏 A big thank you to all presenters for sharing impactful innovations and inspiring others to explore new possibilities.


 


 






#TribePune | Experts Drive Cybersecurity Awareness at C4i4 Lab's Elevates_Program  

Fusion, BGSW Pune's dynamic initiative is designed to create high-performing, inter-disciplinary teams to drive digital transformation, forge powerful external partnerships, and build a boundaryless future. Under this initiative, recently, Trivedi Hiral Shashank (MS/ECL4) delivered a crucial training session on "Cybersecurity Trends and Best Practices for Industry 4.0" at the Center for Industry 4.0 (C4i4) Lab in Pune. She was accompanied by Sharma Vishnu (MS/ECL4).

This engagement was part of the third "Elevates_Program," a collaborative 2-day in-person training on Digital Manufacturing & Cybersecurity, co-organized by C4i4 Lab and SPPU Research Park Foundation. C4i4 Lab operates under the national SAMARTH Udyog initiative, launched by the Department of Heavy Industries, Government of India.

The session championed a "Secure by Design" approach, emphasizing cybersecurity as a foundational principle from the initial design phase of Industry 4.0 systems. This mindset not only strengthens overall security but also mitigates future complexities. Discussions also delved into current cybersecurity challenges, the evolving threat landscape, and best practices tailored for the Industry 4.0 ecosystem. A significant highlight was the showcase of BGSW’s (MS/ECY) Cybersecurity Portfolio, Services & Offerings, Innovations & Products, and tools.

The training proved highly interactive and drew a diverse audience, including post-graduate and MBA students, PhD scholars, and seasoned industry professionals. This rich mix of participants enriched discussions, fostering a comprehensive understanding of cybersecurity considerations within the I4.0 landscape.




 


 





Advancing Impactful Leadership: BGSW #ManaHyderabad SheRise community and CII-IWN 
host Executive Presence Session

Our #ManaHyderabad SheRise community recently hosted an incredible session on "Executive Presence: The Mark of Impactful Leadership" in collaboration with the CII Indian Women Network (IWN) Telangana.

The energy in the room was palpable as women associates explored what it truly means to lead with confidence, clarity, and credibility. From mastering communication to leading with authenticity, the feedback has been overwhelmingly positive, with attendees highlighting how valuable these practical leadership tools are for their career journeys.

A huge thank you to our guest speaker, Hema M Srinivas, for her masterclass in projecting composure and strengthening professional influence. We are proud to see our associates investing in their growth and shaping the future of leadership at Bosch!


 


 






#TribePune | Christmas Celebration 

Associates gathered to celebrate Christmas with festive cheer, while a CSR-led flea market added meaning and fun to the celebrations


 


 





Year-End Cob Mind Buddy Celebration: A Day of Connection, Reflection & Cheer

The Cob Mind Buddy Team wrapped 2025 on a meaningful note with Year-End Celebration, a special gathering that brought together positivity, gratitude and heartfelt appreciation. 

The event created the perfect space for buddies to reconnect, celebrate the journey we’ve had together during the year. Dr.J.Nicolas our In-House Psychologist distributed Certificate on behalf of Health and Wellbeing Team for buddies who actively supported the Mind Buddy initiatives throughout the year and acknowledge the impact we’ve made on each other throughout the year.

As we step into a new year, we carry forward the same energy, commitment, and encouragement continuing to uplift and inspire one another. Here’s to many more meaningful connections ahead!


 


 





Wisdom Wednesdays - Enhancing ABAP Development Efficiency with Joule for Developers 

The session explained how Joule for Developers enhances ABAP development by automating repetitive tasks and providing intelligent code recommendations, thereby boosting productivity, improving code quality, and enabling developers to focus on high-value SAP solutions.

Subject: Security Alert: CEO Impersonation/WhatsApp Scam - Bosch India
Body:
Dear Boschlers,

 

It has come to our notice that some associates have received WhatsApp messages and phone calls from unknown numbers, where the callers are spoofing / impersonating senior executives of the organization. 

 

Please DO NOT respond to such messages or calls. Delete the messages immediately and block the numbers. 

 

Please remember: 

1.	As per Bosch Information Security and Data Protection guidelines, no official communication is conducted over WhatsApp or personal messaging platforms. 

2.	No senior executive of Bosch India will contact associates via WhatsApp regarding internal business matters, confidential information, or financial transactions. 

3.	Any message or call requesting urgent action, sharing of information, or transfer of money should be treated as highly suspicious. 

4.	Remain alert and do not engage with such messages or callers. 

5.	Report any such incidents immediately to your DSP (Data Protection & Information Security Partner), Department Manager, BDO. 

 

Important awareness links:  

*	IT Security Knowledge Base - EN - CEO Fraud, President Scam - risk of unwanted cash outflow <https://inside-docupedia.bosch.com/confluence/display/OSKB/EN+-+CEO+Fraud%2C+President+Scam+-+risk+of+unwanted+cash+outflow>

	Pre-Go-live Information of Citi Corporate Credit Card Queries via GS Service Platform

Jan 8th 2026



   In Short:

*	The Citi Corporate Credit Card queries mailbox will be deactivated, and
	all inquiries will be managed through the GS Service Platform (ESM)
*	Go-Live Date: Jan 8th, 2026.
*	Your primary contact for support request will be GS Service Platform

________________________________

Dear Users,

We would like to inform that all Corporate CITI Credit Card applicants and holders from Bosch India entities should use GS Service Platform (ESM) <https://gbs.bosch.com/esc?id=sc_cat_item&sys_id=90575d2cebdf1610c0c6f24e0bd0cd63>  from the 8th of Jan 2026 for all Citi Corporate Credit Card related queries. 

 <https://gbs.bosch.com/esc?id=emp_taxonomy_topic&topic_id=153e38041b9041106b8efd149b4bcb3d&in_context=true> 

	

 

 

 

 

 

 

	What …?

The primary channel for you to submit the queries will be the GS Service Platform (ESM) <https://gbs.bosch.com/esc?id=sc_cat_item&sys_id=90575d2cebdf1610c0c6f24e0bd0cd63> , as the email option will be switched off.

 <https://gbs.bosch.com/esc?id=emp_taxonomy_topic&topic_id=153e38041b9041106b8efd149b4bcb3d&in_context=true> 

	

 

 

 

 

 

 

	Why …?

Submitting your query via the GS Service Portal ensures a higher quality support and transparency and real time updates.

You will have the possibility to accept or reject a proposed resolution and to provide valuable feedback.

All this will lead to an improved and faster support.

 

 <https://gbs.bosch.com/esc?id=emp_taxonomy_topic&topic_id=153e38041b9041106b8efd149b4bcb3d&in_context=true> 

	

 

 

 

 

 

 

	How …?

From 8th of Jan 2026 you can go to the platform and raise your request directly via GS Service Platform.

Reaching our team via phone is possible via +91 80 3720 0321.

	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
For more information visit our BGN or Docupedia page where we give updates regularly.

January 2026

 <https://cdn.mailing.bosch.com/img2/sth7o/b6f688dc-1b5b-4edb-833f-c042d715a2c0/content> 	

Dear Bosch Associate,

Following the Zünder Online interview <https://cdn.mailing.bosch.com/lnk/AW0AAIsNXPIAAc59xyIABA9B-v4AAYKKXQcAoiQvACuIGwBpXC1l7EarZXRnQd2f68QvNifmsQAMld4/1/JVktJHb6p__yHzXxz2-voQ/aHR0cHM6Ly9iem8uYm9zY2guY29tL2J6by9lbi9hcnRpY2xlX3BhZ2VfNjU5MzkyLmh0bWw>  with Tanja Rückert, here’s the key news on the enhancement of your AskBosch experience: from today all Bosch standard IT users have access to AskBosch powered by Gemini Enterprise. As Bosch Digital, we're focused on providing all Bosch colleagues with practical and secure AI capabilities, and this rollout is an important step toward that goal.
 

What does this mean to you? 
This enhanced platform brings you a powerful suite of AI capabilities designed to help you work smarter, save time, and focus on innovation. 
 

You can now leverage advanced AI to:

*	Get answers faster: Address complex questions quickly.
*	Automate routines: Streamline repetitive processes.
*	Break language barriers: Translate texts effortlessly.
*	Accelerate development: Assist in writing software code.
*	Gain insights instantly: utilize NotebookLM to upload multiple documents for deep inquiry. 

And much more! 
 

How to access the AI platform: 

1.	Log In and Explore: Access AskBosch powered by Gemini Enterprise directly via [Link] <https://cdn.mailing.bosch.com/lnk/AW0AAIsNXPIAAc59xyIABA9B-v4AAYKKXQcAoiQvACuIGwBpXC1l7EarZXRnQd2f68QvNifmsQAMld4/2/eQ-cJS41G7HLrhGM3fYBmQ/aHR0cHM6Ly9hY2NvdW50cy5nb29nbGUuY29tL0FjY291bnRDaG9vc2VyP2hkPWJvc2NoLmNvbSZjb250aW51ZT1odHRwczovL3ZlcnRleGFpc2VhcmNoLmNsb3VkLmdvb2dsZS5jb20vZXUvaG9tZS9jaWQvYmNiMzgzZjEtMjZkOC00MWZkLTlhNTUtNjIzZjdlOTNkZTky> . Your Bosch managed Google Account and access to Gemini Enterprise is already enabled. Please use the following email address when asked for a Google Account during log in: "<NT-UserID>@bosch.com” where <NT-UserID> refers to you internal Bosch NT user identifier. Tip: in case of issues, logout from all other Google Accounts and then login at Google with the Bosch managed Google Account with the userid "<NT-UserID>@bosch.com”. Also, the OneIDM role has been already applied for you to ensure you have access.
2.	Learn and Grow: To help you get started and unlock the full potential of this powerful tool, we've prepared comprehensive training materials and resources. Explore them here: [Link] <https://cdn.mailing.bosch.com/lnk/AW0AAIsNXPIAAc59xyIABA9B-v4AAYKKXQcAoiQvACuIGwBpXC1l7EarZXRnQd2f68QvNifmsQAMld4/3/zLhaCw9N7lDw7IAi6NyV0A/aHR0cHM6Ly9ib3NjaC5tZWRpYXNwYWNlLmRlLmthbHR1cmEuY29tL2NoYW5uZWwvQXNrQm9zY2glMkJwb3dlcmVkJTJCYnklMkJHZW1pbmklMkJFbnRlcnByaXNlLzM5NTM4MA> 
3.	Find Answers: For detailed guidance and frequently asked questions, please refer to our landing page <https://cdn.mailing.bosch.com/lnk/AW0AAIsNXPIAAc59xyIABA9B-v4AAYKKXQcAoiQvACuIGwBpXC1l7EarZXRnQd2f68QvNifmsQAMld4/4/NVhbQKFHGUGeTycuv79INA/aHR0cHM6Ly9kaWdpdGFsLmJvc2NoLmNvbS9vdHA_aWQ9b3RwX29mZmVyaW5nJnN5c19pZD1lOWNhNDUyNGMzYWNiMjEwZWQ5MDNmY2YwNTAxMzEzNQ> .

A platform that evolves with you 
This launch is just the beginning! We are committed to continuously developing and enhancing AskBosch powered by Gemini Enterprise. Expect a stream of exciting new features and capabilities to be rolled out, further expanding what's possible and keeping you at the forefront of AI-driven productivity. 
 

The future of AskBosch: Advancing through Google Gemini technology 
AskBosch remains your standard way to interact with Large Language Models at Bosch. We are just evolving its technological foundation by migrating to the Google Gemini Enterprise ecosystem and phasing out the current version, ensuring a cost efficient, continuously enhanced and future-proof AI experience. 
 

Should you require any technical assistance, please raise a ticket through the IT Service Portal <https://cdn.mailing.bosch.com/lnk/AW0AAIsNXPIAAc59xyIABA9B-v4AAYKKXQcAoiQvACuIGwBpXC1l7EarZXRnQd2f68QvNifmsQAMld4/5/F66Cgfh8ob7NnrZQO1OpCA/aHR0cHM6Ly9zcGVhci5zZXJ2aWNlLW1hbmFnZW1lbnQuYm9zY2gudGVjaC9zdXBwb3J0> .
 

We are excited about the possibilities this new era of AI brings to each of us. 
 

Best regards, 
Program Team Agentic AI@Bosch

*	Efforts submitted in the BGSW effort booking tool will be considered as auto-approved, if not approved by respective timecard controller within 3 calendar days from the date of submission.

Body:
Dear All, 

 

BTC-IN has an upcoming program on Inclusive Leadership and invites self-nominations for this session. Kindly feel free to register and participate in the workshop.

 

Inclusive Leadership on 22nd Jan, its an essential skill set for fostering diverse, equitable, and collaborative work environments.

 

Session Date: 22nd Jan 2026

Self Registration Link: 500258 <https://performancemanagerrot.successfactors.eu/sf/learning?destUrl=https%3a%2f%2fbosch%2eplateau%2ecom%2flearning%2fuser%2fdeeplink%5fredirect%2ejsp%3flinkId%3dSCHEDULED%5fOFFERING%5fDETAILS%26scheduleID%3d500258%26fromSF%3dY&company=BOSCH> 

Registration Cuttoff date: 16th Jan 2026

Venue / Location: BLC

 

This session is designed to empower participants with the tools and insights needed to lead inclusively, create psychologically safe spaces, and drive team performance through empathy and awareness.

 

We are now inviting nominations for individuals who:

*	Exhibit leadership potential or currently hold leadership roles
*	Are passionate about inclusion, equity, and diversity
*	Can influence positive change within their teams or departments 

 

Session content: 

 

Part 1: Understanding Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI) 
• Learn about how Diversity manifests and the value it brings to the workplace 
• Differentiating between Equality, Parity, Equity, Inclusion & Belongingness 
• Understanding the cost of Exclusion 
• Micro-aggressions and their role in creating toxicity 
• Learning the business impact of an included diverse workforce 

Part 2: Self as an Instrument of Change 
• Unpacking conscious / unconscious biases and understanding their impact 
• Assessing privilege, power and rank within systems 
• The Paradox of Diversity 
• Understanding the role of influence on team dynamics and business outcomes 
• Learning how to be an instrument of change within one’s professional ecosystem 

Part 3: Inclusive Leadership 
• Learning the components of Inclusivity 
• The persona of an Inclusive Leader 
• The to do’s of Inclusive Leadership 
• Case studies of Inclusion and non-Inclusion 

Part 4: Implementing Equity & Inclusion 
• Understanding organizational Allyship and its archetypes. 
• Learning from what works and what doesn’t. 
• Practices that create Equity & Inclusion in an organization. 
• Creating my individual DEI Playbook 

 

 

Mit freundlichen Grüßen / Best regards,

Subject: Moving forward with confidence and determination --- Deutsche Sprachversion siehe unten ---
Body:
Bosch: For additional languages and PDF files, click here. <https://bgn.bosch.com/FIRSTspiritWeb/permlink/wcms_c_-hartung_letter_jan_3-EN> 
BSH: For additional languages and PDF files, click here. <https://intranet.bsh-group.com/x/KglAZ> 

Dear Bosch team,

In challenging times, it's important to focus on our strengths. This is not always easy. Yet especially when the path is steep and difficult, we need two things: confidence in our abilities and the determination to move forward with a firm step.

We have encountered many obstacles over the course of 2025. The structural change in the global economy affects all our business sectors. Key markets are developing only weakly. Added to this are geopolitical uncertainties, profound technological shifts in our industries, and fierce competition. In view of these unfavorable conditions, we must become more competitive and make lasting cost improvements. The personnel adjustment measures needed are painful. This is especially true for those associates directly affected, but it also weighs heavily on our entire organization.

All of us on the board of management are fully aware of the consequences of these decisions. And we understand the strong criticism of the extensive measures. Nevertheless, we must tackle and implement these adjustments now. After all, as management, we are responsible for securing our company's future and rigorously driving its long-term development. This commitment reflects the intentions of our company's founder as set out in his will. At its core, our goal is always to preserve Bosch's entrepreneurial freedom and financial independence. This is our bedrock. Only in this way can we continue to create on our own terms technology that is "Invented for life"!

The difficult environment is also reflected in our key financial figures. From an economic perspective, 2025 was not a satisfactory year. According to preliminary figures, we generated sales revenue of roughly 91 billion euros. That includes the acquired Johnson Controls-Hitachi business. Yet it merely matches last year's level, more or less. Moreover, we remain far from our target earnings margin. It is expected to fall well below 2 percent of revenue, largely reflecting provisions in connection with the restructuring measures needed.

Nevertheless, I look ahead to 2026 with confidence. Over the past challenging year, we have taken important steps to position ourselves for the future. We have continued to systematically implement our strategy and have reached key milestones. Time and again, we demonstrated our resilience and strength. As the world's largest automotive supplier, we deliver smart software and sophisticated hardware from a single source. We work closely with partners to further advance automated driving with the assistance of artificial intelligence. Beyond this, we are a valued partner in many other business fields thanks to our innovative strength, our global presence, and our manufacturing expertise. This spans business areas ranging from e-bikes and smart household appliances to connected construction machinery and quantum technology.

Across all business sectors, we succeeded last year in winning major orders and inspiring customers with new products. At the same time, we continue to drive sustainable mobility forward. Our fuel cell drive system was recently awarded the German Future Prize. This recognition is testament to our technological expertise. More than that, it serves as motivation to continue developing and commercializing the technologies of the day after tomorrow.

We are also continuing to invest in tomorrow's markets and in establishing a more balanced regional footprint. In 2025, for example, we completed the acquisition of the heating and air-conditioning business of Johnson Controls-Hitachi. This move strengthens our product portfolio as well as our regional presence in the United States and Asia. The U.S. market also remains attractive for our consumer goods business. We want to raise our profile there with creative marketing initiatives and gain market share in power tools and household appliances. Expanding our AI infrastructure also remains a key priority. Indeed, artificial intelligence is both a key technology and a driver of innovation for Bosch. We have already registered over 2,000 patents in the field of AI. More than 100,000 of you have already taken advantage of our training and development programs. This is essential, as what ultimately matters is the consistent application of the new tools in our daily work. Generative and agentic AI in particular can make a decisive contribution to our competitiveness.

Over the past year, many of you have shown exceptional commitment. Your determination to seize every opportunity for our company was clearly evident to us on the board of management. We saw it in the many personal and open discussions, during visits to our company sites worldwide, and in your day-to-day work. On behalf of the entire board of management, I would like to express our sincere gratitude.

Our ambition for the coming years is clear: We want to lead the way and actively shape the future. We want to improve people's lives with our innovations and become one of the three leading players in our core markets. We aim to drive progress, shape the future of software-defined mobility, and pioneer the use of new technologies such as AI.

Together, we are shaping the future of Bosch by strengthening our portfolio, driving innovation forward, gaining market share wherever opportunities arise, and clearly differentiating ourselves from the competition. Let's break new ground, while remaining firmly focused on our strengths!


Warmest regards
Stefan Hartung
Chairman of the board of management of Robert Bosch GmbH

Bosch: Weitere Sprachen und PDF-Dateien finden Sie hier. <https://bgn.bosch.com/FIRSTspiritWeb/permlink/wcms_c_-hartung_letter_jan_3-EN> 
BSH: Weitere Sprachen und PDF-Dateien finden Sie hier. <https://intranet.bsh-group.com/x/KQlAZ> 

Liebes Bosch-Team,

in herausfordernden Zeiten ist es wichtig, sich auf die eigenen Stärken zu besinnen. Das ist nicht einfach. Aber gerade, wenn der Weg steil und beschwerlich ist, braucht man zweierlei: Vertrauen in die eigenen Fähigkeiten und Entschlossenheit, mit festem Schritt voranzugehen.

2025 hat uns viele Steine in den Weg gelegt. Der strukturelle Wandel der globalen Wirtschaft betrifft all unsere Unternehmensbereiche. Wichtige Märkte entwickeln sich nur schwach. Hinzu kommen geopolitische Unsicherheiten, tiefgreifende technologische Veränderungen in unseren Branchen und ein verschärfter Wettbewerb. Angesichts dieser unvorteilhaften Rahmenbedingungen müssen wir wettbewerbsfähiger werden und unsere Kosten nachhaltig senken. Die dafür erforderlichen Personalanpassungsmaßnahmen sind schmerzhaft. Insbesondere für die betroffenen Mitarbeitenden, aber auch für unsere gesamte Organisation.

Die Tragweite dieser Entscheidungen ist uns als Geschäftsführung vollkommen bewusst. Auch verstehen wir die massive Kritik an den umfangreichen Maßnahmen. Dennoch müssen wir diese Veränderungen jetzt angehen und umsetzen. Denn als Geschäftsführung tragen wir die Verantwortung, unser Unternehmen zukunftssicher aufzustellen und langfristig kraftvoll weiterzuentwickeln. So erfüllen wir das testamentarische Erbe unseres Unternehmensgründers. Im Kern wollen wir mit unseren Entscheidungen stets dafür sorgen, die unternehmerische Selbstständigkeit und finanzielle Unabhängigkeit von Bosch zu bewahren. Das ist die Grundlage. Nur so können wir weiterhin selbstbestimmt Technik fürs Leben schaffen!

Die schwierige Lage spiegelt sich auch in unseren Kennzahlen. Wirtschaftlich war 2025 kein zufriedenstellendes Jahr. Unser Umsatz lag nach vorläufigen Zahlen bei rund 91 Milliarden Euro, inklusive des zugekauften Geschäfts von Johnson Controls-Hitachi. Das entspricht knapp dem Vorjahresniveau. Von unserer Zielrendite ist unser Ergebnis weit weg. Es liegt voraussichtlich bei deutlich unter 2 Prozent vom Umsatz, vor allem beeinflusst durch Rückstellungen für die erforderlichen Restrukturierungsmaßnahmen.

Ich blicke dennoch mit Zuversicht auf 2026. Denn im anspruchsvollen vergangenen Jahr haben wir große Schritte in Richtung Zukunft unternommen. Wir haben unsere Strategie weiter konsequent umgesetzt und wichtige Meilensteine erreicht. Auch haben wir Widerstandskraft bewiesen, vielfach Stärke gezeigt. Als größter Autozulieferer der Welt liefern wir smarte Software und anspruchsvolle Hardware aus einer Hand. In enger Partnerschaft entwickeln wir das automatisierte Fahren mithilfe von künstlicher Intelligenz weiter. Auch in vielen weiteren Geschäftsfeldern sind wir dank unserer Innovationskraft, unserer globalen Präsenz sowie unserer Fertigungskompetenz begehrter Partner. Sei es bei E-Bikes, bei smarten Hausgeräten, vernetzten Baumaschinen oder in der Quantentechnologie.

In all unseren Unternehmensbereichen konnten wir im vergangenen Jahr wichtige Kundenaufträge gewinnen und mit neuen Produkten begeistern. Ebenso treiben wir die nachhaltige Mobilität weiter voran. Jüngst wurde unser Brennstoffzellen-Antriebssystem mit dem Deutschen Zukunftspreis ausgezeichnet. Das ist Ausdruck unserer technologischen Kompetenz. Mehr noch: Diese Auszeichnung ist Ansporn, weiterhin Technologien von übermorgen zu entwickeln und zu kommerzialisieren.

Wir investieren außerdem weiter in die Märkte von morgen sowie in unsere regionale Balance. So haben wir 2025 den Zukauf des Heizungs- und Klimageschäfts von Johnson Controls-Hitachi abgeschlossen. Damit stärken wir unser Produktspektrum sowie unsere regionale Präsenz in den USA und Asien. Die USA bleiben auch für unsere Konsumgüter ein attraktiver Markt. Hier wollen wir mit kreativen Marketingmaßnahmen bekannter werden und Marktanteile bei Elektrowerkzeugen und Hausgeräten gewinnen. Auch der Ausbau unserer KI-Infrastruktur bleibt eine Priorität für uns. Denn künstliche Intelligenz ist für Bosch sowohl Schlüsseltechnologie als auch Innovationstreiber. Mehr als 2.000 Patente haben wir im KI-Bereich bereits angemeldet. Mehr als 100.000 von Ihnen haben bereits unser Aus- und Weiterbildungsangebot in diesem Bereich genutzt. Das ist essenziell. Denn entscheidend wird sein, die neuen Werkzeuge in unserer täglichen Arbeit konsequent anzuwenden. Gerade generative und agentische KI können uns helfen, wettbewerbsfähiger zu werden.

Viele von Ihnen haben im vergangenen Jahr besonders hohen Einsatz gezeigt. Der Wille, alle Chancen für unser Unternehmen zu nutzen, war für uns in der Geschäftsführung deutlich spürbar. Er zeigte sich in vielen persönlichen und vertrauensvollen Gesprächen, bei Besuchen an unseren weltweiten Standorten und in Ihrer täglichen Arbeit. Dafür möchte ich mich im Namen des Geschäftsführungsteams bei Ihnen herzlich bedanken!

Unser Anspruch für die kommenden Jahre ist klar: Wir wollen vorangehen und gestalten. Mit unseren Innovationen das Leben von Menschen verbessern. In unseren Kernmärkten zu den drei führenden Unternehmen gehören. Wir wollen den Fortschritt vorantreiben, die Zukunft der softwaregetriebenen Mobilität prägen und Vorreiter in der Nutzung neuer Technologien wie KI sein.

Gemeinsam arbeiten wir an der Zukunft von Bosch. Indem wir unser Portfolio stärken. Innovationen voranbringen. Marktanteile gewinnen, wo immer sich Chancen bieten. Uns vom Wettbewerb abheben. Lassen Sie uns neue Wege gehen – und uns gleichzeitig auf unsere Stärken besinnen!


Herzlichst,
Ihr Stefan Hartung
Vorsitzender der Geschäftsführung der Robert Bosch GmbH

Develop authentic executive presence by aligning self-awareness, values, and communication style to project confidence, credibility, and trust. Apply verbal, non-verbal, and emotional intelligence skills to influence, engage, and lead effectively in high-impact professional settings..

Dear Associates,

 

We are reiterating the key OLPV Policy rules to ensure full compliance. Non-compliance and requests for exceptions continue to be observed, potentially triggering audit findings and delays.

 

Please prioritize these guidelines for all reimbursement requests.

 

Core Rules:

*	GST-Compliant Invoices: Submit invoices with clear GST details meeting legal standards. Non-GST compliant invoices will not be reimbursed. If the vendor is GST-exempt, upload a vendor email confirmation stating the same.

 

*	Payment Proof Mandatory: Attach valid proof for every claim. Acceptable proofs include:

	*	UPI transaction screenshots
	*	Bank statement extracts
		Note: Cash payments or text messages are strictly not accepted as proof and will lead to rejection.

 

These requirements, in addition to those mentioned in the policy are non-negotiable. Adhere strictly to avoid personal and organizational audit exposure.

Dear Colleagues,

 

We are pleased to share details of the upcoming CII–IWN event. 

 

7th Edition of the CII-IWN Southern Region "Say Yes Annual Leadership Conclave"

17th & 18th February 2026 : Hotel Radisson Blu, Kochi

 

 

Greetings from Indian Women Network (IWN)!

 

We are happy to announce the 7th Edition of the CII-IWN Southern Region "Say Yes Annual Leadership Conclave" scheduled on 17th & 18th February 2026 at Hotel Radisson Blu, Sahodaran Ayyappan Road, Near Elamkulam Metro Station, Elamkulam, Kochi, Kerala.

 

The theme for this year Conclave is "Lead the Change, Shape the Future", captures what leadership today demands: the courage to boldly venture into the unknown and the vision to shape tomorrow’s reality, by creating it today.  This is not a distant aspiration—it is a present, strategic imperative. The future is already unfolding, and those who act with foresight and conviction today are the ones shaping it. This agenda calls for leaders who anticipate change, influence outcomes, and ignite transformation across every sphere.

 

The Conclave seeks to create a platform where women leaders, entrepreneurs, policymakers, and change makers come together to share insights, inspire action, and foster collaboration for a more equitable and sustainable future.

 

As a regular practice, apart from Panel Discussions, Keynote Address and Fireside Chats, there will be Masterclasses on both days of the Conclave.

 

An e-flyer in this regard is also enclosed for your ready reference.

There is no Gender Restrictions for the event.

 

As a prelude to the Conclave, there will be a Boot Camp (an immersive learning for limited participants) that we are organizing on 16th February 2026 from 1230 – 1800 hrs at Hotel Radisson Blu, Kochi. The track ahead is challenging. Our entire industry is transforming at a breathtaking pace. Competition is intensifying, while global economic uncertainties and regional crises make for unpredictable conditions. To succeed in this race, we must become faster and more adaptable. Our current cost structures are holding us back. That's why we must systematically streamline them.

I know that restructuring creates uncertainty – especially when it involves personnel changes. But we have no alternative. And it is a task we must tackle, because our goal is to secure the long-term competitiveness and viability of Bosch Mobility. This is a responsibility we all share as one team.

So why are we, the Bosch Mobility sector board, looking to 2026 with confidence? Because at Bosch Mobility, we are accelerating and making targeted investments. Over the past year, we have secured an excellent starting position in key growth areas: ADAS, electrification, vehicle computers, and chassis systems. We have won major projects and extended our technological lead in these fields. This has laid the foundation for us to remain the leading technology partner for hardware, software, and services.

Now, the real race begins. It's about getting our solutions on the road faster with our customers and bringing our newly won projects across the finish line profitably. Reaching our target cost levels is non-negotiable. Our navigation is set:


*	Simplify: We are streamlining the processes and structures that slow us down. We are empowering our teams and business units by giving responsibility to those with the expertise. More trust, less bureaucracy.
	
	
*	Sync: You can only win a race as a team. We are strengthening our global partnerships to acquire new skills and innovate more quickly together.
	
	
*	Supercharge: We are optimizing the commercialization of our projects, for instance, through the targeted use of artificial intelligence. This makes us not only more efficient but also more precise and powerful. 

To achieve all this, we need to drive with courage and a clear compass. We need the courage to take calculated risks. And the courage to learn quickly from mistakes, correct our course, and keep moving forward. We want a culture built on trust in each individual's competence, not one that seeks to cover all bases at any cost.

Our decisive advantage is our unique position – from chip to cloud, across all vehicle domains. This is what lets us rapidly adapt solutions for local markets and scale them globally, not least thanks to our top position in the lead market of China. Our goal is ambitious: by 2030, we aim to be on the podium in all our core businesses – to be among the top three.

It's now up to us to bring our full power to the track and drive our success home. I am firmly convinced that we will achieve this – with our technological excellence and the outstanding expertise of our team. This is what I'm counting on; it's what we are all counting on.

We will present our detailed course in the strategy livestream on January 27, where we will explain the concrete steps for implementing our strategy. A Zünder online article will follow. 

We have everything it takes to win.

Let's get to it!

Best regards,
Markus Heyn 


________________________________


 
Liebe Kolleginnen und Kollegen,

die Startampeln stehen auf Grün. Vor uns liegt ein anspruchsvolles, aber chancenreiches neues Jahr. Unser gemeinsames Ziel ist klar: Wir wollen auf die Überholspur – und das Rennen um die Mobilität der Zukunft anführen.

	
 <https://bosch.mediaspace.de.kaltura.com/media/0_hghnmp59> 


 
Die Strecke ist herausfordernd. Die gesamte Branche transformiert sich in atemberaubendem Tempo. Der Wettbewerb wird härter, globale wirtschaftliche Unsicherheiten und regionale Krisen machen die Bedingungen unberechenbar. Um in diesem Rennen bestehen zu können, müssen wir schneller und anpassungsfähiger werden. Unsere aktuellen Kostenstrukturen bremsen uns aus. Deshalb müssen wir sie konsequent verschlanken.

Ich weiß, dass Restrukturierung verunsichert – erst recht, wenn sie mit personellen Veränderungen einhergeht. Aber wir haben keine Alternative! Und die Umsetzung müssen wir sicherstellen, denn unser Ziel ist, die Zukunfts- und Wettbewerbsfähigkeit von Bosch Mobility langfristig zu sichern. Diese Verantwortung tragen wir gemeinsam als Team.

Warum blicken wir als Sektorvorstand zuversichtlich auf 2026? Weil wir als Bosch Mobility beschleunigen und gezielt investieren. Wir haben uns im vergangenen Jahr eine hervorragende Startposition in den entscheidenden Wachstumsfeldern erarbeitet: ADAS, Elektrifizierung, Fahrzeugcomputer und Chassis-Systeme. Hier konnten wir wichtige Projekte gewinnen und unseren technologischen Vorsprung ausbauen. Damit haben wir das Fundament gelegt, um führender Technologiepartner zu bleiben – für Hardware, Software und Services.

Jetzt beginnt das eigentliche Rennen. Es geht darum, unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit den Kunden schneller auf die Strecke zu bringen und die gewonnenen Projekte profitabel ins Ziel zu führen. Wir müssen unbedingt das Zielkostenniveau erreichen. Unsere Navigation dorthin steht:


*	Vereinfachen: Wir verschlanken Prozesse und Strukturen, die uns bremsen. Wir geben Verantwortung dorthin, wo die Expertise liegt – in unsere Teams und die Fachbereiche. Mehr Vertrauen, weniger Bürokratie.
	
	
*	Verbinden: Ein Rennen gewinnt man nur im Team. Wir intensivieren unsere globalen Partnerschaften, um gemeinsam schneller neue Fähigkeiten zu erwerben und innovativer zu werden.
	
	
*	Verbessern: Wir optimieren die Industrialisierung unserer Projekte, zum Beispiel durch den gezielten Einsatz künstlicher Intelligenz. Das macht uns nicht nur effizienter, sondern auch präziser und schlagkräftiger. 

Für all das brauchen wir eine mutige Fahrweise und einen klaren Kompass. Mut, auch kalkulierte Risiken einzugehen. Und Mut, aus Fehlern schnell zu lernen, den Kurs zu korrigieren und weiterzumachen. Wir wollen eine Kultur, die auf Vertrauen in die Kompetenz jedes Einzelnen setzt, nicht auf Absicherung um jeden Preis.

Unser entscheidender Vorteil ist unsere einzigartige Aufstellung – vom Chip bis zur Cloud, über alle Fahrzeugdomänen hinweg. Das erlaubt uns, Lösungen schnell für lokale Märkte anzupassen und global zu skalieren, nicht zuletzt dank unserer Top-Position im Leitmarkt China. Das Ziel ist ambitioniert: Bis 2030 wollen wir in allen unseren Kerngeschäften auf dem Podium stehen – zu den Top-Drei gehören.

Jetzt liegt es an uns, die volle Leistung auf die Strecke zu bringen und den Erfolg einzufahren. Ich bin fest davon überzeugt, dass wir das schaffen – mit unserer technologischen Exzellenz und dem herausragenden Know-how unserer Mannschaft. Darauf baue ich, darauf bauen wir alle.

Den detaillierten Kurs stellen wir am 27. Januar im Strategie-Livestream vor. Dort erläutern wir, wie wir unsere Strategie konkret umsetzen, gefolgt von einem Zünder-Online-Artikel. 

Wir haben alles, um zu gewinnen.

Packen wir es an!

Mit besten Grüßen 
Markus Heyn

23rd January 2026


 






Bio-Garden

On 3rd March 2022, a simple belief took root at BGSW that nurturing the earth could also nurture people. From that moment, the Bio-Garden community began its quiet transformation into a living, breathing space of connection, learning, and well-being. Over time, it has become a place where hands meet soil, conversations grow alongside plants, and families come together to share moments of calm and purpose. Experiences like “Experience with Datta” (Nov 2024) deepened collective learning, while the Coimbatore Bio-Garden Walk-Through (Apr 2025) invited participants to slow down and rediscover the joy of sustainable living. As a proud pillar of FIT.Kovai, the inter-corporate platform for holistic fitness launched at BGSW COB in November 2024, the garden has also opened its gates to counter-partners, creating meaningful green connections beyond our campus. 

Last year, we celebrated the growth and spirit of the Bio-Garden, and this coming March, we will mark its fourth anniversary. Over the past three wonderful years, this growing movement has blossomed into a vibrant space with 15+ varieties of vegetables, 30+ fruit and flowering trees, innovative IoT-enabled watering systems, and creative vertical gardens. With 250+ passionate members and activities flourishing throughout weekdays and weekends, the Bio-Garden is a living testament to what we can achieve together. It reminds us that when we nurture nature, we do far more than grow gardens—we cultivate community, connection, and care.

"In every seed we plant, a story of growth, connection, and hope begins."
