Subject: Newsletter on National Safety Day-2026 and Introducing an email for reporting EHS Concerns
Body:
Dear Boschlers,

 

National Safety Day is observed every year on 4th March to promote awareness about workplace safety, health, and environmental protection. The day marks the foundation of the National Safety Council in 1966 and aims to reinforce the importance of following safe work practices across industries/organization. 

 

The 2026 National Safety Day theme, “Engage, Educate and Empower,” is highly relevant for an IT corporate environment where employee well-being, ergonomics, data center safety, and mental health play a crucial role. 

 

In an office-based setup, 

Engage means actively encouraging employees to report unsafe conditions, ergonomic concerns, electrical hazards, or stress-related issues. 

 

Educate focuses on regular awareness sessions on workstation ergonomics, fire safety, emergency evacuation procedures, cybersecurity practices, and overall health and wellness. 

 

Empower enables employees to take ownership by following safe work practices, participating in drills, using equipment responsibly, and supporting a culture where safety concerns can be raised without hesitation. 

 

Promoted by the National Safety Council, this theme reinforces that even in a technology-driven corporate setting, safety remains a shared responsibility that supports productivity, resilience, and sustainable growth.

 

 

 

 

 

 

 





 

 

 

 

 

 

 

As part of our commitment to EHSS (Environment, Health, Safety & Sustainability), we encourage all employees to proactively raise any safety observations, near-miss incidents, unsafe conditions, or environmental concerns.

 





 

Best Regards,

BGSW Marketing and Communications

Subject: Technical Upgrade 2026 - Testing Schedule & Productive Systems Downtime (POE, PA5, P98)
Body:
Dear Boschlers, 

As part of the central project initiated by M/BD1 and M/BDX-GT1-PJ, there is a plan for technical upgrade of ERP systems (POE, PA5, P98 etc.) and SAP BI systems (PIF, PBL) scheduled this year.

This upgrade will ensure improved application security, functionality, stability, and compliance with our contractual obligations with SAP. No process changes will be implemented as part of TU2026.

The production systems must be shut down for the final upgrade. Downtime of the production systems is planned as:

SAP BI: 5th and 6th June 2026 (Fri-Sat, approx. 25 hours) (Systems: PIF, PBL) 

SAP ERP (R/3): 11th and 12th Jul 2026 (Sat-Sun, approx. 8 hours) (Systems: P98, POE, PA5 etc.) 

 The exact timelines will be announced later.

Important Information:

Schedule of testing: testing will be performed by Key Users (KUs) with support of PST.

*	Acceptance testing: 13th Apr 2026 to 8th May 2026
*	Bridge Test: 26th May 2026 to 4th June 2026
*	Approval testing: 8th Jun 2026 to 12th Jun 2026

Please plan your activities in advance to minimize any disruption in supplies to customers, during the downtime period.

For questions, please reach out to:

*	Kumawat Ratnesh (RBIN/BDO-DE2 M/BDX-GT2-Q2E)

Additionally, PST teams from RBIN/BDO, along with designated Process Experts (PEX) and KUs, will be available to provide support and clarifications as needed.

Subject: Important Update Regarding the Global Crisis and Its Impact on BGSW Operations
Body:
Dear Colleagues,

 

Recent global crisis has introduced volatility into international energy markets, potentially impacting our business operations. While our Indian government is actively working to ensure a stable energy supply, the global nature of supply chains means we might still experience some localized challenges, particularly concerning LPG, petrol, and diesel availability.

 

These fluctuations could affect our daily operations, including:

*	Cafeteria Services: Potential temporary adjustments to our menu or service due to LPG supply.
*	Transportation & Commuting: Possible impacts on employee commutes due to fuel availability and price changes.
*	Business Continuity: We are closely monitoring effects on our broader operations, especially those reliant on transportation, food, and backup energy.

 

We are proactively developing contingency plans to mitigate disruptions and ensure operational continuity.

 

We encourage all employees to remain vigilant:

*	Stay Informed: Follow reliable news sources.
*	Conserve Resources: Be mindful of energy consumption at work and home.
*	Be Prepared: Plan commutes in advance, considering potential fuel disruptions.

 

Working together, we can effectively navigate these challenges. We will keep you updated.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

 

Regards,

GR/FCM-BGSW

Dear Vetsa Sai Vivek,

As part of the 'separation' process, you are requested to return all IT assets (Desktop / Laptop / Workstation/ Monitor) against your name to BD/PFP-IN on or before your last working day.
For the same, you are requested to raise IT Service Portal ticket.

Your Employee number is 35929442 and your last working day in BGSW is 18-Mar-2026. 

You are requested to physically come to the office at your main work location and hand over the IT assets to the BD/SLP-IN in charge at your location.

	Raise 'transfer' request from Asset management Tool: Monitor Asset Transfer to BD/PFP <https://inside.bosch.com/irj/portal?NavigationTarget=navurl://bcef4c668152e0bb0641e2fa7463f53>

	Raise ticket via IT Service Portal: Return A Computer to BD/PFP <https://service-management.bosch.tech/sp?id=sc_cat_item&sys_id=486eed501bfc615078087403dd4bcbd> 
	

	(Please provide right details of your location, building, floor and workplace number)

Subject: Stoppage of travel advance for domestic and international travel in BGSW
Body:
Dear Colleagues,

Inline with the new credit card policy- Corporate Credit Card - Finance <https://kor2vm0022.apac.bosch.com/stages/>  released on 27th February 2026, issue of Forex advance will be stopped from 15th March 2026. Also to ensure seamless business travels and to align with the compliance standards, it is mandatory to apply for the Citi Corporate Credit Card which will be the desired mode of payments for all domestic and international business travels. Whether you have travel plans or not, please apply for the Citi Corporate Card immediately.

*	To access the Citi Credit Card Application Process Guide - Click Here <https://connect.bosch.com/files/app/s/0BlQX5rKGoINDmb3B82pIDm1ljve> 
*	To access the FAQ’s and Best Practices Guide - Click Here <https://connect.bosch.com/files/app/s/3Y3Q54EP99TYWk0ljPPOF5oz7dlW> 
*	All active on-roll employees can apply for the Citi Credit Card.
Important Note:

The issuance of Forex Card and re-loads to the existing Forex cards will be stopped from 15th March 2026.
Effective 16th March 2026, the option to raise the Travel Advance request for domestic and international travels via the SWIFT system will be dis-abled.
Effective 16th March 2026, if you do not hold a Citi credit card, then you will have to use your personal credit/debit card for all your business travels.

For queries or clarifications-

Please create ticket in GS Service Platform (ESM) <https://gbs.bosch.com/esc?id=emp_taxonomy_topic&topic_id=b7dc10c8c3d4661012b7218dc00131d7>   or call the hotline +91 80 3720 0321.
Refer Training document and video <https://inside-docupedia.bosch.com/confluence/spaces/GSCSC/pages/5832000826/Contact+information>  for any clarifications related to ticket creation.

BGSW Multimarket Data and AI team’s innovative GenAI solution propels Bosch into 
India's top 50 innovative companies

Bosch Ltd. has been proudly named one of the Top 50 Innovative Companies in India by the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) for 2025. This prestigious national recognition, awarded at a ceremony in New Delhi, was significantly driven by a first-of-its-kind Generative AI solution developed by SX/EDS-MM team: Samal Ashis (SX/EDI2-MM), Arjun R (SX/EDI2-MM), Panigrahy Debasis (SX/EDI1-MM),Gokul Ajith (SX/EDI2-MM), Ranjan Vishal (SX/EDI2-MM)

The team engineered a Gen AI recommendation system designed to transform manufacturing processes. By analyzing a 
massive 6-year dataset with a Large Language Model (LLM), the solution provides intelligent, human-like recommendations for the complex task of reworking fuel injection pumps.

This innovation has reduced dependency on highly skilled operators. With the AI recommendation engine, semi-skilled operators can perform the rework with enhanced accuracy and confidence. The result is a more efficient process flow, reduced batch dispatch times, and a powerful demonstration of how Generative AI is reshaping the future of manufacturing at Bosch.

Celebrating Excellence: JLR Diesel MY28 Project Redefines Project Methodology

The BGSW PM Awards 2025 celebrate innovation, collaboration, and excellence across projects that demonstrate impactful problem-solving and strong delivery culture. These awards recognize teams that embody our organization’s values while driving meaningful progress.

We are proud to announce that the JLR Diesel MY28 Project has won the prestigious “Excellence in Project Methodology” award. This recognition highlights the team’s outstanding ability to apply and adapt project management practices to navigate complex challenges and deliver exceptional results.

The project focuses on developing Powertrain Control Modules (PCM) for Jaguar Land Rover’s 6-cylinder diesel engines, enabling compliance with the upcoming EU7 emission regulations while integrating with next-generation JLR vehicle platforms. Despite challenges such as a declining diesel market, hardware resource constraints, and evolving regulatory timelines, the team successfully turned these constraints into opportunities, securing future program continuity.

The success was driven by the team’s methodology, “Agility Unleashed – Results Delivered!”, built on four key pillars:

• Agile Transformation: A hybrid ASPICE-Agile framework with a  “Scrum of Scrums” model.

• Proactive Management: Predictive dashboards to anticipate and resolve risks early.

• Radical Collaboration: A strong one-team culture with real-time knowledge sharing.

• Intelligent Automation: CI/CD integration and optimized testing to reduce manual effort.

This recognition reflects the team’s dedication, innovation, and collaborative spirit in delivering excellence under challenging conditions. Volvo Trucks, visited Bosch Global Software Technologies (BGSW) 

On 25 February 2026, Kristina Bjelkstal, Director – Diagnostic Data Engineering at Volvo Trucks, visited Bosch Global Software Technologies (BGSW) Bengaluru to strengthen the ongoing strategic collaboration with the Bosch SDS and KAM MA teams. The visit was hosted by Raghavendra Rao Krishnamurthy, Section Head – KAM MA, and Ram Kumar, Associate Director Sales – SDS.

Bosch currently supports Volvo GTT’s Automotive Aftermarket division with end to end diagnostics content creation.

Kristina shared insights into Volvo’s diagnostics strategy, future roadmap, and global operating model—covering people capabilities, technology platforms, and process alignment.

The Bosch team showcased its capabilities and innovations through a marketplace themed around AI driven technician assistance and automated content development. The demonstrations sparked positive discussions on deeper collaboration and future growth opportunities.

As part of the visit, the team also conducted a walkthrough of the newly established satellite office at the EC location in Bengaluru, highlighting enhanced data security, improved collaboration setups, and upgraded facility infrastructure.

The visit reinforced strong leadership alignment and a shared vision to advance next generation diagnostics solutions, strengthening the long standing Bosch–Volvo partnership.


 


 





GenFusion: Harnessing Generational Synergy for a Future-Ready Workplace  

enFusion: Tapping into Generational Strength brought together BD/PTD-M2C and BD/DPA-CSO associates in a vibrant DEI-led engagement to reframe “generational difference” into “generational synergy.” In collaboration with the BD HR team, the session created an open space for dialogue, reflection, and shared learning on how different generations connect, collaborate, and innovate. Manickavasaham Somasundaram set the tone through his keynote, highlighting that every generation brings valuable insights and that embracing these differences strengthens teams and builds a future-ready organization. Representatives from Gen X, Gen Y, and Gen Z shared candid perspectives across themes such as values and behaviors, tech adoption, and communication in the age of AI and hybrid work - revealing diverse approaches but a shared commitment to learning and collaboration. The event was very well received, with participants appreciating the engaging discussions and cross-generational perspectives. We thank the BD India Leadership and HR Team for their sponsorship and continued support in fostering an inclusive culture. GenFusion reinforced a simple truth: when generations learn with and from one another, we unlock new possibilities together.


 


 






Success Story of MS/ECV-PS and PS-SC/ECV Team collaboration to acquire EA211 EVO3 ECU Project from Customer VW  

We are thrilled to announce a significant win for Bosch, as our business partner PS-SC/ECV in Vienna has confirmed that Volkswagen (VW) has awarded the EA211 EVO3 Engine Control Unit project to Bosch. This success is a direct reflection of the outstanding contributions and collaborative spirit of both PS-SC/ECV3 and MS/ECV12-PS Team – VW One Team.

The EA211 EVO3 ECU project presented a unique and demanding challenge. VW sought a rapid prototype to integrate emission-relevant features from the advanced MG1EVO platform into their classic MG1 platform Engine Control Unit. This required porting critical functionalities between vastly different architectures within an ambitious three-month timeframe – a task that truly tested the limits of conventional development cycles.
The VW One Team, comprised of highly skilled and dedicated experts, rose to this challenge with exceptional professionalism. They meticulously devised a step-by-step plan for both software and hardware updates, ensuring that every milestone was met to deliver the prototype software within the committed timeline.

The project’s complexity was substantial, requiring the adaptation of over 450 functional components for the initial test software. Navigating the integration phase, which involved resolving challenges related to over 1000 open interfaces and implement I/O signal configurations, demanded seamless collaboration. This was achieved through effective cross-functional teamwork with colleagues spanning India, Vienna, Germany, Vietnam, and Cluj. Furthermore, the team proactively mitigated risks associated with high runtime by implementing optimized techniques, safeguarding the project's critical delivery schedule.

The unwavering commitment and resilience demonstrated by the VW One team during these demanding periods were paramount. Team dedication ensured the successful delivery of the first running software to the customer for evaluation at the Test bench.

Culminated Effort from the Team leads to a remarkable achievement: the customer successfully achieved "First Fire" in the engine test bench at Wolfsburg, Germany, with minimal iterations. The exceptional behavior of the Bosch software deeply impressed the VW customer, ultimately leading to the award of the EA211 EVO3 project to us.

This project is a true testament to the growth and development within our teams. Being part of this challenging journey has significantly sharpened our collective skills and boosted our confidence in managing time-critical software updates. The VW One Team proactive approach, technical expertise, and collaborative spirit were key differentiators that ultimately secured this significant win for Bosch. 

We would like to appreciate and Thank Fischer Oliver (PS-SC/ECV3) and Reisinger Sarah (PS-SC/ECV3) for the continuous guidance and support that played key role for this Project Win.

#ManaHyderabad | Supporting Community Development and Water Conservation in Manchal Mandal

On 7th March 2026, BGSW Hyderabad Associates visited Manchal Mandal as part of Bosch’s continued commitment to community engagement and sustainable development. During the visit, associates interacted with local farmers and conducted structured career guidance sessions for students from the local government school. The engagement provided students with exposure to different career pathways and encouraged them to think about future educational and professional opportunities.

Bosch, through its CSR interventions, supports WOTR (Watershed Organisation Trust), an NGO working towards watershed development projects in Maharashtra and Karnataka. As part of this broader initiative, the visit also provided volunteers with exposure to a similar watershed development model implemented in close proximity to the BGSW Hyderabad office.

During the visit, BGSW Hyderabad Associates observed a water conservation pond developed by a farmer along with his two brothers. The initiative demonstrated practical approaches to sustainable water management and highlighted the importance of community-led solutions in addressing future water needs.

BGSW Hyderabad Associates also engaged with students by sharing insights into their professional backgrounds and providing an overview of Bosch as an organization. The session included discussions on career values, professional development, and opportunities for future growth.

The visit concluded with continued interactions with community members, reinforcing Bosch’s focus on knowledge sharing, responsible citizenship, and supporting initiatives that contribute to long-term societal development.

BGSW #ManaHyderabad celebrated International Women’s Day 2026 with a powerful and inspiring event that brought together leadership perspectives, meaningful dialogue and vibrant women community, reinforcing our commitment to inclusion beyond words and into action.

A key highlight of the celebration was the inspiring keynote by Ms. Pooja Jamwal, Head of Strategy and Corporate Development at Cyient DLM. Drawing from her leadership journey across industries, she shared candid insights on resilience, growth, and navigating leadership with confidence, leaving the audience inspired and energized.

The event also featured awards and recognition moments, along with vibrant experiences like the Flea Market and Women in Tech Entrepreneurship Marketplace in collaboration with WeHUB, celebrating and supporting women-led businesses.

The celebration was further enriched by a special recognition of Ms. Meera Shenoy, Founder and CEO of Youth4Jobs, for her inspiring work advancing employment opportunities for youth with disabilities for her inspiring work and strong collaboration with Bosch in advancing education, skilling, and employment opportunities for youth with disabilities.

Together, the event reaffirmed our belief in creating spaces where women can lead, innovate, and thrive—and reminded us that when we give, we all gain.

VM AI Showtime was successfully hosted in Hyderabad on 10 March, bringing together associates for an engaging and insightful session on the growing role of Artificial Intelligence in our organization. The event was very well received and witnessed enthusiastic participation from the team.

The session provided a valuable platform for associates to gain a deeper understanding of our AI strategy and overall approach toward leveraging emerging technologies. It also offered insights into how AI can support our business objectives and enhance efficiency across projects.

The HERALBONY team from Japan facilitated a thoughtfully curated session designed to foster reflection, dialogue, and meaningful international exchange among a select group of leaders. HERALBONY represents artists with intellectual disabilities and licenses their original artworks to leading global brands and institutions, ensuring their creativity receives both cultural recognition and commercial value. The organization was recently recognized at the LVMH Innovation Award in the Employee Experience, Diversity & Inclusion category, highlighting its global impact. This invite-only immersive session, hosted at WE Hub as the India pilot, was led by Japanese trainers visiting India for the first time.

Mr. Amjad Khan Patan, Center Head – BGSW Hyderabad, and Ms. Priya Menon, Site HR Lead – BGSW Hyderabad, attended the session and engaged with global experts and cross-sector leaders on advancing inclusion and innovation.

*        Highlighted how international brands integrate inclusion into strategy and innovation

Facilitated exchange of perspectives within a curated circle of organizational leaders


 


 






Pathfinders Explore the Hidden Trails of Nijagal Betta 

On 7th March, 81 enthusiastic associates from the Pathfinders community came together for an adventurous trek to Nijagal Betta, a lesser-explored hill known for its rugged trails, fascinating rock formations, and quiet historical charm. Located on the outskirts of Bangalore, the hill offers a refreshing break from the city and rewards trekkers with sweeping views, ancient ruins, and a sense of discovery that makes every step exciting.

The trek was not just about reaching the top, it was about the journey together. The Pathfinders brought their signature spirit of energy, laughter, and camaraderie as the group explored the trails, shared stories, clicked countless pictures, and cheered each other along the climb. From playful banter on the trail to moments of quiet awe at the summit, the day was filled with exploration, entertainment, and pure fun, strengthening bonds within the community. Experiences like these truly capture what Pathfinders stands for adventure, connection, and creating unforgettable memories together.

Dear All,

 

As per the attached mail, your separation is scheduled for 18th March 2026. In line with the Exit Process, kindly follow the steps and timelines below to ensure a smooth clearance

 

1.	Effort Booking Screenshot (Planisware)

Update your last week’s timesheet up to the final working day, ensure it is approved, and share the screenshot with @Arvind Nadar (GS/HRS11-IN) and @Bhavya B (GS/HRS11-IN) before submitting the laptop.

 

2.	IT Asset Return Request -

Please raise a Return My Computer request on the IT Service Portal (bosch.com) <https://rb-servicecatalog.apps.intranet.bosch.com/RequestCenter/website/Grunt/application/offer.html?id=4372>  by 16th March 2026 to initiate IT clearance.

 

3.	IT Asset Submission –

 

Submit your IT assets on 18th March 2026 at the following venue and time:

		*	9:00 AM – 12:00 PM
		*	Meeting Room 536, 5th Floor, Tower B

 

4.	ID Card Submission – On 18th March 2026 

After submitting your laptop , kindly return your ID card at the same venue during:

		*	1:00 PM – 2:30 PM
		*	Meeting Room 536, 5th Floor, Tower B

 

 

Thank you for your cooperation in following the above process. This will help us ensure a smooth and timely exit procedure.

 



 

*	 

Mit freundlichen Grüßen / Best regards

Priyanka Sampat Daware

Subject: Important Health Information: Understanding Chickenpox
Body:
Dear Associates, 

 

We're sharing some important information about Chickenpox (Varicella) to ensure everyone is well-informed about this common illness and how to manage it, which surges during summer.

 

What is Chickenpox? Chickenpox, medically known as varicella, is a highly contagious illness caused by the varicella-zoster virus (VZV). It's most recognizable by its distinctive blister-like rash. While commonly associated with children, it can affect anyone who hasn't been vaccinated or previously infected. 

 

How Does Chickenpox Spread? The virus spreads easily from person to person primarily through:

*	Airborne droplets: When an infected person coughs or sneezes, the virus can enter the air and be inhaled by others.
*	Direct contact: Touching the fluid from a chickenpox blister and then touching your mouth or nose.
*	Indirect contact: Less commonly, via unwashed hands that have touched contaminated objects (e.g., clothes). The virus is most contagious 1-2 days before the rash appears and until all blisters have crusted over, usually about 5-7 days after the rash onset.

 

Stages and Symptoms: Chickenpox progresses through several stages:

1.	Incubation Period: 10-21 days from exposure to symptom onset.
2.	Prodromal Stage: Mild fever, general malaise, loss of appetite, headache.
3.	Rash Development: Red bumps appear, quickly turning into fluid-filled blisters, then crusting over. New spots can appear for several days.
4.	Healing: Blisters dry out, forming scabs that eventually fall off.

 

Classic symptoms include:

*	Itchy red rash: Begins on the face, chest, and back, then spreads to other body parts, including inside the mouth, eyelids, or genital area.
*	Fever: Usually mild to moderate.
*	Body aches, headache, tiredness, and loss of appetite.
*	Blisters: Filled with clear fluid, which then break open before crusting over.

 

Who is at Risk? Most susceptible groups include children, adults who never had chickenpox, pregnant women not immune, and immunocompromised individuals.

 

Treatment and Home Care: Chickenpox typically resolves on its own. Proper care can accelerate recovery and prevent complications:

*	Isolation: Stay home to prevent spreading the infection until all blisters have scabbed over.
*	Hydration and Rest: Plenty of fluids and rest help the body heal.
*	Itch Relief: Calamine lotion application as recommended by the doctor. Keep fingernails short to prevent scratching and potential infection.
*	Medications: Paracetamol for fever (avoid aspirin in children). Antiviral drugs may be prescribed for severe or high-risk cases.

 

When to See a Doctor: Seek medical attention if fever or/and rash is seen. This is especially crucial for infants, pregnant individuals, or those who are immunocompromised.

 

Prevention is Key:

*	Vaccination: The chickenpox vaccine is safe and highly effective. It's recommended for those who haven't had chickenpox or been vaccinated, especially adults planning pregnancy.
*	Handwashing: Frequent and proper hand hygiene for everyone.
*	Disinfect Surfaces: Regularly clean commonly touched objects and surfaces if there is a known case of CP.

 

Understanding chickenpox helps us to protect ourselves and our community. For any symptoms or concerns, always consult a qualified doctor promptly.

 

For further reading: http://www.cdc.gov/chickenpox

 

For any further queries, contact BGSW/HRL-HWB BGSW/HRL-HWB-MED.
